items.name: ! a
items.summary: Returns the negation of a Boolean expression. This means `true` becomes `false` and vice versa.
Add two Numbers, concatenate two Arrays or two Strings, or create a copy of an Array or HashMap.
Subtracts numbers or arrays from each another, negates a number. For arrays also see deleteAt and deleteRange.

items.name: a != b
items.summary: Returns whether one value is not equal to another. String comparison is case-insensitive (e.g `"STRINGtext" != "stringTEXT" // returns false - strings are equivalent`).

items.name: a % b
items.summary: Remainder of *a* divided by *b*.

items.name: a && b
items.summary: Returns true only if both conditions are true. In case of the alternative syntax, lazy evaluation is used - if left operand is false, evaluation of the right side is ignored.

items.name: a * b
items.summary: Returns the value of *a* multiplied by *b*.

items.name: a / b
items.summary: Returns the quotient of two numbers. If the divisor is 0 a *Division by zero* error is shown but the script does not stop and the result of such division is assumed to be 0.

items.name: a : b
items.summary: See switch

items.name: a = b
items.summary: Assigns the result of expression on the right to the variable on the left. Technically this is not a command and it is not listed in supportInfo; this is more of a compiler instruction.

items.name: a == b
items.summary: Check if *a* is equal to *b*. String comparison is case-insensitive - use isEqualTo if case sensitivity is needed.

items.name: a ^ b
items.summary: *a* raised to the power of *b*

items.name: a greater b
items.summary: Returns true if a is greater than b, else returns false.

items.name: a greater= b
items.summary: Returns if *a* is greater than or equal to *b*.

items.name: a hash b
items.summary: Selects an element from an Array, same as select command for arrays, but has higher precedence.

items.name: a less b
items.summary: Returns if *a* is lesser than *b*.

items.name: a less= b
items.summary: Returns true if a is less than or equal to b, else returns false.

items.name: a or b
items.summary: Returns true if one or both conditions are true. In case of the alternative syntax, lazy evaluation is used. That means that if left operand is true, evaluation of the right side is skipped completely.

items.name: abs
items.summary: Returns absolute (positive) value of a real number.

items.name: accTime
items.summary: Returns the current simulation acceleration factor.

items.name: acos
items.summary: ArcCosine of a number, result in Degrees

items.name: action
items.summary: Make a unit perform an action. See Category:Actions for action names and syntaxes.

items.name: actionKeys
items.summary: Returns Array containing dikCodes of keys, buttons and combos assigned to the given user action. Action names could be found in config class ControllerSchemes or user action names or user profile, for example:

items.name: actionKeysEx
items.summary: Gives a broken down version of actionKeys return. Returns an Array containing the breakdowns of the dikCodes of keys, buttons and combos assigned to the given user action.

items.name: actionKeysImages
items.summary: Returns a list of button images or names assigned to the given user action. A maximum of *maxKeys* keys is listed. You can find the action names in the ControllerSchemes config class or user action names.

items.name: actionKeysNames
items.summary: Returns a list of button names assigned to the given user action. Action names can be found in config class `ControllerSchemes` or user action names.

items.name: actionKeysNamesArray
items.summary: Returns a list of button names assigned to the given user action. You can find the action names in config class ControllerSchemes or user action names.

items.name: actionName
items.summary: Returns localized name of action.

items.name: actionNow
items.summary: Make a unit perform an action immediately (without any animation/pre-processing). See the action command for more information.

items.name: actionParams
items.summary: Returns Array with params for given user action id (similar to addAction param array).

items.name: activateAddons
items.summary: Activates the listed addons.

items.name: activatedAddons
items.summary: Returns a list of all activated addons.

items.name: activateKey
items.summary: Activates the given keyname for the current user profile. The keys are used to unlock missions or campaigns. See `keys`, `keysLimit` and `doneKeys` in the Description.ext#Mission Keys chapter.

items.name: activeTitleEffectParams
items.summary: Returns type, effect, speed and map visibility of the given active title effect (see allActiveTitleEffects)

items.name: add3DENConnection
items.summary: Connect entities together. Be aware to select the correct type of Eden Entities for the connection type.

items.name: add3DENEventHandler
items.summary: Adds an Eden Editor Event Handler.

items.name: add3DENLayer
items.summary: Adds an editing layer in Eden Editor.

items.name: addAction
syntax: object addAction [title, script, arguments, priority, showWindow, hideOnUse, shortcut, condition, radius, unconscious, selection, memoryPoint]
items.summary: Adds an entry to the action menu of an object. The action can only be activated when in proximity to the object and looking at it. Adding an action to the player makes that action available to the player at all times.

items.name: addBackpack
items.summary: Adds a backpack for a unit. If a unit already has a backpack, the old backpack will be placed on the ground under the unit. Items defined in the backpack's config will be added as well.

items.name: addBackpackCargo
items.summary: Add backpack(s) to the cargo space of vehicle. Classname list of available backpacks is here.

items.name: addBackpackCargoGlobal
items.summary: Add backpack(s) to the cargo space of vehicle.

items.name: addBackpackGlobal
items.summary: Adds a backpack to a unit - global variant of addBackpack.

items.name: addBinocularItem
items.summary: Adds weapon item, including magazine, directly to the binocular weapon. This is used for infantry weapons.

items.name: addCamShake
items.summary: Creates the camera shaking effect, like when you are near an explosion

items.name: addCuratorAddons
items.summary: Allow curator use of given addon.

items.name: addCuratorCameraArea
items.summary: Adds or changes curator camera area (depends on if ID is already used).

items.name: addCuratorEditableObjects
items.summary: Register objects which can be edited by a curator.

items.name: addCuratorEditingArea
items.summary: Adds or changes curator edit area (depends on if ID is already used).

items.name: addCuratorPoints
items.summary: Adds or removes curator points.

items.name: addCuratorSelected
items.summary: Add items to the selected curator items.

items.name: addEditorObject
items.summary: Add an object to the editor and assign arguments. Create script is,called with _new equal to true. Returns the ID of the new EditorObject.,Subtype class is optional.

items.name: addEventHandler
items.summary: Adds an Event Handler to the given object. - As many Event Handlers of any type can be added - existing Event Handlers do not get overwritten - Use removeEventHandler to remove an Event Handler Read Event Handlers for…

items.name: addForce
items.summary: Applies given force for one frame (essentially an impulse) to unit or given PhysX object at given position.

items.name: addForceGeneratorRTD
items.summary: Adds force generator to world.

items.name: addGoggles
items.summary: Create a new item and try to link it into goggles (glasses) slot.

items.name: addGroupIcon
items.summary: Adds icon to a group leader. Returns icon ID, Control icons visibility with setGroupIconsVisible. Since Arma 3 v2.22 the offset can be set separately for 2d and 3d.

items.name: addHandgunItem
items.summary: Adds weapon item, including magazine, directly to the handgunWeapon. This is used for infantry weapons.

items.name: addHeadgear
items.summary: Creates a headgear item and tries to link it to headgear slot. If slot is occupied with another item, the item in the slot will be replaced.

items.name: addItem
items.summary: Creates new item and tries to add it into inventory. Inventory must have enough space to accomodate new item or command will fail.The item can also be a weapon or a magazine.

items.name: addItemCargo
items.summary: Creates new items and stores them in given container. Works with items, weapons, magazines, equipment and glasses but not backpacks. In the latter case use addBackpackCargo instead.

items.name: addItemCargoGlobal
items.summary: Global variant of addItemCargo.

items.name: addItemPool
items.summary: Adds count items of type name into the weapon pool (used in the campaign to transfer items to the next mission)

items.name: addItemToBackpack
items.summary: Create new item and store it to soldier's backpack. The item can also be a weapon or a magazine.

items.name: addItemToUniform
items.summary: Create new item and store it to soldier's uniform. The item can also be a weapon or a magazine.

items.name: addItemToVest
items.summary: Create new item and store it to soldier's vest. The item can also be a weapon or a magazine.

items.name: addLiveStats
items.summary: Adds score to the Xbox Live Statistics score for the given unit (or the commander unit of the given vehicle).

items.name: addMagazine
syntax: unitName addMagazine magazineName Local ArgumentGlobal Effect
unitName addMagazine [magazineName, ammoCount] Arma 2: Operation Arrowhead v1.62 Local ArgumentGlobal Effect Arma 3 v1.00 Global ArgumentGlobal Effect
items.summary: Adds a magazine to a person. Infantry units can only carry a specific number of magazines, once the magazine slots are filled (or uniform/vest/bagpack are full in Arma 3), any further addMagazine commands are ignored.

items.name: addMagazineAmmoCargo
items.summary: Adds magazines with specified ammo count to the cargo space of a vehicle or a container.

items.name: addMagazineCargo
items.summary: Add magazines to the cargo space of vehicles, which can be taken out by infantry units. Once the magazine cargo space is filled up, any further addMagazineCargo commands are ignored.

items.name: addMagazineCargoGlobal
items.summary: Add magazines to the cargo space of vehicles, which can be taken out by infantry units.

items.name: addMagazineGlobal
items.summary: Adds magazine to a unit regardless of locality. This command can also be used to add magazine to a vehicle, like a static gun, for example.

items.name: addMagazinePool
items.summary: Adds magazines to the magazine pool, of which the player may choose in the following mission. Available in campaigns only.

items.name: addMagazines
items.summary: Adds multiple magazines to the unit. For cargo containers use addMagazineCargoGlobal command.

items.name: addMagazinesTurret
items.summary: Adds given number of a magazine to the given turret. Use turret path `[-1]` for driver's turret.

items.name: addMagazineTurret
items.summary: Adds a magazine to the turret. Use turret path `[-1]` for driver's turret.

items.name: addMenu
items.summary: Adds a new menu button. Priority is optional.

items.name: addMenuItem
items.summary: Creates a new menu item. Menu can be "file" or "view",index is index,as returned from addMenu command. priority is optional and determines,where in the menu the item will reside (higher priority items first).

items.name: addMissionEventHandler
items.summary: Adds event handler attached to the current mission and returns event handler handle. For the list of available mission event handlers see: Arma 3: Mission Event Handlers

items.name: addMPEventHandler
items.summary: Adds a multiplayer event handler (EH) to the given object and returns EH handle. See Event Handlers.

items.name: addMusicEventHandler
items.summary: Adds playMusic event handler. Returns id of the handler or -1 when failed. Like addMissionEventHandler, the music event handler is attached to the mission. See Arma 3: Event Handlers#Music Event Handlers.

items.name: addonFiles
items.summary: Returns a list of files present in the addon.

items.name: addOwnedMine
items.summary: Sets ownership of a remotely detonatable mine to a unit. If the unit is a player, an action that allows the player to detonate the mine is added to the action menu.

items.name: addPlayerScores
items.summary: MP server only: Adds player score.

items.name: addPrimaryWeaponItem
items.summary: Adds weapon item, including magazine, directly to the primaryWeapon. This is used for infantry weapons.

items.name: addPublicVariableEventHandler
items.summary: This event handler will detect if a missionNamespace variable (it is attached to) has been broadcast over network with publicVariable, publicVariableClient or publicVariableServer commands and will execute EH code upon…

items.name: addRating
items.summary: Add a number to the rating of a unit - negative values can be used to reduce the rating.

items.name: addResources
items.summary: Adds resources to a team member.

items.name: addScore
items.summary: Adds a number to the score of a unit. Negative values will remove from the score.

items.name: addScoreSide
items.summary: Adds side score. This is shown in the MP score tab as the total score. MP only.

items.name: addSecondaryWeaponItem
items.summary: Adds weapon item, including magazine, directly to the secondaryWeapon. This is used for infantry weapons.

items.name: addSwitchableUnit
items.summary: Adds a unit to the list of units available for Team Switch. Units marked as playable in editor are automatically switchable.

items.name: addTeamMember
items.summary: Add given member to given team. Effect is local, unless both member and team are local to PC on which command is executed, then effect is global.

items.name: addToRemainsCollector
items.summary: Adds an array of vehicles/units to disposal manager for automatic wreck/body removal. The disposal manager follows wreck/body removal values set in description.ext

items.name: addTorque
items.summary: Applies torque (rotation momentum) to the center of mass of the given object. Torque force is defined as vector [x, y, z] applied in world space.

items.name: addUniform
items.summary: Create a new uniform and try to link it into uniform slot (given uniform has to be supported by allowedUniforms list of target soldier).

items.name: addUserActionEventHandler
items.summary: Adds a user action event handler to the current mission and returns its event handler index.

items.name: addVehicle
items.summary: Adds a specified vehicle for use by a specified AI led group.

items.name: addVest
items.summary: Create a new vest and try to link it into vest slot.

items.name: addWaypoint
items.summary: Adds (or inserts when index is given) a new waypoint to a group.

items.name: addWeapon
items.summary: Add a weapon to a unit. For a global version of this command see addWeaponGlobal.

items.name: addWeaponCargo
items.summary: Add weapons to the cargo space of vehicles, which can be taken out by infantry units. Ignores available cargo space.

items.name: addWeaponCargoGlobal
items.summary: Add weapons to the cargo space of vehicles, which can be taken out by infantry units.

items.name: addWeaponGlobal
items.summary: Add a weapon to a unit. Infantry units can only carry weapons in their respective slots (primary, secondary and handgun), the addWeaponGlobal command will replace the weapon currently in a slot with the added weapon if…

items.name: addWeaponItem
items.summary: Adds a weapon item to the specified weapon. The item can be weapon magazine, in which case the amount of ammo and target muzzle could also be specified.

items.name: addWeaponPool
items.summary: Add weapons to the weapon pool, of which the player may choose in the following mission. Available in campaigns only.

items.name: addWeaponTurret
items.summary: Adds a weapon to the turret. Use turret path [-1] for driver's turret.

items.name: addWeaponWithAttachmentsCargo
items.summary: Adds a weapon into the cargo space of a vehicle / box with given attachments / magazines. Ignores available cargo space.

items.name: addWeaponWithAttachmentsCargoGlobal
items.summary: Adds a weapon into the cargo space of a vehicle / box with given attachments / magazines. Ignores available cargo space.

items.name: admin
items.summary: This is dedicated server command, which queries the admin state of any client on the network by their client (owner) id.

items.name: agent
items.summary: Return a person for a given agent.

items.name: agents
items.summary: Return a list of agents in the current mission.

items.name: AGLToASL
items.summary: Converts position from PositionAGL to PositionASL.

items.name: aimedAtTarget
items.summary: Returns how good a vehicle's weapon is aimed at the target.

items.name: aimPos
items.summary: Returns the position of the object other units can aim to.

items.name: airDensityCurveRTD
items.summary: Returns array with air density data.

items.name: airDensityRTD
items.summary: Returns air density in given altitude.

items.name: airplaneThrottle
items.summary: Returns throttle position. Works only on player's vehicle.

items.name: airportSide
items.summary: Gets the side of an airport, set by setAirportSide. Default side is sideUnknown.

items.name: AISFinishHeal
items.summary: Alternative Injury Simulation (AIS) end state. Used to tell engine that script side healing is done when using "HandleHeal" event handler.

items.name: alive
items.summary: Check if given vehicle/person/building is alive (i.e. not dead or destroyed).

items.name: all3DENEntities
items.summary: Returns an array of all currently placed Eden Editor entities.

items.name: allActiveTitleEffects
items.summary: Returns a list of all layers that have currently active title effect. Numbers equal to or greater than 0 represent cut layers, where as -1 represents title layer (see Title Effect Type).

items.name: allAddonsInfo
items.summary: Returns the list of all loaded addons.

items.name: allAirports
items.summary: Returns all map airports, both static and dynamic.

items.name: allCameras
items.summary: Return a list of all existing cameras.

items.name: allControls
items.summary: Returns a list of all controls in the provided display or controls group, including "sub"-controls from other CT_CONTROLS_GROUPs.

items.name: allCurators
items.summary: Returns list of all curator logic units, not the units assigned to the logic.

items.name: allCutLayers
items.summary: Returns all named layers used by cutRsc, cutText, cutObj or cutFadeOut. The layer normally would be added on the first use of any of the aforementioned commands, however if a layer needs to be reserved it could be done…

items.name: allDead
items.summary: Return a list of all dead units including agents and destroyed vehicles. Dead units may be in vehicles.

items.name: allDeadMen
items.summary: Return a list of dead units including agents. Dead unit might be inside vehicle.

items.name: allDiaryRecords
items.summary: Returns array with all Diary Records for the given subject available to the given person. See Diary for the explanation on the available subjects and their structure.

items.name: allDiarySubjects
items.summary: Returns array with all Diary subjects available to the given person. See Diary for the explanation on the available subjects and their structure.

items.name: allDisplays
items.summary: Returns a list of all opened GUI displays.

items.name: allEnv3DSoundSources
items.summary: Returns all environmental 3D sound sources (Objects) like trees and houses in camera vicinity.

items.name: allExtensions
items.summary: Returns information about all loaded Extensions

items.name: allGroups
items.summary: Return a list of all groups created on the following sides east, west, resistance/independent and civilian only. Does not contain groups of sideLogic.

items.name: allLODs
items.summary: Returns the list of object or model LODs.

items.name: allMapMarkers
items.summary: Returns all map marker names, including user-placed markers.

items.name: allMines
items.summary: Returns an array of all mines in the mission

items.name: allMissionObjects
items.summary: Returns all objects of the given type that are currently present in the mission. In some cases, the entities and allObjects commands are much faster alternatives to this command.

items.name: allObjects
items.summary: Returns array of requested objects as fast as the engine allows it. The objects can be requested by object type and simulation kind.

items.name: allow3DMode
items.summary: Allow/dissallow 3D mode.,

items.name: allowCrewInImmobile
items.summary: If true, units will remain in a vehicle with broken tracks/wheels; they will still eject if the vehicle is drowning, about to explode or upside down for a while.

items.name: allowCuratorLogicIgnoreAreas
items.summary: Allows curator placing and working with modules outside of edit areas.

items.name: allowDamage
items.summary: Enables / disables an entity's ability to receive damage. This command does not prevent the entity from taking scripted damage from commands such as setDamage, setHit, setHitIndex or setHitPointDamage.

items.name: allowDammage
items.summary: Allow or prevent an object being damaged (or injured, or killed). The command does not prevent object from taking scripted damage such as setDamage or setHit.

items.name: allowedService
items.summary: Returns which types of repair/refuel/rearm service are allowed. The two available types are manual, where the action is displayed to the user, and auto, where the service happens within distance.

items.name: allowFileOperations
items.summary: Allow/dissallow file ops (load/save etc).

items.name: allowFleeing
items.summary: Sets the cowardice level (the lack of courage or bravery) of a group or unit.

items.name: allowGetIn
items.summary: Set if the units given in the list are allowed to enter vehicles.

items.name: allowService
items.summary: Sets which type of repair/refuel/rearm service is allowed. The two available types are manual, where the action is displayed to the user, and auto, where the service happens within distance.

items.name: allowSprint
items.summary: Force player to run/jog if set to false.

items.name: allPlayers
items.summary: Returns a list of all units controlled by connected clients. This includes: - Normal human players (including dead players) - Virtual Entities (see *Systems* → *Logic Entities* → *Virtual Entities* in the Eden Editor) -…

items.name: allSimpleObjects
items.summary: Returns array of all simple objects that belong to the listed class names. If the array of types is empty [], all simple objects are returned including those without class name.

items.name: allSites
items.summary: Return all sites in map.

items.name: allTurrets
items.summary: Returns array of available turret paths from vehicle object.

items.name: allUnits
items.summary: Returns a list of all units, except agents, dead units or units waiting for respawn, outside and inside vehicles that were created on the following sides east, west, independent and civilian.

items.name: allUnitsUAV
items.summary: Return a list of all UAV vehicles.

items.name: allUsers
items.summary: Returns a list of player ids of all the users on an MP server.

items.name: allVariables
items.summary: Returns a list of all variables from the desired namespace.

items.name: ambientTemperature
items.summary: Returns ambient temperature on the current terrain in Celsius in format: [airTemperature, blackSurfaceTemperature, whiteSurfaceTemperature]

items.name: ammo
items.summary: Check how many rounds are left in the currently loaded magazine in the given muzzle.

items.name: ammoOnPylon
items.summary: Returns ammo count on given pylon (or false on failure).

items.name: and
items.summary: Returns true only if both conditions are true. In case of the alternative syntax, lazy evaluation is used - if left operand is false, evaluation of the right side is ignored.

items.name: angularVelocity
items.summary: Gets the angular velocity of the object in world space as a 3D vector. The units are in Rad/s (radians per second) and rotations are clockwise.

items.name: angularVelocityModelSpace
items.summary: Gets the angular velocity of the object in model space as a 3D vector. The units are in Rad/s (radians per second) and rotations are clockwise.

items.name: animate
items.summary: Activates given object animation. Animation is defined in CfgModels animations class.

items.name: animateBay
items.summary: Forces animation of bay to given state, -1 for reset to engine handling, can cause weapon inoperative, because weapon is released when bay state == 1.

items.name: animateDoor
items.summary: Animates a door on a vehicle. Animation is defined in config file in CfgVehicles -> AnimationSources. Wanted animation phase is set with phase param. This command works only on animation sources with "door" controller.

items.name: animatePylon
items.summary: Force animation of pylon to given state, -1 for reset to engine handling, can cause weapon inoperative, because weapon is released when pylon state == 1.

items.name: animateSource
items.summary: Process an animation of the object. If animate uses class name from CfgModels *Animations*, animateSource uses name defined by the *source* property. AnimationSources can animate multiple animate Animations.

items.name: animationNames
items.summary: Returns Array of Strings where elements are the names of model animations, which should theoretically be available for use with animate command.

items.name: animationPhase
items.summary: Returns the phase of the given animation on the given object. Animation can be scripted (animate, animateSource, animateDoor) or engine driven.

items.name: animationSourcePhase
items.summary: Returns current animation phase of given source. Similar to animationPhase or doorPhase but designed to complement animateSource.

items.name: animationState
items.summary: Returns the name of a unit's current primary animation. Seems to be forced to lower case in Arma 3.

items.name: apertureParams
items.summary: Returns current aperture parameters.

items.name: append
items.summary: Appends array2 to the back of array1 modifying array1. See insert for an "appendUnique" equivalent.

items.name: apply
items.summary: Applies the given code to each element of the given data structure and collects the results in an array.

items.name: armoryPoints
items.summary: Returns, stored in [USERNAME].ArmaXProfile, value of *armoryPoints* entry. If the entry doesn't exist, it returns 0.

items.name: arrayIntersect
items.summary: Intersects two arrays returning an array of unique common elements, avoiding nil values. Using the same array as both parameters will return unique elements of that array.

items.name: asin
items.summary: Arcsine of a number, result in Degrees.

items.name: ASLToAGL
items.summary: Converts position from PositionASL to PositionAGL

items.name: ASLToATL
items.summary: Converts a position from PositionASL to PositionATL

items.name: assert
items.summary: Tests a condition and if the condition is false, displays error on screen (if -showscripterrors enabled) and logs error into .rpt file. It does not interrupt the script execution.

items.name: assignAsCargo
items.summary: Assign a unit as cargo of a vehicle. Used together with orderGetIn to order a unit to get in as cargo into a specific vehicle.

items.name: assignAsCargoIndex
items.summary: Assigns the character to a specific cargo / passenger index of the given vehicle.

items.name: assignAsCommander
items.summary: Assign a unit as commander of a vehicle. Used together with orderGetIn to order subordinate units to get in as commander of a specific vehicle.

items.name: assignAsDriver
items.summary: Assign a unit as driver of a vehicle. Used together with orderGetIn to order subordinate units to get in as driver of a specific vehicle.

items.name: assignAsGunner
items.summary: Assign a unit as gunner of a vehicle. Used together with orderGetIn to order subordinate units to get in as gunner of a specific vehicle.

items.name: assignAsTurret
items.summary: Assigns the soldier to turret.

items.name: assignCurator
items.summary: Assign player as curator. Two players cannot act as one curator.

items.name: assignedCargo
items.summary: Returns the list of soldiers assigned to the given vehicle as a cargo.

items.name: assignedCommander
items.summary: Returns the soldier assigned to the given vehicle as a commander.

items.name: assignedDriver
items.summary: Returns the soldier assigned to the given vehicle as a driver.

items.name: assignedGroup
items.summary: Returns Group to which the given vehicle was added last with addVehicle. To update assignedGroup to the current group, run addVehicle to the current group again.

items.name: assignedGunner
items.summary: Returns the soldier assigned to the given vehicle as a gunner.

items.name: assignedItems
items.summary: Get array with assigned items. The resulting Array order is not guaranteed. To check availability of a particular slot item use getSlotItemName. To return stored items see items and itemsWithMagazines.

items.name: assignedTarget
items.summary: Returns the target assigned to an unit or the vehicle's effectiveCommander. The target can be assigned by the group/vehicle/formation leader (as player via quick command menu or "target" complex command menu).

items.name: assignedTeam
items.summary: Returns the team the unit belongs to. Possible values:

items.name: assignedVehicle
items.summary: Returns the vehicle to which a unit is assigned, usually with *assignAsXXX* command. If no vehicle is assigned objNull is returned.

items.name: assignedVehicleRole
items.summary: Returns the role a unit is assigned to within its assigned vehicle.

items.name: assignedVehicles
items.summary: Returns all vehicles added to the given Group with addVehicle.

items.name: assignItem
items.summary: Assigns existing item from inventory (uniform, vest, backpack) to a correct slot. If the slot is occupied by another item, it gets replaced. See also linkItem.

items.name: assignTeam
items.summary: Assigns the unit (in case of a vehicle, its commander) to the given team. Team is an option in group control (unit management) menu that allows to split player group in teams and then give bulk order to separate teams.

items.name: assignToAirport
items.summary: Assigns a plane to an airport ID or object.

items.name: atan
items.summary: Returns the arcus tangens.

items.name: atan2
items.summary: ArcTangent of *y/x*. Used to determine the angle of a vector *[y,x]*. Result in Degrees between -180 and 180.

items.name: atg
items.summary: Returns the arcus tangens.

items.name: ATLToASL
items.summary: Converts a position from PositionATL to PositionASL

items.name: attachChild
syntax: [parent, child] attachChild [jointType, localFrameParent, localFrameChild, miscFlags, jointDescription]
items.summary: Attaches a child object to a parent, similar to attachTo but instead of a rigid/forced attachment its using a PhysX joint.

items.name: attachedObject
items.summary: Returns the object a location is attached to. If the location is unattached, then objNull is returned.

items.name: attachedObjects
items.summary: Returns a list of objects attached to the given object.

items.name: attachedTo
items.summary: Returns object the given object is attached to or objNull if the given object is not attached to anything.

items.name: attachObject
items.summary: Attaches a location to the specified object. To detach a location, attach it to objNull.

items.name: attachTo
items.summary: Attaches an object to another object. - The offset is applied to the object center unless a memory point is provided, in which case the offset will be applied to the memory point position.

items.name: attackEnabled
items.summary: Return whether a group's leader can issue attack commands to soldiers under his command.

items.name: awake
items.summary: Wakes up sleeping PhysX object or puts a PhysX object to sleep. In 2.10 this command can be used on corpses of type `Man` and has no effect on alive units.

items.name: backpack
items.summary: Returns a class of a backpack.

items.name: backpackCargo
items.summary: Get array with backpacks from ammo box (or any general weapon holder container).

items.name: backpackContainer
items.summary: Returns a cargo container of a unit's backpack.

items.name: backpackItems
items.summary: Get array with all items (of any kind, even weapons) in backpack of the given unit.

items.name: backpackMagazines
items.summary: Get array with all magazines from backpack of the given unit.

items.name: backpacks
items.summary: Returns an array of all backpack names a unit has in its inventory, excluding the one it carries on the back.

items.name: backpackSpaceFor
items.summary: Returns how much space is in backpack for given weapon or magazine

items.name: behaviour
items.summary: Returns the behaviour of the individual unit, this is why it only accepts Object as the argument. For Arma 3 behaviour explanation see Arma_3_AI_Behavior

items.name: benchmark
items.summary: Returns the value of "3D Performance" in OFP Preferences (flashpoint.cfg). This can be used to estimate the computer performance to adapt CPU and GPU demanding settings like view distance dynamically in missions.

items.name: bezierInterpolation
items.summary: Gets interpolated value based on Bézier curve with given control points (progress value is 0...1 for a curve that starts at pos0 and finishes at posN)

items.name: binocular
items.summary: Returns class name of currently used binocular weapon.

items.name: binocularItems
items.summary: Returns array with all items assigned to the binocular weapon except magazines. Use binocularMagazine command for the latter. This command is used for infantry weapons only.

items.name: binocularMagazine
items.summary: Collects all loaded magazines from all binocular muzzles and returns them in Array, otherwise it returns []. This command is used for infantry weapons only.

items.name: blufor
items.summary: Pre-defined variable for the blufor side.

items.name: boundingBox
items.summary: Returns a bounding box of given object in model coordinate space, adjusted according to destruction/animation of an object.

items.name: boundingBoxReal
items.summary: Returns a raw bounding box of given object in model coordinates space. This command is similar to boundingBox but gives more precise measurements.

items.name: boundingCenter
items.summary: Returns the position of the original (loaded) center of an object in model coordinates.

items.name: brakesDisabled
items.summary: Returns the status of autobrake (see disableBrakes).

items.name: break
items.summary: Skips all loop iterations (for, forEach, while, findIf etc).

items.name: breakOut
items.summary: Breaks out of the scope with given name. - An unknown scopeName name will cause the script error `Generic error in expression` - If multiple scopes with the same name exist, the command will break out the nearest scope.

items.name: breakTo
items.summary: Breaks block to scope named *name*.

items.name: breakWith
items.summary: Skips all loop iterations and immediately returns the given value.

items.name: briefingName
items.summary: Returns the name of the current briefing/scenario name.

items.name: buildingExit
items.summary: Returns the given indexed exit in a building. The returned value is in format Position.

items.name: buildingPos
items.summary: Returns position of a given indexed position in a building.

items.name: buldozer_enableRoadDiag
items.summary: Enables road diagnostics in buldozer.

items.name: buldozer_isEnabledRoadDiag
items.summary: Returns if road diagnostics are enabled in buldozer.

items.name: buldozer_loadNewRoads
items.summary: Generates new roads. Working only in buldozer.

items.name: buldozer_reloadOperMap
items.summary: Reload oper map visible in costMap diag tool. Working only in buldozer.

items.name: buttonAction
items.summary: Returns the action assigned to a control of the currently active user dialog. Can be used for buttons and active texts. Read Arma: GUI Configuration for more information about user dialogs and controls.

items.name: buttonSetAction
items.summary: Set the action of a control of the currently active user dialog. The script statement is executed on button release and `_this` is available, but contains ""; See Arma: GUI Configuration for more information about user…

items.name: cadetMode
items.summary: Prior to Arma 3 it returns if the player is currently playing in cadet or veteran mode.

items.name: calculatePath
items.summary: Spawns an agent that will execute an AI path calculation and fire the `"PathCalculated"` event handler.

items.name: calculatePlayerVisibilityByFriendly
items.summary: Sets if friendly units will calculate player's visibility or not. Default value is false.

items.name: call
items.summary: Adds given set of compiled instructions to the current stack and waits for it to finish and return, provides an option to pass arguments to the executed Code.

items.name: callExtension
items.summary: Calls custom .dll also known as Extension. The name of the extension is the name of the extension .dll without ".dll" part (or without "_x64.dll" part on 64-bit Arma).

items.name: camCommand
items.summary: Executes a command on the given *camera / actor* object. Known commands:

items.name: camCommit
items.summary: Smoothly conduct the changes that were assigned to a camera within the given time. If the time is set to zero, the changes are done immediately. For `camPrepareXXX` commands use camCommitPrepared.

items.name: camCommitPrepared
items.summary: Smoothly conducts the changes that were assigned to a camera within the given time. If the time is set to zero, the changes are done immediately. This command is for use with `camPrepareXXX` commands.

items.name: camCommitted
items.summary: Checks if the conduction of the last camCommit call already finished.

items.name: camConstuctionSetParams
items.summary: Sets construction camera parameters. To work with "camconstruct" object.

items.name: camCreate
items.summary: Create a camera or a seagull object on the given position. The creation happens immediately and doesn't wait for camCommit.

items.name: camDestroy
items.summary: Destroys camera object created with camCreate. This command doesn't need camCommit.

items.name: cameraEffect
items.summary: Sets the given effect on the given camera. If you want to switch the screen directly to the first-person, aiming, third-person or group view of an object, use switchCamera instead.

items.name: cameraEffectEnableHUD
items.summary: Enable / disable showing of in-game UI during currently active camera effect. By default the HUD is off, which will make results of drawIcon3D invisible, for example.

items.name: cameraInterest
items.summary: Return camera interest for given entity, as set by setCameraInterest, or as autodetected.

items.name: cameraOn
items.summary: Returns the vehicle to which the camera is attached. If you need the person, see focusOn.

items.name: cameraView
items.summary: Returns mode of active camera view. Mode is one of: - "INTERNAL" (1st person) - "EXTERNAL" (3rd person) - "GUNNER" (optics / sights) - "GROUP" (commander view)

items.name: campaignConfigFile
items.summary: Returns root of campaign description.ext entries hierarchy.

items.name: camPreload
items.summary: Preloads the scene for the prepared camera with given timeout after which preloading is aborted. Max timeout is 30 seconds. Timeout of 0 means max timeout of 30 seconds as well.

items.name: camPreloaded
items.summary: Checks whether the camera has finished preloading.

items.name: camPrepareBank
items.summary: Prepares the camera bank angle.

items.name: camPrepareDir
items.summary: Prepares the camera heading.

items.name: camPrepareDive
items.summary: Prepares the camera dive angle.

items.name: camPrepareFocus
items.summary: focusRange is . Prepares the camera focus blur.

items.name: camPrepareFov
items.summary: Prepares the camera field of view (zoom). The default zoom level is 0.75, 0.01 is the nearest and 2 the furthest zoom value. The angle of the field of view is *atan(FOV)*2* radians when in 4:3 aspect ratio.

items.name: camPrepareFovRange
items.summary: Prepares the camera field of view range for auto zooming.

items.name: camPreparePos
items.summary: Prepares the camera position. Needs the call of camCommitPrepared to be conducted.

items.name: camPrepareRelPos
items.summary: Prepares the camera position relative to the current position of the currect target (see camPrepareTarget). Needs the call of camCommitPrepared to be conducted.

items.name: camPrepareTarget
items.summary: Prepares the camera target to a position or to a target. Needs the call of camCommitPrepared to be conducted.

items.name: camSetBank
items.summary: Sets camera bank angle. Does not commit changes.

items.name: camSetDir
items.summary: Sets the orientation of the given camera in the direction of the given vector. Needs camCommit. Since Arma 3 v0.50, only the second syntax with a Vector3D is available.

items.name: camSetDive
items.summary: Sets camera dive angle. Does not commit changes.

items.name: camSetFocus
items.summary: Sets camera focus range. It does not automatically commit changes (see camCommit). Use [-1, -1] to disable focus completely.

items.name: camSetFov
items.summary: Set the zoom level (Field Of View) of the given camera.

items.name: camSetFovRange
items.summary: Set the zoom level (Field Of View) start and end values for automatical zooming.

items.name: camSetPos
items.summary: Sets the position of the given camera or seagull (see camCreate). It is worth mentioning that camera position can also be set with setPos, in which case it would be instant.

items.name: camSetRelPos
items.summary: Sets the position of the given camera relative to its target, set with camSetTarget. Needs a call to camCommit to be conducted.

items.name: camSetTarget
items.summary: Set the target object or position where the given camera should point at. Needs the call of camCommit to be conducted. To reset the target use objNull.

items.name: camTarget
items.summary: Returns camera's target.

items.name: camUseNVG
items.summary: Set / clear using of night vision during cutscenes. This command only works with camCreate created camera that is currently the main camera for the player (see #Examples).

items.name: canAdd
items.summary: Checks if given object can be stored in inventory of given object or any inventory container (uniform, vest, backpack) of given unit.

items.name: canAddItemToBackpack
items.summary: Checks if given object can be stored into soldier's backpack.

items.name: canAddItemToUniform
items.summary: Checks if given object can be stored into soldier's uniform.

items.name: canAddItemToVest
items.summary: Checks if given object can be stored into soldier's vest.

items.name: cancelSimpleTaskDestination
items.summary: Cancels a simple task destination.

items.name: canDeployWeapon
items.summary: Returns true if a unit's weapon can be deployed.

items.name: canFire
items.summary: Returns true if the given vehicle is still able to fire. For the command to return true, vehicle must be alive, have weapon operator and the weapon cannot be damaged ≥ 0.9 but can be empty due to running out of ammo.

items.name: canMove
items.summary: Returns if the given vehicle is still able to move. - This command does not check for the amount of fuel the vehicle has, except for helicopters and airplanes.

items.name: canSlingLoad
items.summary: Returns true if setSlingLoad is possible.

items.name: canStand
items.summary: Returns if the given soldier is able to stand up. It only checks for the unit's legs and not its alive/dead status - it can return true for a dead unit.

items.name: canSuspend
items.summary: Returns true if sleep, uiSleep or waitUntil commands can be used in the current scope.

items.name: canTriggerDynamicSimulation
items.summary: A getter for triggerDynamicSimulation.

items.name: canUnloadInCombat
items.summary: Returns config value of `unloadInCombat` for a vehicle. Alternatively see getUnloadInCombat

items.name: canVehicleCargo
items.summary: Returns bool array if it is possible to load cargo inside vehicle and if possible to load cargo into empty vehicle

items.name: captive
items.summary: Returns the captive state of the given unit (set with setCaptive). A captive unit will not be attacked by its enemies.

items.name: captiveNum
items.summary: Checks whether the unit is a captive. If the unit is a vehicle, its commander is checked instead.

items.name: case
items.summary: This command is used as a keyword inside a switch structure to define a value case.

items.name: catch
items.summary: Processes code when an exception is thrown in a try block. The exception caught can be found in the *_exception* variable.

items.name: cbChecked
items.summary: Returns the current state of a CT_CHECKBOX control.

items.name: cbSetChecked
items.summary: Sets the current state of a CT_CHECKBOX control. Use `"CheckedChanged"` control event handler with it.

items.name: ceil
items.summary: The ceil value of x.

items.name: channelEnabled
items.summary: Returns Array of Booleans in format [enabledChat, enabledVoN] for the given channel. For more information about enabling/disabling of chat channels see enableChannel.

items.name: cheatsEnabled
items.summary: Checks whether cheats are enabled (whether the designers' version is running).

items.name: checkAIFeature
items.summary: Checks if the given AI feature is currently enabled.

items.name: checkVisibility
items.summary: Checks if one position is visible from another position and how much.

items.name: childAttached
items.summary: Get the child that has been attached via attachChild

items.name: civilian
items.summary: Pre-defined variable for the civilian side.

items.name: className
items.summary: Returns short name of location. For config class name, see configName

items.name: clear3DENAttribute
items.summary: Clears the value of the given entity's attribute in Eden Editor. An attribute is identified by its `property` (`data` when it is engine-drive attribute) value in config.

items.name: clear3DENInventory
items.summary: Deletes inventory from mission.sqm of given units. Effect is not immediately visible, only when previewing the inventory resets to default.

items.name: clearAllItemsFromBackpack
items.summary: Removes all items from backpack of a unit.

items.name: clearBackpackCargo
items.summary: Removes all backpacks from ammo box (or any general weapon holder container).

items.name: clearBackpackCargoGlobal
items.summary: Removes all backpacks from the vehicle cargo space; MP-synchronised.

items.name: clearForcesRTD
items.summary: Removes all force generators from world.

items.name: clearGroupIcons
items.summary: Removes all icons from group.

items.name: clearItemCargo
items.summary: Removes all items from ammo box (or any general weapon holder container).

items.name: clearItemCargoGlobal
items.summary: Removes all items from ammo box (or any general weapon holder container). It also removes vests and uniforms.

items.name: clearItemPool
items.summary: Removes all items from ammo box (or any general weapon holder container)

items.name: clearMagazineCargo
items.summary: Remove all magazines from the given vehicle's magazine cargo space.

items.name: clearMagazineCargoGlobal
items.summary: Removes all magazines from the vehicle cargo space. MP synchronized.

items.name: clearMagazinePool
items.summary: Removes all magazines from the magazine pool, of which the player may choose in the following missions. Available in campaigns only.

items.name: clearOverlay
items.summary: Clear the current overlay.

items.name: clearRadio
items.summary: Clean up the content of radio protocol history.

items.name: clearWeaponCargo
items.summary: Remove all weapons from the given vehicle's weapon cargo space.

items.name: clearWeaponCargoGlobal
items.summary: Removes all weapons from the vehicle cargo space. MP synchronized.

items.name: clearWeaponPool
items.summary: Remove all weapons from the weapon pool, of which the player may choose in the following missions. Available in campaigns only.

items.name: clientOwner
items.summary: Returns the machine network ID of the client executing the command.

items.name: closeDialog
items.summary: Closes the currently active dialog with exit code. It does not instantly close the dialog but does it on next simulation cycle. Most common exit codes are:

items.name: closeDisplay
items.summary: Closes given display with exit code. It does not instantly close the display but does it on next simulation cycle. Most common exit codes are:

items.name: closeOverlay
items.summary: Closes the current overlay without committing.

items.name: collapseObjectTree
items.summary: Collapse the object tree.

items.name: collect3DENHistory
items.summary: Execute a block of code in which all Eden Editor operations will be recorded as one history step.

items.name: collectiveRTD
items.summary: Returns the current position of a helicopter's collective pitch control. - 0: fully lowered - 1: fully raised

items.name: collisionDisabledWith
items.summary: Returns the object, given object has collision disabled with and whether or not returned object has also collision disabled with given object.

items.name: combatBehaviour
items.summary: Returns combat behaviour of unit or group. To set unit or group behaviour see setCombatBehaviour. The behaviour is one of:

items.name: combatMode
items.summary: Returns the combat mode of the given AI group. See setCombatMode for more information about combat modes.

items.name: combatPace
items.summary: Sets or gets the combat pace for the local player. If the right-hand array is empty, the command will simply return the current combat pace mode without making any changes to combat pace.

items.name: commandArtilleryFire
items.summary: Orders an artillery unit to fire a burst on the given position (via the radio).

items.name: commandChat
items.summary: Types text to the command radio channel. The text will be visible only on the PC where command was executed. If you need the message to show on all computers, you have to execute it globally (see remoteExec).

items.name: commander
items.summary: In Operation Flashpoint it returns the commander of a vehicle. Since Armed Assault it returns the primary observer. The commander of a vehicle can be found with effectiveCommander.

items.name: commandFire
items.summary: Order the given unit to fire on the given target (via the radio). If the target is objNull, the unit is ordered to fire on its current target (set with doTarget or commandTarget).

items.name: commandFollow
items.summary: Order the given unit(s) to follow another from his own group (via radio). It can also be used to resume unit formation after e.g doStop.

items.name: commandFSM
items.summary: Orders a unit to process command defined by FSM file (via the radio).

items.name: commandGetOut
items.summary: Orders one or multiple units to get out from the vehicle (via the radio). Same as doGetOut with latter being silent.

items.name: commandingMenu
items.summary: Returns the name of the topmost commanding menu or "" if the menu is closed. For action menu visibility check see isActionMenuVisible. See #Notes for Arma 2/Arma 3 structure.

items.name: commandMove
items.summary: Order the given unit(s) to move to the given location (via the radio). Exactly the same as doMove, except this command displays a radio message.

items.name: commandRadio
items.summary: Sends the audio message to the command radio channel. The message is defined in CfgRadio in the description.ext file or config radio protocol. The transmission will play only on the PC where command was executed.

items.name: commandStop
items.summary: Order the given unit(s) to stop via radio. A stop command will never finish, the unit(s) will never be ready.

items.name: commandSuppressiveFire
items.summary: Orders the given unit or a group of units to suppress the given position or target (with radio messages, see doSuppressiveFire if you do not want messages).

items.name: commandTarget
items.summary: Order the given unit(s) to target the given target (via the radio). Command given to the player, puts a red square with words Target and Distance on player's HUD at target location.

items.name: commandWatch
items.summary: Orders the unit(s) to watch the given position or target (via the radio). Use objNull as the target to order a unit to stop watching a position/target.

items.name: comment
items.summary: Defines a comment. See SQF Syntax#Comments to learn more about comments.

items.name: commitOverlay
items.summary: Commit the current overlay.

items.name: compatibleItems
items.summary: Returns all items (attachments) that can be mounted on the given weapon.

items.name: compatibleMagazines
items.summary: Returns all magazines that can be loaded in the given weapon or all magazines containing the provided ammo. No compatible magazines are returned for submunition or missiles.

items.name: compatibleWeapons
items.summary: Returns all compatible weapons for given weapon item, weapon magazine or weapon slot.

items.name: compile
items.summary: Compiles String expression into Code.

items.name: compileFinal
items.summary: Compiles an expression / takes an existing HashMap and makes it final, preventing it from being modified or overwritten (by = assignation, publicVariable, set or any other command).

items.name: compileScript
items.summary: This command is an alias for `compile(Final) (prefixHeader + preprocessFileLineNumbers path)`. See description of preprocessFileLineNumbers for more details.

items.name: completedFSM
items.summary: Checks whether the given FSM is completed. The FSM handle is the number returned by the execFSM command.

items.name: composeText
items.summary: Creates a Structured Text by joining the given structured or plain text arguments.

items.name: config greater greater name
items.summary: Returns config entry with given name (alias of a / b, slightly faster but with lower precedence)

items.name: configClasses
items.summary: Returns an array of config entries which meet criteria in condition code. Command iterates through all available config sub classes of the given config class.

items.name: configFile
items.summary: Return root of config entries hierarchy.

items.name: configHierarchy
items.summary: Returns hierarchy of the given config class. Just like with inheritsFrom, only complete config classes are supported (before Arma 3 v2.14).

items.name: configName
items.summary: Returns name of config entry.

items.name: configNull
items.summary: A non-existing Config.

items.name: configOf
items.summary: Returns config path of the provided object.

items.name: configProperties
items.summary: Returns an array of config entries that meet the criteria in the condition code. The command iterates through available classes and config properties for given config entry.

items.name: configSourceAddonList
items.summary: Returns an array of addons (CfgPatches) in which the given config class is defined.

items.name: configSourceMod
items.summary: Returns modDir of the mod that given config class was loaded from.

items.name: configSourceModList
items.summary: Returns an array of mods (CfgMods) in which the given config class is defined.

items.name: confirmSensorTarget
items.summary: Sets for which Side the entity becomes a "confirmed hostile" target - a target that becomes highlighted red on the sensors display.

items.name: connectTerminalToUAV
items.summary: Connect person with UAV terminal to UAV unit. UAV Terminal item needs to be assigned to GPS slot. In MP the connection is handled locally, therefore it is possible for multiple MP clients to connect to the same UAV.

items.name: connectToServer
items.summary: Connects the client to the provided server.

items.name: continue
items.summary: Skips current loop iteration and continues with the next one.

items.name: continueWith
items.summary: Skips the current loop iteration, continues with the next one and returns the given value.

items.name: controlNull
items.summary: A non-existing Control. To compare non-existent objects use isNull or isEqualTo (see examples).

items.name: controlsGroupCtrl
items.summary: Returns a child control with specified idc from a controls group

items.name: conversationDisabled
items.summary: A getter for disableConversation.

items.name: copyFromClipboard
items.summary: Return ANSI content of the (text) clipboard. If Unicode support is desired, see forceUnicode.

items.name: copyToClipboard
items.summary: Copies ANSI text string to the clipboard. If Unicode support is desired, see forceUnicode.

items.name: copyWaypoints
items.summary: Copy the chain of waypoints from source to target group. The target group will start to process waypoints from the first one.

items.name: cos
items.summary: Cosine of a number, argument in degrees.

items.name: count
items.summary: Can be used to count: - The number of elements in an array (returns the already internally known array size) - The number of elements in an array matching the condition - The number of sub-entries in a config entry -…

items.name: countEnemy
items.summary: Count how many units in the array are considered enemy to the given unit.

items.name: countFriendly
items.summary: Count how many units in the array are considered friendly to the given unit.

items.name: countSide
items.summary: Returns how many units in the given array belong to given side.

items.name: countType
items.summary: Count how many objects in the array are of given type. This command also works with parent classes like "Air", "Tank", and "Car". For a full class reference see Classes.

items.name: countUnknown
items.summary: Count how many units in the array are unknown to the given unit.

items.name: create3DENComposition
items.summary: Create new Composition. To create individual entities, use create3DENEntity.

items.name: create3DENEntity
items.summary: Create new Eden Entity. Used for creating individual entities; to create a composition (e.g., infantry squad), use create3DENComposition and to create a layer use add3DENLayer.

items.name: createAgent
items.summary: Creates an agent of the given type. An agent does not have a group or leader or the standard soldier FSM associated with it - for instance, an enemy soldier spawned as an agent has limited AI and will do nothing when…

items.name: createCenter
items.summary: Instanciate a Side center. A Side center is required to be able to create groups of this side.

items.name: createDialog
items.summary: Creates a dialog which is defined either in the mission's description.ext, in the campaign's description.ext or in the global resource.cpp. The given name has to be the class name used in one of these files.

items.name: createDiaryLink
items.summary: Creates a link to the given diary entry.

items.name: createDiaryRecord
syntax: player createDiaryRecord [subject, textInfo, task, taskState, showTitle]
items.summary: Creates a Diary entry. Supported tags and their parameters:

items.name: createDiarySubject
items.summary: Creates a new subject in the Diary.

items.name: createDisplay
items.summary: Creates child display of given display and loads from "resourceName". The notable difference between createDisplay and createDialog is that with createDisplay the player would be able to move around while the display is…

items.name: createGearDialog
items.summary: Opens gear dialog for given unit.

items.name: createGroup
items.summary: Creates a new Group for the given Side. Using this command if the group limit is reached will return grpNull. The new Group exists globally, but it's locality is where this command was executed.

items.name: createGuardedPoint
items.summary: Adds a point guarded by the given side (scripted way of adding equivalent of "GUARDED BY" trigger in Editor). A closest AI group in the given side with assigned "GUARD" waypoint will attempt to secure this guard point.

items.name: createHashMap
items.summary: Creates a new empty HashMap.

items.name: createHashMapFromArray
items.summary: Creates a new HashMap and initializes it from a key-value pair array

items.name: createHashMapObject
items.summary: Create a HashMap with an Object-Oriented Programming behaviour.

items.name: createLocation
items.summary: Creates a location of the specified class and dimensions at the specified position. Classes are defined in `CfgLocationTypes`; for possible location types see Location Types.

items.name: createMarker
items.summary: Creates a new map marker at the given position. The marker will be created for every connected player as well as all JIP players.

items.name: createMarkerLocal
items.summary: Creates a local marker at the given position - the marker only exists on the machine that created it. The marker name has to be unique, if a marker with the given name exists, the command will be ignored.

items.name: createMenu
items.summary: Creates a previously added menu.

items.name: createMine
items.summary: Creates a mine of the given type.

items.name: createMissionDisplay
items.summary: Create single missions display as a child of given display. The mission dialog will be set to the directory given as an argument "root".

items.name: createMPCampaignDisplay
items.summary: Create a MP campaign display. The class name must be a mission collection declared in the configs; for example, `configFile >> "CfgMissions" >> "MPMissions" >> "Apex"`

items.name: createSimpleObject
items.summary: Create object with given shape defined as path to .p3d model. Supported LODs include Geometry, Fire Geometry, Roadway, View Geometry and ShadowVolume.

items.name: createSimpleTask
items.summary: Creates a new Task and adds it to the Diary.

items.name: createSite
items.summary: Create a new site.

items.name: createSoundSource
items.summary: Creates a sound source of the given type (type is the name of the subclass of CfgVehicles which is pointing to the sound defined in CfgSFX).

items.name: createSoundSourceLocal
items.summary: Same as createSoundSource but with local effect - the created sound is not transferred to other clients.

items.name: createTarget
items.summary: Create a target.

items.name: createTask
syntax: teamMember createTask [[type, parentTask], priority, name1, value1, ...]
items.summary: Create a new AI task (subtask of parentTask). Type is name of registered task type.

items.name: createTeam
items.summary: Creates a Team and names it.

items.name: createTrigger
items.summary: Creates a trigger of the given type and at the given position. The type must be a class name in *CfgNonAIVehicles* or *CfgVehicles* with `simulation = detector`.

items.name: createUnit
syntax: group createUnit [type, position, markers, placement, special]
type createUnit [position, group, init, skill, rank]
items.summary: Create a unit of the provided CfgVehicles class.

items.name: createVehicle
items.summary: Creates an empty object of given classname type. See Arma 3: Assets / Arma 3: createVehicle/vehicles, or Category:CfgVehicles for earlier games.

items.name: createVehicleCrew
items.summary: Creates vehicle crew corresponding to the provided vehicle's faction. If the vehicle is already occupied, the command will only create missing crew in the existing vehicle's group.

items.name: createVehicleLocal
items.summary: Creates an object of the given type. The Created object is not transferred through network in MP games. netId of such vehicle in multiplayer will be "0:0".

items.name: crew
items.summary: Returns the crew (both dead and alive) of the given vehicle.

items.name: ctAddHeader
items.summary: Adds a header line of controls according to the HeaderTemplate class. Note that rows and headers are indexed separately.

items.name: ctAddRow
items.summary: Adds one row of controls according to the RowTemplate class. It returns an array containing row index and array of created controls in a format [<rowIndex>, [<control0>, <control1>...<control n>]].

items.name: ctClear
items.summary: Removes all the lines from the RscControlsTable. Returns Nothing.

items.name: ctCurSel
items.summary: Returns index of the selected row. Will take only rows, but not headers into account.

items.name: ctData
items.summary: Returns metadata associated with a particular row of a CT_CONTROLS_TABLE control.

items.name: ctFindHeaderRows
items.summary: Gets array of indices of rows under this header.

items.name: ctFindRowHeader
items.summary: Gets index of the closest header above this row.

items.name: ctHeaderControls
items.summary: Returns array of controls on the header with the given index.

items.name: ctHeaderCount
items.summary: Returns number of headers (rows not included) in the RscControlsTable.

items.name: ctRemoveHeaders
items.summary: Takes array of header indices as a parameter and removes headers with those indices. Indices of remaining headers will be recomputed.

items.name: ctRemoveRows
items.summary: Takes array of row indices as a parameter and removes rows with those indices. Indices of remaining rows will be recomputed.

items.name: ctrlActivate
items.summary: Launches action attached to given (button based) control. Command ignores control disabled state. (Example 2).

items.name: ctrlAddEventHandler
items.summary: Add an event handler to the given control.

items.name: ctrlAngle
items.summary: Gets rotation info of a control set as `ST_PICTURE`. Supported control types: - CT_STATIC - Arma 3 v2.10 CT_ACTIVETEXT

items.name: ctrlAnimateModel
items.summary: Process an animation of 3D Arma: GUI Configuration. Command uses name defined by source property and works similar like animateSource command.

items.name: ctrlAnimationPhaseModel
items.summary: Returns current animation phase of given source. Similar to animationSourcePhase.

items.name: ctrlAt
items.summary: Returns the control at the specified coordinates.

items.name: ctrlAutoScrollDelay
items.summary: Returns number of seconds auto-scroll will wait before scroll and/or rewind. -2 if scrollbar not present.

items.name: ctrlAutoScrollRewind
items.summary: Returns true if auto-scroll should move back to start after it reaches the end.

items.name: ctrlAutoScrollSpeed
items.summary: Returns number of seconds to auto-scroll one line. -1 if auto-scroll is disabled. -2 if scrollbar not present.

items.name: ctrlBackgroundColor
items.summary: Returns control's background color.

items.name: ctrlChecked
items.summary: Returns the current state of given CT_CHECKBOXES control. Since Arma 3 v1.72 it is possible to query multiple checkboxes by providing checkbox index. For more information see CT_CHECKBOXES.

items.name: ctrlClassName
items.summary: Returns the class name of a Control as it is defined in config. If you need config class of a game created Display, it is stored on display itself:

items.name: ctrlCommit
items.summary: Commits control animation to last specified duration.

items.name: ctrlCommitted
items.summary: Check if the control animation is finished.

items.name: ctrlCreate
items.summary: Creates a new control in the given display.

items.name: ctrlDelete
items.summary: Deletes given control. The control has to be created either by script with ctrlCreate or to have `deletable` property in config set to 1.

items.name: ctrlEnable
items.summary: Enables or disables a control of the currently active user dialog. Disabled controls cannot be clicked onto. Read Arma: GUI Configuration for more information about user dialogs and controls.

items.name: ctrlEnabled
items.summary: Returns if a control on the currently active user dialog is enabled. Disabled controls cannot be focused. Read Arma: GUI Configuration for more information about user dialogs and controls.

items.name: ctrlFade
items.summary: Returns the current fade factor of control.

items.name: ctrlFontHeight
items.summary: Returns control's font size, usually `sizeEx` value (see ctrlSetFontHeight).

items.name: ctrlForegroundColor
items.summary: Returns control's foreground color.

items.name: ctrlGetProperty
items.summary: Returns one or multiple given properties of given control.

items.name: ctrlHTMLLoaded
items.summary: Returns true when HTML content was successfully loaded.

items.name: ctrlIDC
items.summary: Returns control IDC.

items.name: ctrlIDD
items.summary: Returns display IDD.

items.name: ctrlMapAnimAdd
items.summary: Adds the next frame to the map animation.

items.name: ctrlMapAnimClear
items.summary: Clears the map animation.

items.name: ctrlMapAnimCommit
items.summary: Plays the map animation.

items.name: ctrlMapAnimDone
items.summary: Checks whether the map animation has finished.

items.name: ctrlMapCursor
items.summary: Changes the default cursor that appears when interacting with a map control to a custom one. Use an empty string to restore the default cursor.

items.name: ctrlMapDir
items.summary: Returns the current orientation angle of the map control in degrees.

items.name: ctrlMapMouseOver
items.summary: Returns description of map sign mouse cursor is over. Works with in-game map as well as 2D editor map in edit mode.

items.name: ctrlMapPosition
items.summary: A getter for ctrlMapSetPosition. Returns map position in format [x, y, w, h]. If map is inside a Controls Group, the x and y position is relative to the Controls Group top left corner.

items.name: ctrlMapScale
items.summary: Returns the current scale of given map control.

items.name: ctrlMapScreenToWorld
items.summary: Converts map screen coordinates into world coordinates. Unlike posScreenToWorld, this command returns world position is format [x, y], otherwise it is identical to posScreenToWorld.

items.name: ctrlMapSetPosition
items.summary: Sets position and size of the given map control and recalculates control center. The effect is immediate and no ctrlCommit is necessary, unlike with ctrlSetPosition command.

items.name: ctrlMapWorldToScreen
items.summary: Converts world coordinates into map screen coordinates. This command is identical to posWorldToScreen.

items.name: ctrlModel
items.summary: Returns model used in 3D-Dialog.

items.name: ctrlModelDirAndUp
items.summary: Returns vectorDir and vectorUp of the model used in 3D-Dialogs. Returns [[],[]] if control is null.

items.name: ctrlModelScale
items.summary: Returns 3D control model scale.

items.name: ctrlModelVectorSide
items.summary: Get the provided control model's vectorSide in 3D-Dialogs.

items.name: ctrlMousePosition
items.summary: Returns position of the mouse on the screen relative to UI Control in UI coordinates. Also works within CT_CONTROLS_GROUPs. In that case, returned position is relative to the position of the group.

items.name: ctrlParent
items.summary: Returns the parent Display of the given control. For parent Controls group see ctrlParentControlsGroup.

items.name: ctrlParentControlsGroup
items.summary: Returns the parent control of a given child control. If the control is not part of a CT_CONTROLS_GROUP control then controlNull is returned. To return parent Display of the control use ctrlParent.

items.name: ctrlPosition
items.summary: Returns the current position of 2D control as `[x, y, w, h]` array. For 3D control it returns relative `[x, z, y]`.

items.name: ctrlRemoveAllEventHandlers
items.summary: Remove all event handlers from the given control.

items.name: ctrlRemoveEventHandler
items.summary: Remove a given event handler from the given control.

items.name: ctrlScale
items.summary: Returns the current scale of the control.

items.name: ctrlScrollValues
items.summary: Returns scroll values for current scrollbars in range 0...1 (-1 if not applicable) for the following controls: - CT_CONTROLS_TABLE - CT_CONTROLS_GROUP - CT_TREE - CT_LISTBOX - CT_COMBO - CT_XCOMBO - CT_LISTNBOX -…

items.name: ctrlSetActiveColor
items.summary: Sets text color of given control when it is selected.

items.name: ctrlSetAngle
items.summary: Sets the rotation of a control set as `ST_PICTURE`. Rotation will be done within the control boundaries, so if the X and Y are given off center, the picture may get clipped by the control boundaries.

items.name: ctrlSetAutoScrollDelay
items.summary: Sets number of second before auto-scroll starts/rewinds. Setter for ctrlAutoScrollDelay.

items.name: ctrlSetAutoScrollRewind
items.summary: Defines if scroll should rewind when auto-scroll reach end. Setter for ctrlAutoScrollRewind.

items.name: ctrlSetAutoScrollSpeed
items.summary: Sets number of second required to scroll to next line. If speed < 0, auto-scroll is disabled. Setter for ctrlAutoScrollSpeed.

items.name: ctrlSetBackgroundColor
items.summary: Sets background color of given control. Only affects: - CT_COMBO - CT_STATIC - CT_STRUCTURED_TEXT - CT_MAP - CT_MAP_MAIN - Arma 3 v2.02 CT_BUTTON - Arma 3 v2.02 CT_SHORTCUTBUTTON - Arma 3 v2.02 CT_ACTIVETEXT

items.name: ctrlSetChecked
items.summary: Sets checked state of a CT_CHECKBOXES control.

items.name: ctrlSetDisabledColor
items.summary: Sets the colorDisabled attribute of a control.

items.name: ctrlSetEventHandler
items.summary: Sets given event handler of given control: any previously added event handler is removed.

items.name: ctrlSetFade
items.summary: Sets wanted transparency for control animation. Requires ctrlCommit to commit changes. To hide or show a control instantly, use ctrlShow.

items.name: ctrlSetFocus
items.summary: Sets the input focus on given control.

items.name: ctrlSetFont
items.summary: Sets the font for given control (see available fonts)

items.name: ctrlSetFontH1
items.summary: Sets H1 font of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontH1B
items.summary: Sets H1 bold font of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontH2
items.summary: Sets H2 font of given HTML control

items.name: ctrlSetFontH2B
items.summary: Sets H2 bold font of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontH3
items.summary: Sets H3 font of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontH3B
items.summary: Sets H3 bold font of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontH4
items.summary: Sets H4 font of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontH4B
items.summary: Sets H4 bold font of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontH5
items.summary: Sets H5 font of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontH5B
items.summary: Sets H5 bold font of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontH6
items.summary: Sets H6 font of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontH6B
items.summary: Sets H6 bold font of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontHeight
items.summary: Sets the `sizeEx` property for most controls as follows: - `CT_MAP` - "sizeExNames" - `CT_HTML` - "P" >> "sizeEx" - Other - "sizeEx" - Arma 3 v2.02 `CT_STRUCTURED_TEXT` - "size"

items.name: ctrlSetFontHeightH1
items.summary: Sets H1 font size of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontHeightH2
items.summary: Sets H2 font size of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontHeightH3
items.summary: Sets H3 font size of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontHeightH4
items.summary: Sets H4 font size of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontHeightH5
items.summary: Sets H5 font size of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontHeightH6
items.summary: Sets H6 font size of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontHeightSecondary
items.summary: Sets the font size of the secondary text of given control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontP
items.summary: Sets P font of given HTML control or its size.

items.name: ctrlSetFontPB
items.summary: Sets P bold font of given HTML control.

items.name: ctrlSetFontSecondary
items.summary: Sets the font size of the secondary text of given control.

items.name: ctrlSetForegroundColor
items.summary: Sets foreground color of the given control.

items.name: ctrlSetModel
items.summary: Sets model for 3D-Dialogs (see Arma 3: createSimpleObject/objects for a p3d models' list).

items.name: ctrlSetModelDirAndUp
items.summary: Sets orientation of 3D control model. It is similar to setVectorDirAndUp command for an object.

items.name: ctrlSetModelScale
items.summary: Sets 3D control model scale

items.name: ctrlSetMousePosition
items.summary: Similar to setMousePosition but relative to the given control.

items.name: ctrlSetPixelPrecision
items.summary: Switches mode of pixel precision (rounding) in a given control interface.

items.name: ctrlSetPosition
items.summary: Sets wanted position and size for 2D control animation. Width and height are optional. ctrlCommit is required to complete the operation.

items.name: ctrlSetPositionH
items.summary: Sets the height of a 2D control. ctrlCommit is required to complete the operation.

items.name: ctrlSetPositionW
items.summary: Sets the width of a 2D control. ctrlCommit is required to complete the operation.

items.name: ctrlSetPositionX
items.summary: Sets horizontal position (x) of the 2D control. ctrlCommit is required to complete the operation.

items.name: ctrlSetPositionY
items.summary: Sets vertical position (y) of a 2D control. ctrlCommit is required to complete the operation.

items.name: ctrlSetProperty
items.summary: Sets one or multiple given properties of given control.

items.name: ctrlSetScale
items.summary: Sets scale of a control. Top left corner remains same. This command requires ctrlCommit.

items.name: ctrlSetScrollValues
items.summary: Sets scroll values for current scrollbars in range 0..1 for the following controls: - CT_CONTROLS_TABLE - CT_CONTROLS_GROUP - CT_TREE - CT_LISTBOX - CT_COMBO - CT_XCOMBO - CT_LISTNBOX - CT_LISTNBOX_CHECKABLE

items.name: ctrlSetShadow
items.summary: Sets 'shadow' property of the control: - 0 - no shadow - 1 - shadow - 2 - outline

items.name: ctrlSetStructuredText
items.summary: Set the Structured Text which will be displayed in structured text control.

items.name: ctrlSetText
items.summary: Sets the text of a control of the currently active user dialog or display. This command can be used for static texts, buttons, edit lines and active texts as well as for images, where you can use it to set the image…

items.name: ctrlSetTextColor
items.summary: Sets text color of given control. As of Arma 3 v1.40 this command can also be used to change fill-color of a CT_PROGRESS control.

items.name: ctrlSetTextColorSecondary
items.summary: Sets the secondary text color of a text control.

items.name: ctrlSetTextSecondary
items.summary: Sets the secondary text of a text control.

items.name: ctrlSetTextSelection
items.summary: Selects `length` characters of edit control from the `start` position and places cursor at the end of selection.

items.name: ctrlSetTooltip
items.summary: Sets tooltip text of given control.

items.name: ctrlSetTooltipColorBox
items.summary: Sets tooltip border color of given control.

items.name: ctrlSetTooltipColorShade
items.summary: Sets tooltip background color of given control.

items.name: ctrlSetTooltipColorText
items.summary: Sets tooltip text color of given control.

items.name: ctrlSetTooltipMaxWidth
items.summary: Set maximum width of a control's tooltip.

items.name: ctrlSetURL
items.summary: Sets URL property of the given control subject to `allowedHTMLLoadURIs[]` whitelisting in CfgCommands config. Supported controls are: - `CT_BUTTON` - `CT_SHORTCUTBUTTON` - `CT_ACTIVETEXT`

items.name: ctrlSetURLOverlayMode
