items.summary: Sets how to handle opening of URL, default browser or Steam overlay. Possible values: - 0 - default browser - 1 - Steam overlay if enabled, otherwise default browser - 2 - Steam overlay, shows error message box if…

items.name: ctrlShadow
items.summary: Returns 'shadow' property of the control (see ctrlSetShadow).

items.name: ctrlShow
items.summary: Shows or hides a control, or group of controls together with all the controls inside that group of controls.

items.name: ctrlShown
items.summary: Returns whether given control is shown.

items.name: ctrlStyle
items.summary: Returns the provided control's style. See Arma: GUI Configuration#Control Styles.

items.name: ctrlText
items.summary: Returns the text of a control of the currently active user dialog. This command can be used on static texts, buttons, edit lines and active texts as well as for images, where it returns the image path.

items.name: ctrlTextColor
items.summary: Returns control's text color

items.name: ctrlTextHeight
items.summary: Returns the text control's height. Supported control types: - CT_STATIC - CT_STRUCTURED_TEXT - CT_EDIT - Arma 3 v2.06 CT_XKEYDESC - Arma 3 v2.06 CT_XBUTTON - Arma 3 v2.06 CT_SHORTCUTBUTTON - Arma 3 v2.06 CT_BUTTON -…

items.name: ctrlTextSecondary
items.summary: Returns the secondary text of a text control.

items.name: ctrlTextSelection
items.summary: Returns edit control text selection in format [start, length, selectedText].

items.name: ctrlTextWidth
items.summary: Returns the width of the control text including left and right margins (0.008 each).

items.name: ctrlTooltip
items.summary: Returns the tooltip property of a button control. Getter for ctrlSetTooltip.

items.name: ctrlType
items.summary: Returns number representing the type of control, which is also defined by *type* property in config. For more information see Arma: GUI Configuration

items.name: ctrlURL
items.summary: Returns the URL property of a button control. Getter for ctrlSetURL.

items.name: ctrlURLOverlayMode
items.summary: Returns the URL overlay mode 0, 1, 2 (see ctrlSetURLOverlayMode) or -1 if something went wrong.

items.name: ctrlVisible
items.summary: Returns if a control of the currently active user dialog is shown or not. Read Arma: GUI Configuration for more information about user dialogs and controls.

items.name: ctrlWebBrowserAction
items.summary: Executes an action on a WebBrowser control. The type of parameters depends on the action type. Possible Actions are:

items.name: ctRowControls
items.summary: Returns array of controls on the row with the given index.

items.name: ctRowCount
items.summary: Returns number of rows (headers not included) in the RscControlsTable.

items.name: ctSetCurSel
items.summary: Selects the line with the given index. Will take only rows, but not headers into account. -1 deselects all. Returns Nothing.

items.name: ctSetData
items.summary: Associates metadata (string) with the row determined by the index. Returns Nothing.

items.name: ctSetHeaderTemplate
items.summary: Takes config path to the new header template. Clears the whole RscControlsTable and sets the new header template.

items.name: ctSetRowTemplate
items.summary: Takes config path to the new row template. Clears the whole RscControlsTable and sets the new row template (Deleting all rows and headers is easier to implement than replacing the rows and filling them with new data.

items.name: ctSetValue
items.summary: Associates metadata (number) with the row determined by the index. Returns Nothing.

items.name: ctValue
items.summary: Returns metadata (number) associated with a particular row of RscControlsTable.

items.name: curatorAddons
items.summary: Returns list of addons allowed to given curator. The addon names are not guaranteed to be all lower case

items.name: curatorCamera
items.summary: Returns curator camera object.

items.name: curatorCameraArea
items.summary: Returns all curator camera areas.

items.name: curatorCameraAreaCeiling
items.summary: Returns ceiling height for curator camera.

items.name: curatorCoef
items.summary: Returns current coeficient setting.

items.name: curatorEditableObjects
items.summary: Returns all editable objects which belong to a curator.

items.name: curatorEditingArea
items.summary: Returns all curator editing areas.

items.name: curatorEditingAreaType
items.summary: Returns type of edit areas assigned to curator (blacklist/whitelist).

items.name: curatorMouseOver
items.summary: Returns Curator Editable Object under curator mouse pointer.

items.name: curatorPoints
items.summary: Returns number of points that curator have.

items.name: curatorRegisteredObjects
items.summary: Returns array with all objects that has curator registered and their settings.

items.name: curatorSelected
items.summary: Returns list of all curator selected items.

items.name: curatorSelectionPreset
items.summary: Returns list of all objects stored in the given selection preset.

items.name: curatorWaypointCost
items.summary: Return current price for placing waypoints (curator specific).

items.name: current3DENOperation
items.summary: Returns the currently performed editing operation in Eden Editor.

items.name: currentChannel
items.summary: Returns currently selected user chat channel on the UI (selected with <kbd><</kbd> and <kbd>></kbd> in multiplayer).

items.name: currentCommand
items.summary: Return the current command type (empty string when no command) for the commander of given vehicle (or for a given soldier).

items.name: currentMagazine
items.summary: Returns class name of currently loaded vehicle's / unit's magazine.

items.name: currentMagazineDetail
items.summary: Returns description of vehicle's currently loaded magazine, its ammo count (current/default) and its id.

items.name: currentMagazineDetailTurret
items.summary: Returns the class name of currently used magazine on specified turret. Use turret path [-1] for driver's turret. Note that a turret is not loaded until unit enters it, so this command will return "".

items.name: currentMagazineTurret
items.summary: Returns the name of the type of the currently using magazine on specified turret. Use turret path [-1] for driver's turret. Note that a turret is not loaded until unit enters it, so this command will return "".

items.name: currentMuzzle
items.summary: Returns a unit's current weapon muzzle. Does not work on vehicles.

items.name: currentNamespace
items.summary: Returns the current global namespace the script runs in.

items.name: currentPilot
items.summary: Returns the person piloting the vehicle. If co-pilot is piloting, co-pilot is returned. If you need current pilot of a UAV or UGV, see UAVControl command.

items.name: currentTask
items.summary: Return current task of given person.

items.name: currentTasks
items.summary: Returns array with all uncompleted tasks for the given agent. getVariable could be used on Task to get the following special local variables from the task: - `"_this"` Team Member - the teamMember agent the task is…

items.name: currentThrowable
items.summary: Returns currently selected throwable (and the muzzle it is loaded into), which will be launched if the user presses <kbd>G</kbd>.

items.name: currentVisionMode
items.summary: Returns current vision mode of unit's weapon. Vision mode could be one of: - 0 - normal vision - 1 - night vision - 2 - thermal vision Alternative syntaxes additionally return FLIR index (see setCamUseTI) of the thermal…

items.name: currentWaypoint
items.summary: Returns the *index* of the current waypoint (not the waypoint in Waypoint Array format).

items.name: currentWeapon
items.summary: Return the name of the currently selected weapon (on the primary turret for vehicles).

items.name: currentWeaponMode
items.summary: Returns current weapon mode of unit's weapon.

items.name: currentWeaponTurret
items.summary: Returns the name of the currently selected weapon on specified turret. Use turret path [-1] for driver's turret.

items.name: currentZeroing
items.summary: Returns current zeroing.

items.name: cursorObject
items.summary: Returns the object under cursor. This command is quite different from cursorTarget as it is more precise in determining the boundaries of the pointed at object and can detect a larger variety of objects including map…

items.name: cursorTarget
items.summary: Returns the target pointed at by the player (usually with cross-hairs). The target has to be known to the player to some degree (knowsAbout > 0). If target is completely unknown, command returns objNull.

items.name: customChat
items.summary: Sends the chat message to the custom radio channel. The radio channel needs to be created on the server before hand, with radioChannelCreate command. Use clearRadio to clear chat history

items.name: customRadio
items.summary: Sends the message to the custom radio channel. The message is defined in the description.ext file or radio protocol.

items.name: customWaypointPosition
items.summary: Returns player's custom waypoint (<kbd>LShift</kbd>+<kbd>LMB</kbd>) position.

items.name: cutFadeOut
items.summary: Terminates the effect in the given layer by fading it out according to the given duration. If named layer is used and it doesn't exist, it will be allocated. For title layer see titleFadeOut.

items.name: cutObj
syntax: layer cutObj [class, type, speed, showInMap, drawOverHUD]
layerName cutObj [class, type, speed, showInMap, drawOverHUD]
items.summary: Displays an object defined in the global config in `CfgTitles`.

items.name: cutRsc
syntax: layer cutRsc [class, effect, speed, showInMap, drawOverHUD]
items.summary: Display a resource defined in RscTitles of the mission's Description.ext, the campaign's description.ext or the global config.

items.name: cutText
syntax: cutText [text, type, speed, showInMap, isStructuredText, drawOverHUD]
layer cutText [text, type, speed, showInMap, isStructuredText, drawOverHUD]
items.summary:
Displays a text message in the center of the screen. The text can be displayed on multiple lines by using "
" new line characters: `cutText ["line1
line2
line3", "PLAIN"];`

items.name: damage
items.summary: Return the damage value of an object.

items.name: date
items.summary: Return the actual in-mission date and time.

items.name: dateToNumber
items.summary: Convert a date to a float number, based on Jan 1st 00:00:00 = 0 and Dec 31st 23:59:59 = 1. The same day and time in leap year will be different after 28th of February and 23:59 on 31st of December will be 1.00274.

items.name: dayTime
items.summary: Returns the current in-game time in hours. For a formatted version of time, see BIS_fnc_timeToString.

items.name: deActivateKey
items.summary: Deactivates the given keyname for the current user profile. The keys are used to unlock missions or campaigns.

items.name: debriefingText
items.summary: Returns debriefing text of provided end.

items.name: debugFSM
items.summary: Dump (something about FSM) to debugging output. This command is (assumed to be) non-functional in the retail version.

items.name: debugLog
items.summary: Dump argument type and value to debugging output.

items.name: decayGraphValues
items.summary: Multiplies graph values by the given coefficient. The corresponding lower bound value is used instead if the product is smaller than the bound.

items.name: default
items.summary: Defines a Switch Type default case - does not need a colon to define its block. See switch for more information.

items.name: deg
items.summary: Converts given value in radians to degrees. 1 degree equals 0.01745 radians or pi / 180.

items.name: delete3DENEntities
items.summary: Delete given entities in Eden Editor.

items.name: deleteAt
items.summary: Removes array element at the given index and returns removed element (modifies the original array, just like resize or set).

items.name: deleteCenter
items.summary: In a nutshell, this command removes gaming Side (see createCenter). If a side has >0 Groups it cannot be deleted.

items.name: deleteCollection
items.summary: Delete a collection. As example, used with a soldier, it'll hide the ingame model.

items.name: deleteEditorObject
items.summary: Delete the editor object. Requires all editor object links to be removed prior.

items.name: deleteGroup
items.summary: Destroys the given group - the group must be empty and local to the machine executing this command.

items.name: deleteGroupWhenEmpty
items.summary: Marks given group for auto-deletion when group is empty. true will mark the group for auto-deletion once empty, false will simply unmark the group that was marked previously.

items.name: deleteIdentity
items.summary: Deletes an identity created with saveIdentity from the campaign's progress file.

items.name: deleteLocation
items.summary: Deletes scripted location.

items.name: deleteMarker
items.summary: Destroys the given marker.

items.name: deleteMarkerLocal
items.summary: Destroys the given marker.

items.name: deleteRange
items.summary: Removes a range of array elements from the given array. Modifies the original array, just like resize or set.

items.name: deleteResources
items.summary: Delete (unregister) resources of the team member. Resources are deleted in the order they were added. Case insensitive.

items.name: deleteSite
items.summary: Removes the site.

items.name: deleteStatus
items.summary: Deletes a status created with saveStatus from the campaign's progress file.

items.name: deleteTarget
items.summary: Delete a target.

items.name: deleteTeam
items.summary: Destroy given team.

items.name: deleteVehicle
items.summary: Deletes an object. Only objects inserted in the mission editor and objects created during the game's progress can be deleted by this command. Terrain objects and players cannot be deleted.

items.name: deleteVehicleCrew
items.summary: Deletes a member of or the whole crew of a vehicle. Human players cannot be deleted.

items.name: deleteWaypoint
items.summary: Removes the specified waypoint.

items.name: detach
items.summary: Detaches previously attached with attachTo object.

items.name: detachChild
items.summary: Detaches previously attached with attachChild object.

items.name: detectedMines
items.summary: Returns an array of all mines detected by a given side

items.name: diag_activeMissionFSMs
items.summary: Returns array with active Mission FSMs. To see number of all scripts currently in the scheduler use diag_activeScripts.

items.name: diag_activeScripts
items.summary: Returns 4 element array with numbers of currently running scripts

items.name: diag_activeSQFScripts
items.summary: Returns information about active SQF scripts. To see number of all scripts currently in the scheduler use diag_activeScripts.

items.name: diag_activeSQSScripts
items.summary: Returns array with active SQSs. To see number of all scripts currently in the scheduler use diag_activeScripts.

items.name: diag_allMissionEventHandlers
items.summary: Returns an array with all mission event handlers.

items.name: diag_captureFrame
items.summary: This command starts counting frames from the moment it is executed and when the count reaches the number passed as param, the current frame is captured and captured data UI dialog appears, similar to…

items.name: diag_captureFrameToFile
items.summary: This command starts counting frames from the moment it is executed and when the count reaches the number passed as param, the current frame is captured and written to a log file in the same directory as the .rpt file.

items.name: diag_captureSlowFrame
items.summary: Opens "capture frame" dialog if current frame exceeds set threshold in seconds. One can indicate to either capture duration of a specific profiling selection or the total duration of the frame.

items.name: diag_codePerformance
items.summary: Attempts to run given code with given arguments given number of cycles in unscheduled environment and returns average time it took to run the code as well as actual number of executions performed.

items.name: diag_deltaTime
items.summary: Returns the duration of the previous frame in seconds

items.name: diag_drawMode
items.summary: Activates a debug visualisation.

items.name: diag_dumpCalltraceToLog
items.summary: Dumps current callstack/calltrace to RPT.

items.name: diag_dumpScriptAssembly
items.summary: Dump script assembly.

items.name: diag_dumpTerrainSynth
items.summary: Returns OutsideTerrain's current world's values.

items.name: diag_dynamicSimulationEnd
items.summary: Ends dynamic simulation data gathering and writes collected data into given (txt) file. The file is saved in the Arma 3 installation folder.

items.name: diag_dynamicSimulationStart
items.summary: Starts gathering Arma 3: Dynamic Simulation diagnostic data.

items.name: diag_enable
items.summary: Toggles various diagnostics.

items.name: diag_enabled
items.summary: Checks whether specific diagnostic mode is activated.

items.name: diag_exportConfig
items.summary: Exports given config into file of given path.

items.name: diag_exportTerrainSVG
syntax: diag_exportTerrainSVG [filePath, drawLocationNames, drawGrid, drawCountlines, drawTreeObjects, drawMountainHeightpoints, simpleRoads]
items.summary: Like the old TOPOGRAPHY cheat code, exports terrain, but in modern SVG format instead of the proprietary EMF format.

items.name: diag_fps
items.summary: Returns average framerate calculated over last 16 frames.

items.name: diag_fpsMin
items.summary: Returns minimal framerate. Calculated from the longest frame over last 16 frames.

items.name: diag_frameNo
items.summary: Returns number of frame currently displayed.

items.name: diag_getTerrainGrid
items.summary: Returns terrain cell size (size of each grid cell in the Heightmap).

items.name: diag_getTerrainHeight
items.summary: Returns terrain height at the specified location.

items.name: diag_getTerrainSegmentOffset
items.summary: Returns the terrain segment. It is basically the same as:

items.name: diag_lightNewLoad
items.summary: Allows loading of lighting config during the gameplay (effectively changing the current scene lighting). Filename path can be either absolute or relative.

items.name: diag_list
items.summary: Returns an array of all diagnostic modes available in the game.

items.name: diag_localized
items.summary: Returns array with all localized keys from the given stringtable or the array of all stringtables names if empty string `""` is given. Common stringtables are: `"Global"`, `"Mission"`, `"Campaign"`.

items.name: diag_log
items.summary: Dumps the argument's value to the report file. Each call creates a new line in the file.

items.name: diag_mergeConfigFile
items.summary: Updates config without restarting. Attributes and classes can not be deleted unless `delete` is used. Changes to the config are applied to all new entities, a mission restart is not necessarily required.

items.name: diag_recordTurretLimits
items.summary: Start recording tool for creating turret aiming limits.

items.name: diag_remainsCollector
items.summary: Returns current settings for the remains collector and the list of monitored units if any.

items.name: diag_resetAnims
items.summary: Resets the animations system cache, so that animation makers can test their animations without restarting the game. A mission restart is required for the changes to be applied.

items.name: diag_resetShapes
items.summary: Reload models on-the-fly without the need of restarting the game. Changes applied by diag_resetShapes are applied to all new entities so restart of mission is not necessarily required - spawning vehicle again or…

items.name: diag_scope
items.summary: Returns script scope depth. When script is directly executed by the engine or a new script is added to the scheduler, the scope depth is 0. The examples of such execution are event handlers, spawn, etc.

items.name: diag_setLightNew
items.summary: Overrides currently used scene lighting. The operand is config that is placed as a string (not file). The changes may not be applied immediately, but can be forced by the call of simulWeatherSync.

items.name: diag_setTerrainHeight
items.summary: Changes the terrain height of the cell in which given position lies. This command is only available with Arma 3: Diagnostics Exe.

items.name: diag_SQFCDebugDump
items.summary: Dumps the bytecode as Arma 3 sees it, in a diff friendly way. Useful for testing custom SQFC compilers.

items.name: diag_stacktrace
items.summary: Returns an array containing the function name, line number, scope name and all local variables in form of a hashmap.

items.name: diag_testScriptSimpleVM
items.summary: Outputs the provided SQF code's end code.

items.name: diag_tickTime
items.summary: Real time in seconds spent from the start of the game. On Windows the command uses timeGetTime.

items.name: diag_toggle
items.summary: Toggles various diagnostics.

items.name: dialog
items.summary: Tests whether any user dialog is open.

items.name: diaryRecordNull
items.summary: A non-existent Diary Record. To compare non-existent objects use isNull or isEqualTo:

items.name: diarySubjectExists
items.summary: Checks whether given subject is present in the Diary of given player.

items.name: didJIP
items.summary: Checks if the current client Joined In Progress.

items.name: didJIPOwner
items.summary: Checks if the current owner of supplied Object Joined In Progress. Returns false on clients.

items.name: difficulty
items.summary: Returns high-level selected difficulty mode.

items.name: difficultyEnabled
items.summary: Checks specific difficulty settings of the current user. Difficulty flag names can be found in the ArmA profile file under class Difficulties/xxx/Flags (xxx being regular or veteran).

items.name: difficultyEnabledRTD
items.summary: Returns true if Advanced Flight Model is enabled. Forcing of rotorlib simulation could be done with mission param forceRotorLibSimulation.

items.name: difficultyOption
items.summary: Checks specific difficulty settings of the current user. Difficulty flag names can be found in the `CfgDifficultyPresets` config class or in ArmA profile file under class `DifficultyPresets/xxx/Options` (xxx being…

items.name: direction
items.summary: Returns the direction an object or a location is facing (differs from getDir in that this also works with locations).

items.name: directionStabilizationEnabled
items.summary: Get state of direction stabilization. This command returns true if the current optic mode of the selected turret has direction stabilization configured in config (`directionStabilized`) and if it is also not disabled by…

items.name: directSay
items.summary: Sends given audio message to the direct channel. Command operates just like xxxxRadio commands, but the sound is played over direct channel and is independent of fadeSound.

items.name: disableAI
items.summary: Disables parts of the AI behaviour to get a better control over the actions of a unit. If the unit changes locality, this command might need to be executed again at the new locality to maintain effect.

items.name: disableBrakes
items.summary: Disables autobrake, which is engaged when vehicle is stationary and stops wheels from rotating freely when vehicle is pushed.

items.name: disableCollisionWith
items.summary: Disable collision between provided objects. The collision is always disabled for both objects in the arguments.

items.name: disableConversation
items.summary: In theory disables the ability to talk to other people. In actuality, if true is given, the command increases unit's kbTell *IsSpeaking* status by 1, thus stopping unit from having a conversation.

items.name: disableDebriefingStats
items.summary: Disable debriefing score table.

items.name: disableMapIndicators
items.summary: Command allows suppressing visualization of FRIENDLY, ENEMY, MINES and/or PING map indicators from difficulty setting EXTENDED MAP CONTENT.

items.name: disableNVGEquipment
items.summary: Enables or disables transport NV (Night Vision). To disable TI (Thermal Imaging) use disableTIEquipment.

items.name: disableRemoteSensors
items.summary: This command will halt raycasting calculations (on the local machine only) for all groups which don't contain *any* local entities.

items.name: disableSerialization
items.summary: Disable saving of script containing this command. After this, the script can work with data types which do not support serialization (UI types).

items.name: disableTIEquipment
items.summary: Disables TI (Thermal Imaging) equipment for given vehicle.

items.name: disableUAVConnectability
items.summary: Disables unit's AV terminal(s) connecting to UAV.

items.name: disableUserInput
items.summary: Disables or enables the keyboard and mouse input. Usually used during cutscenes.

items.name: displayAddEventHandler
items.summary: Adds an event handler to the given display. See User Interface Event Handlers for the full list of event names.

items.name: displayChild
items.summary: Returns child display of the given display.

items.name: displayCtrl
items.summary: Return child control with specified idc.

items.name: displayNull
items.summary: A non-existing Display. To compare non-existent displays use isNull or isEqualTo:

items.name: displayParent
items.summary: Returns parent display of the given display.

items.name: displayRemoveAllEventHandlers
items.summary: Remove all event handlers from the given display.

items.name: displayRemoveEventHandler
items.summary: Remove a given event handler from the given display.

items.name: displaySetEventHandler
items.summary: Sets given event handler of given display. The return code of the provided function should indicate whether this event was handled correctly.

items.name: displayUniqueName
items.summary: Get the provided display's UI On Texture unique name.

items.name: displayUpdate
items.summary: Set the provided display to update its UI On Texture render.

items.name: dissolveTeam
items.summary: Dissolves the given team. All members become members of the main team.

items.name: distance
items.summary: Returns a distance in meters between Objects, Positions or Locations.

items.name: distance2D
items.summary: Returns a 2D distance (distance projected to X,Y plane) in meters between Objects and/or Positions.

items.name: distanceSqr
items.summary: Computes the squared distance between two objects or positions. This command is faster than distance by saving a square root operation, useful for mass-checking distance without the need of the distance value itself.

items.name: distributionRegion
items.summary: Returns the numerical index for the distribution region of this copy of Armed Assault. 1. USA 1. Rest of the world

items.name: do
items.summary: Executes *code*. Used as part of a construct, such as while, with, for and switch. The *code* is always executed in missionNamespace unless do is used with with as an argument.

items.name: do3DENAction
items.summary: Performs given Eden Editor action.

items.name: doArtilleryFire
items.summary: Orders an artillery unit to fire a burst on the given position (silently).

items.name: doFire
items.summary: Order the given unit(s) to fire on the given target (without radio messages).

items.name: doFollow
items.summary: Order the given unit(s) to follow another from his own group as his formation leader (without radio messages).

items.name: doFSM
items.summary: Orders a unit to process command defined by FSM file (silently).

items.name: doGetOut
items.summary: Orders one or multiple units to get out from the vehicle (silently). Same as commandGetOut with latter being shown via radio chat.

items.name: doMove
items.summary: Order the given unit(s) to move to the given position (without radio messages). Upon reaching its destination, if it is the group leader it will order the group to form around it's new position.

items.name: doorPhase
items.summary: Return animation phase of door on vehicle.

items.name: doStop
items.summary: Order the given unit(s) to stop (without radio messages). The units stopped in this way will leave the groups formation.

items.name: doSuppressiveFire
items.summary: Orders the given unit or a group of units to suppress the given position or target (without radio messages, see commandSuppressiveFire is you need messages).

items.name: doTarget
items.summary: Order the given unit(s) to target the given target (without radio messages). Targeting can be stopped by

items.name: doWatch
items.summary: Order the given unit(s) to watch the given position or target (without radio messages). Use objNull as the target to order a unit to stop watching a position/target.

items.name: drawArrow
items.summary: Draws a single line arrow on the map. As this command needs to be called every frame, it is preferable using the onDraw UI Event Handler. To draw a color filled arrow of custom shape see BIS_fnc_drawArrow.

items.name: drawEllipse
syntax: map drawEllipse [centre, a, b, angle, color, fill, alignWithMap]
items.summary: Draws an ellipse on the map. Just like with marker or trigger area, negative *a* and *b* will result in hexagon.

items.name: drawIcon
syntax: map drawIcon [texture, color, position, width, height, angle, text, shadow, textSize, font, align]
items.summary: Draws an icon on the map. As this command needs to be called every frame, it is preferable using the onDraw UI Event Handler.

items.name: drawIcon3D
syntax: drawIcon3D [texture, color, position, width, height, angle, text, shadow, textSize, font, textAlign, drawSideArrows, offsetX, offsetY]
items.summary: Draws an icon at the given position in the game world. This command has to be executed every frame. Use the Draw3D Mission Event Handler (which is executed every frame if the user can see the icon).

items.name: drawLaser
syntax: drawLaser [position, direction, beamColor, dotColor, dotSize, beamThickness, beamMaxLength, isIR]
items.summary: Draws a laserbeam and a lightpoint at the impact location of the laser.

items.name: drawLine
items.summary: Draw a line on the map. Can decrease framerate!

items.name: drawLine3D
items.summary: Draws a line of a given colour between two 3D positions in the current frame. To be used mostly in a "Draw3D" mission event handler.

items.name: drawLink
items.summary: The editor will draw a line between the two specified editor objects. Line type can be LINE or ARROW.

items.name: drawLocation
items.summary: Used to draw locations in 2D Editor.

items.name: drawPolygon
items.summary: Draws given polygon on the given map control with given color. The polygon must consist of at least 3 points.

items.name: drawRectangle
syntax: map drawRectangle [centre, halfWidth, halfHeight, angle, color, fill, alignWithMap]
items.summary: Draws a rectangle on the map.

items.name: drawTriangle
items.summary: Draws one to multiple triangles on the map.

items.name: drawXPolygon
syntax: map drawXPolygon [n, centre, a, b, angle, color, fill, alignWithMap]
items.summary: Draws an N sided polygon on the map.

items.name: driver
items.summary: Returns the driver of a vehicle.

items.name: drop
items.summary: Creates a particle effect. This command is used to create smoke, fire and similar effects. The particles are single polygons with single textures that always face the player.

items.name: dynamicSimulationDistance
items.summary: A getter for setDynamicSimulationDistance.

items.name: dynamicSimulationDistanceCoef
items.summary: A getter for setDynamicSimulationDistanceCoef

items.name: dynamicSimulationEnabled
items.summary: A getter for enableDynamicSimulation.

items.name: dynamicSimulationSystemEnabled
items.summary: A getter for enableDynamicSimulationSystem

items.name: east
items.summary: Pre-defined variable for the eastern side.

items.name: echo
items.summary: Sends any text into the debugger console or the logfile. This command is only present in internal version not in the retail version. Use diag_log instead!

items.name: edit3DENMissionAttributes
items.summary: Open a window with scenario attribute in given section.

items.name: editObject
items.summary: Show the edit object dialog for the given object.

items.name: editorSetEventHandler
items.summary: Sets given event handler of given editor.

items.name: effectiveCommander
items.summary: Returns the effective commander of the vehicle. Effective commander is the player whom driver AI will listen to.

items.name: elevatePeriscope
items.summary: Elevates periscope of a vehicle. Vehicles in Arma 3 which are compatible with this tech are Strider, remote laser designators, the robot arm on Eddie, etc.

items.name: else
items.summary: Executes else code when if condition returns false.

items.name: emptyPositions
items.summary: Returns the number of given empty positions in the vehicle.

items.name: enableAI
items.summary: Enables parts of the AI behavior that was disabled by disableAI.

items.name: enableAIFeature
items.summary: Enables/disables given AI feature.

items.name: enableAimPrecision
items.summary: Set whether animation's aim precision affects weapon sway.

items.name: enableAttack
items.summary: Set if leader can issue attack commands to the soldiers in his group.

items.name: enableAudioFeature
items.summary: Get the state of or enable/disable an audio feature. Available features are `"lowpass"` and `"building_interior"`. - Arma 3 v2.14 it is possible to enable `"building_interior"` on an object placed in a building.

items.name: enableAutoStartUpRTD
items.summary: Toggle availability of the automated helicopter start-up and shutdown sequences.

items.name: enableAutoTrimRTD
items.summary: Toggle auto-trim for RTD helicopters.

items.name: enableCamShake
items.summary: Allows camera shake effects via addCamShake. If set to false, then a currently active shake effect will stop immediately.

items.name: enableCaustics
items.summary: Enable/disable caustics drawing.

items.name: enableChannel
items.summary: Enables/disables UI functionality which is responsible for sending text or voice chat to the given chat channel.

items.name: enableCollisionWith
items.summary: Cancels the effects of disableCollisionWith. The collision is always enabled for both objects in the arguments, i.e. vehicle1 with vehicle2 and vehicle2 with vehicle1

items.name: enableCopilot
items.summary: Enables copilot actions, toggles availability of the actions related to copilots, such as taking over controls, suspending controls, etc. This command triggers the `"ControlsShifted"` event handler.

items.name: enableDebriefingStats
items.summary: Enable debriefing score table.

items.name: enableDiagLegend
items.summary: Enable or disable the legend for diagnostics. Internal dev only!

items.name: enableDirectionStabilization
items.summary: Enables / disables direction stabilization of turrets. This command only has an effect if the current optic mode of the selected turret has `directionStabilized` configured in config.

items.name: enableDynamicSimulation
items.summary: Enables or disables Arma 3: Dynamic Simulation for an object or group.

items.name: enableDynamicSimulationSystem
items.summary: Enables or disables the whole Arma 3: Dynamic Simulation system

items.name: enableEndDialog
items.summary: Enables the execution of a custom camera sequence after the players death, coded in onPlayerKilled.sqs.

items.name: enableEngineArtillery
items.summary: Enable/disable the artillery engine. This allows the user to use the artillery computer on mortar/artillery, and for AI to use it for indirect fire.

items.name: enableEnvironment
items.summary: Enable/disable environmental effects: ambient life and/or ambient sound.

items.name: enableFatigue
items.summary: Enables/Disables the person's fatigue.

items.name: enableFreeLook
items.summary: Enables or disables the freelook toggle (2x Alt)

items.name: enableGunLights
items.summary: Toggles the target group's gun lights. disableAI "LIGHTS" will disable the use of gun lights.

items.name: enableGunStabilization
items.summary: Enables/disables turret gun stabilisation.

items.name: enableInfoPanelComponent
items.summary: Controls availability of component to given object info panel.

items.name: enableIRLasers
items.summary: Allows the AI to use IR lasers. Units should be in "Combat" behaviour.

items.name: enableMimics
items.summary: Enables/disables mimics on a given unit.

items.name: enablePersonTurret
items.summary: Enables or disables firing from a vehicle cargo position. To get the turret path use assignedVehicleRole or getCargoIndex command.

items.name: enableRadio
items.summary: Enable and disable radio messages to be heard and shown in the left lower corner of the screen - the order-giving unit can still be heard direct-talking when in its vicinity. The AI will still follow orders.

items.name: enableReload
items.summary: Enable / disable auto-reload (including AI) when magazine is empty. Default - enabled.

items.name: enableRopeAttach
items.summary: Enables or disables the ability to be attached to a rope end for the given entity.

items.name: enableSatNormalOnDetail
items.summary: Enables/Disables satellite normal map or detail maps.

items.name: enableSaving
items.summary: Enable / disable saving of the game with an optional autosave.

items.name: enableSentences
items.summary: Enables radio transmissions to be heard and seen on screen. It does not affect KBTell conversations.

items.name: enableSimulation
items.summary: Enables / disables simulation for the given entity, e.g its animation and physics; it will still be able to take damage and report enemies. This command will affect entity simulation only locally.

items.name: enableSimulationGlobal
items.summary: Enable or disable simulation for given entity, globally. Has the same effect as enableSimulation when used in singleplayer.

items.name: enableStamina
items.summary: Enable/disable stamina system

items.name: enableStressDamage
items.summary: Toggles stress damage in Advanced Flight Model, which otherwise could be manually toggles in game setting: `Options > Game > Helicopter Flight Model > Advanced > Stress Damage`.

items.name: enableTeamSwitch
items.summary: Enable / disable Team Switch. The default setting is enabled.

items.name: enableTraffic
items.summary: Enable ambient traffic.

items.name: enableUAVConnectability
items.summary: Enables unit's AV terminal(s) connecting to UAV.

items.name: enableUAVWaypoints
items.summary: Enables/disables the option for player to set waypoints for UAV in AV terminal.

items.name: enableVehicleCargo
items.summary: Enable/disable option to transport other vehicles (if configured) or be transported.

items.name: enableVehicleSensor
items.summary: Enable/disable given sensor

items.name: enableWeaponDisassembly
items.summary: Enables or disables disassembly of static weapons. Could be applied to local player, to another unit or to static weapon directly.

items.name: endl
items.summary: Creates a string containing a line break, similar to lineBreak for text. The name is inspired by c++ std::endl (end line). The command returns `"\r\n"`, which contains control characters rather than printable characters:

items.name: endLoadingScreen
items.summary: Finishes loading screen started by startLoadingScreen.

items.name: endMission
items.summary: Finish the mission. Mission saves are deleted. Use failMission if they should not be.

items.name: engineOn
items.summary: Activates and deactivates the engine of a vehicle.

items.name: enginesIsOnRTD
items.summary: Returns which engines are producing some work.

items.name: enginesPowerRTD
items.summary: Returns power produced by engines in Watts.

items.name: enginesRpmRTD
items.summary: Returns all engines RPM.

items.name: enginesTorqueRTD
items.summary: Torque produced by engines in N·m (Newton × meter).

items.name: entities
items.summary: Returns a list of all alive and dead entities of the given type or deriving from the given type. Units in vehicles are ignored with the primary syntax.

items.name: environmentEnabled
items.summary: Returns status of enableEnvironment command

items.name: environmentVolume
items.summary: Returns the current environment volume (set by fadeEnvironment)

items.name: equipmentDisabled
items.summary: Returns current state for NVG and TI equipment availability.

items.name: estimatedEndServerTime
items.summary: Estimated end of MP game in seconds converted to serverTime.

items.name: estimatedTimeLeft
items.summary: Sets the estimated time left in the game that is shown in the "Game in progress" screen or in the master browser.

items.name: evalObjectArgument
items.summary: Return argument in mission editor of a given object.

items.name: everyBackpack
items.summary: Returns array of backpacks stored in given crate or vehicle. Used for accessing backpack content of a backpack on ground.

items.name: everyContainer
items.summary: Returns array of all containers (uniforms, vests, backpacks) stored in given crate or vehicle. Used for accessing containers content stored in ammo box or ground holder.

items.name: exec
items.summary: Execute a script using (the deprecated but still available) SQS Syntax. SQF Syntax (and execVM) is the most recent scripting language.

items.name: execEditorScript
items.summary: Execute an editor script for the specified object.

items.name: execFSM
items.summary: Execute scripted FSM and return the FSM handle or 0 when failed. The FSM file is first searched in the mission folder, then in the campaign scripts folder and finally in the global scripts folder.

items.name: execVM
items.summary: Compiles and adds an SQF script to the scheduler queue and returns script handle (see also #Example 4).

items.name: exit
items.summary: Stops the execution of a SQS script.

items.name: exitWith
items.summary: Exits the current code scope. Often used for exiting do, for, count, forEach or the whole script.

items.name: exp
items.summary: Exponential function with the base e). Equal to `e^x`.

items.name: expectedDestination
items.summary: Return expected destination of unit as an array.

items.name: exportJIPMessages
items.summary: Creates a log file containing an overview on all JIP (network) messages currently in the JIP queue. The file is created in the same directory as .rpt file.

items.name: exportLandscapeXYZ
items.summary: Exports landscape as XYZ file.

items.name: eyeDirection
items.summary: Returns the direction object is watching (eyes, or a vehicle's primary observer).

items.name: eyePos
items.summary: Returns the object's eyes / main turret position.

items.name: face
items.summary: Returns the face class of a person as it is written in 'CfgFaces'.

items.name: faction
items.summary: Gets unit faction. Factions were introduced in Arma 2 and are defined under *CfgFactionClasses*.

items.name: fadeEnvironment
items.summary: Changes the master environment volume smoothly within the given time and is different from enableEnvironment global mute option. The default volume is 1.

items.name: fadeMusic
items.summary: Changes the current music volume to the given value smoothly within the given time.

items.name: fadeRadio
items.summary: Changes the radio volume smoothly within the given time.

items.name: fadeSound
items.summary: Changes the sound volume smoothly within the given time.

items.name: fadeSpeech
items.summary: Changes the master speech volume smoothly within the given time. The default volume is 1.0.

items.name: failMission
items.summary: Finish the mission. If the server is set to run persistent mission, failMission will not end the mission when last player gets kicked to the lobby. Use endMission to end the mission.

items.name: false
items.summary: Always false.

items.name: fileExists
items.summary: Checks if file on given path exists. Uses same path resolve code as loadFile.

items.name: fillWeaponsFromPool
items.summary: Adds magazines from the campaign pool to the given unit, depending on his weapons. Available in campaigns only.

items.name: find
items.summary: Searches for an array element within an array or an ANSI string within an ANSI string.

items.name: findAny
items.summary: Returns the zero-based index of the first element in array A that also exists in array B. If no common elements exist it returns -1.

items.name: findCover
syntax: object findCover [position, hidePosition, maxDist, minDist, visibilityPosition, ignoreObject]
items.summary: Returns the object around where the unit finds cover. The minDist, visibilityPosition and ignoreObject parameters are optional.

items.name: findDisplay
items.summary: Finds a display by its IDD which can either be defined in missionConfigFile (description.ext) or configFile (config.cpp) or by its UI On Texture's unique name (see displayUniqueName).

items.name: findEditorObject
items.summary: Return object that matches the provided reference.

items.name: findEmptyPosition
items.summary: Searches for an empty area around the specified position, starting from the *center* looking for an empty *areaRadius* and looks as far away as *areaRadius* + *maxDistance*.

items.name: findEmptyPositionReady
items.summary: Preloads area to be used with findEmptyPosition command and returns true when area is ready. The size of the area preloaded is from `center - radius - maxDistance` to `center + radius + maxDistance`

items.name: findIf
items.summary: Searches for an element within array for which the code evaluates to true. Returns the zero-based index on success or -1 if not found.

items.name: findNearestEnemy
items.summary: Finds the nearest enemy to the specified position. Returns a null object if the object's group does not know about any enemies. This command will return nearest object that is known to the unit and is considered enemy.

items.name: finishMissionInit
items.summary: Finish world initialisation before mission is launched.

items.name: finite
items.summary: Returns true if the provided number is finite (not infinite and a valid number).

items.name: fire
items.summary: Forces a unit to fire the given weapon.

items.name: fireAtTarget
items.summary: Remotely forces a unit to fire the given weapon. See also BIS_fnc_fire.

items.name: firstBackpack
items.summary: Returns the first stored backpack.

items.name: flag
items.summary: Returns the original flag pole of the flag the unit is carrying.

items.name: flagAnimationPhase
items.summary: Returns flag position on the flag pole.

items.name: flagOwner
items.summary: Returns the global owner of a flag. A getter for setFlagOwner. Note that owner of a flag is Object rather than Number, as how it is usually with other owner commands

items.name: flagSide
items.summary: Returns Side of the local instance of the flag. A getter for setFlagSide.

items.name: flagTexture
items.summary: Returns texture of the local instance of the flag. A getter for setFlagTexture. It will not return flag textures applied using forceFlagTexture, use getForcedFlagTexture for that.

items.name: flatten
items.summary: Flattens an array.

items.name: fleeing
items.summary: Checks if a unit is fleeing.

items.name: floor
items.summary: Returns the next lowest integer in relation to the provided number.

items.name: flyInHeight
items.summary: Sets the flying altitude for aircraft relatively to the ground surface. Avoid too low altitudes, as helicopters and planes won't evade trees and obstacles on the ground. The default flying altitude is 100 meters.

items.name: flyInHeightASL
items.summary: Sets the minimal ASL height. Final height is `*flyInHeight* max *flyInHeightASL*` - the higher altitude has priority.

items.name: focusedCtrl
items.summary: Returns display's focused control.

items.name: focusOn
items.summary: Returns the person the camera is focused on. If you need the vehicle, see cameraOn.

items.name: fog
items.summary: A getter for setFog. Returns the current value of the fog in range 0..1.

items.name: fogForecast
items.summary: Returns the forecast fog value. A value of 0 means no fog, 1 means maximum fog.

items.name: fogParams
items.summary: A getter for setFog (Alt Syntax). Returns extended params for the fog

items.name: for
items.summary: This operator creates a For Type which is used in the for-constructs.

items.name: forceAddUniform
items.summary: Create a new uniform and hard link it into slot (without any restrictions).

items.name: forceAtPositionRTD
items.summary: Adds force generator to world.

items.name: forceCadetDifficulty
items.summary: Forces `showCadetHints` and `showCadetWP` global Cadet Arma 3 difficulty, returns previous settings.

items.name: forcedMap
items.summary: Returns if map was forced by using forceMap command or openMap command with force option

items.name: forceEnd
items.summary: Forces mission ending (set with endMission) even if a camera effect or any another condition delays the endMission (mostly in Operation Flashpoint).

items.name: forceFlagTexture
items.summary: Forces a flag texture onto a flag carrier (unit, vehicle or flag pole). No flag holder is required. If `""` is used as texture, the texture is removed. This will override regularly owned flags.

items.name: forceFollowRoad
items.summary: Forces the vehicle to stay on road.

items.name: forceGeneratorRTD
items.summary: Adds force generator to world.

items.name: forceHitPointsDamageSync
items.summary: Synchronises hitpoints values and total damage across current network clients as well as JIP.

items.name: forceMap
items.summary: Opens non-interactive main map in background that overrides user screen. To force open interactive map use openMap command.

items.name: forceRespawn
items.summary: Forces the unit to respawn. The effect is as if the player pressed the RESPAWN button in the game pause menu; the unit is killed but there is no "X was killed" message and no score adjustment.

items.name: forceSpeed
items.summary: Force the speed limit on given object (object will never attempt to move faster than given by forceSpeed). Use negative value to return to default behaviour.

items.name: forceUnicode
items.summary: List of the commands that work with forceUnicode - copyFromClipboard - copyToClipboard - count - find - in - insert - reverse - select - splitString - trim - regexFind - regexMatch - regexReplace

items.name: forceWalk
items.summary: Forces unit to walk even if run or sprint is selected.

items.name: forceWeaponFire
items.summary: The unit will be forced to fire weapon from the given muzzle. The weapon will not fire if firemode passed as parameter is not supported by the given muzzle.

items.name: forceWeatherChange
items.summary: Forcibly applies previously set weather settings. Skips smooth transitions. This might cause lag.

items.name: forEach
items.summary: Executes the given command(s) on every item of an Array or a HashMap.

items.name: forEachMember
items.summary: Executes the given command recursively for both teams and agents that are members of the given team. For teams only use forEachMemberTeam. For agents only use forEachMemberAgent.

items.name: forEachMemberAgent
items.summary: Executes the given command recursively for each agent that is a member of the given team. For just teams use forEachMemberTeam. For both teams and agents use forEachMember.

items.name: forEachMemberTeam
items.summary: Executes the given command recursively for each team that is a member of the given team. For just agents use forEachMemberAgent. For both teams and agents use forEachMember.

items.name: forEachReversed
items.summary: Executes the given command(s) on every item of an Array in reversed order, compared to forEach.

items.name: forgetTarget
items.summary: Resets the info a group has about a target, forcing knowsAbout value to 0.

items.name: format
items.summary: Composes a string containing other variables or other variable types. Converts any variable type to a string.

items.name: formation
items.summary: Returns the current formation of a group.

items.name: formationDirection
items.summary: Return the direction in degrees of the 'unit' watching in formation.

items.name: formationLeader
items.summary: Return leader of the formation.

items.name: formationMembers
items.summary: Return list of units (drivers) in the formation.

items.name: formationPosition
items.summary: Return position of unit in the formation.

items.name: formationTask
items.summary: Return the current task of the unit in the formation.

items.name: formatText
items.summary: Creates a Structured Text similar to format command.

items.name: formLeader
items.summary: Returns the formation leader of a given unit. This is often the same as the group leader, but not always, for example in cases when a unit is ordered to follow another unit.

items.name: freeExtension
items.summary: Unloads given extension loaded previously with callExtension so that extension developer could rapidly tweak developed extension without restarting the game.

items.name: freeLook
items.summary: Returns if freelook is active on the current machine's controlled character.

items.name: from
items.summary: Continue sequence of for construct. It sets the start value of the index variable.

items.name: fromEditor
items.summary: Return if given team was inserted directly from mission editor.

items.name: fromJSON
items.summary: Obtain the game value from the provided JSON-formatted string.

items.name: fuel
items.summary: Checks how much fuel is left in the gas tank of a vehicle.

items.name: fullCrew
items.summary: Returns an array with all crew inside given vehicle, with or without empty seats.

items.name: gearIDCAmmoCount
items.summary: Returns ammo count of assigned magazine.

items.name: gearSlotAmmoCount
items.summary: Returns ammo count of assigned magazine.

items.name: gearSlotData
items.summary: Returns gear slot item name.

items.name: gestureState
items.summary: Returns the name of a unit's current gesture. Seems to be forced to lower case in Arma 3.

items.name: get
items.summary: Retrieves a value out of a HashMap after looking it up by its key.

items.name: get3DENActionState
items.summary: Returns state of given Eden Editor action.

items.name: get3DENAttribute
items.summary: Returns the value of the given entity's attribute in Eden Editor.

items.name: get3DENAttributes
items.summary: Retrieve all attributes and their values of the specified (optional) category.

items.name: get3DENCamera
items.summary: Returns the camera Object used by the Eden Editor.

items.name: get3DENConnections
items.summary: Returns all connections currently present on an entity.

items.name: get3DENEntity
items.summary: Returns Eden Entity based on its Eden ID.

items.name: get3DENEntityID
items.summary: Returns unique index of an Eden Entity. This number remains the same even after saving and loading the scenario. ´

items.name: get3DENGrid
items.summary: Returns the grid increment for the given transformation type.

items.name: get3DENIconsVisible
items.summary: Gets visibility state of Eden Editor icons.

items.name: get3DENLayer
items.summary: Returns the provided entity's layer ID.

items.name: get3DENLayerEntities
items.summary: Return all entities and sub-layer in Eden Entity layer. In order to get all layer entities during a scenario use getMissionLayerEntities.

items.name: get3DENLinesVisible
items.summary: Get visibility state of Eden Editor lines.

items.name: get3DENMissionAttribute
items.summary: Return value of scenario attribute. For a list of all available mission attributes see Mission Attributes.

items.name: get3DENMissionAttributes
items.summary: Retrieve all attributes and their values from the specified section/category (category is optional).

items.name: get3DENMouseOver
items.summary: Returns the Eden Entity the mouse is hovering over in Eden Editor.

items.name: get3DENParent
items.summary: Obtains the provided entity's parent.

items.name: get3DENSelected
items.summary: Returns an array of all selected Eden Editor Entities of the given type.

items.name: getAimDirectionAndUp
items.summary: Returns the aim direction and up vectors of a soldier in model space. It returns where the weapon aim is wanted from the eyePos, not the actual weapon direction. For actual weapon direction, see weaponDirection.

items.name: getAimingCoef
items.summary: Get current aiming coefficient (higher ~ less precise, default is 1)

items.name: getAllEnv3DSoundControllers
items.summary: Returns an array containing the names and values of environmental 3D sound controllers, variables that can be used in simple expressions when configuring sounds.

items.name: getAllEnvSoundControllers
items.summary: Returns an array containing the names and values of environmental 2D sound controllers, variables that can be used in simple expressions when configuring sounds.

items.name: getAllHitPointsDamage
items.summary: Get provided object's hit points damage.

items.name: getAllOwnedMines
items.summary: Gets all mine objects this unit has ownership over.

items.name: getAllPylonsInfo
items.summary: Return an array with the vehicle's all pylons info.

items.name: getAllSoundControllers
items.summary: Returns an array containing names and values of the sound controllers that can be used in simple expressions when configuring sounds.

items.name: getAllUnitTraits
items.summary: Returns unit traits (native or set by setUnitTrait).

items.name: getAmmoCargo
items.summary: Returns the amount (1 is full) of ammo resources in the cargo space of a rearm vehicle.

items.name: getAnimAimPrecision
items.summary: Returns aim precision for current animation

items.name: getAnimationsQueue
items.summary: Returns the primary and secondary animations queue of the entity. The primary queue contains the full motion path from current animation (animationState) to a target animation, while the secondary queue contains…

items.name: getAnimSpeedCoef
items.summary: Get coefficient for animation speed.

items.name: getArray
items.summary: Extract array from config entry.

items.name: getArtilleryAmmo
items.summary: Get list of all available magazines of artillery units on the list. Command returns only unique magazine types and doesn't contain any information about which unit has which magazine.

items.name: getArtilleryComputerSettings
items.summary: Returns settings from current vehicle weapon manned by player.

items.name: getArtilleryETA
items.summary: Returns ETA to the target in seconds for given artillery unit based on target position and used magazine, -1 if target can't be hit.

items.name: getAssetDLCInfo
items.summary: Returns DLC information about given object or model.

items.name: getAssignedCuratorLogic
items.summary: Returns curator logic to which given player has access.

items.name: getAssignedCuratorUnit
items.summary: Returns unit assigned to curator logic.

items.name: getAttackTarget
items.summary: Returns the target given unit is engaging.

items.name: getAudioOptionVolumes
items.summary: Returns profile audio volumes.

items.name: getBackpackCargo
items.summary: Returns all backpack types and count from the cargo space.

items.name: getBleedingRemaining
items.summary: Returns how many seconds injured unit will continue leaving blood trail. If unit damage is < 0.1, the return value is 0 and unit doesn't leave any blood trail. Use setBleedingRemaining to set different remaining time.

items.name: getBoneNames
items.summary: Returns an array of bone names and their parents.

items.name: getBurningValue
items.summary: Returns how much the unit is exposed to fire damage.

items.name: getCalculatePlayerVisibilityByFriendly
items.summary: Returns true if visibility of player by friendly units is calculated.

items.name: getCameraViewDirection
items.summary: Returns the direction unit is looking in render time scope. While for AI the origin for the view direction vector can be taken from `eyePos unit`, for human player the origin should be taken from player camera position…

items.name: getCargoIndex
items.summary: Returns index of the unit in cargo. -1 if not in cargo.

items.name: getCenterOfMass
items.summary: Returns center of mass of an object.

items.name: getClientState
items.summary: Returns client state in network game. Works on both, client and dedicated server. The following states are possible:

items.name: getClientStateNumber
items.summary: Returns client state in network game. Works on both, client and dedicated server. The following states are possible:

items.name: getCompatiblePylonMagazines
items.summary: Get array of compatible pylon magazines

items.name: getConnectedUAV
items.summary: Returns UAV/UGV vehicle if person has connection to some UAV. To return the AI unit which player controls, see getConnectedUAVUnit.

items.name: getConnectedUAVUnit
items.summary: Returns UAV/UGV AI unit, which player is controlling. To return UAV vehicle, see getConnectedUAV

items.name: getContainerMaxLoad
items.summary: Returns max load value of given uniform, vest or backpack container. For other types of containers, use maxLoad command

items.name: getCorpse
items.summary: Returns the corpse associated with given weaponholder. When unit is killed and had a weapon, the weapon is placed inside "WeaponHolderSimulated" and dropped together with the unit.

items.name: getCorpseWeaponholders
items.summary: Returns primary and secondary weapon holders of a dead unit. If a unit had weapons at the moment of death, primary weapon is dropped into primary weaponholder and secondary weapon is dropped into secondary.

items.name: getCruiseControl
items.summary: Returns cruise control settings set with setCruiseControl command.

items.name: getCursorObjectParams
items.summary: Returns object and named selections under cursor and distance to object's surface (to the point cursor points at).

items.name: getCustomAimCoef
items.summary: Returns aimPrecision from animation state with custom value that will directly affects weapon sway size and speed.

items.name: getCustomSoundController
items.summary: Returns current value set to the controller (see setCustomSoundController).

items.name: getCustomSoundControllerCount
items.summary: Returns current number of custom sound controllers supported by the engine for the given vehicle (currently 32)

items.name: getDammage
items.summary: Returns the object damage.

items.name: getDebriefingText
items.summary: A getter for setDebriefingText.

items.name: getDescription
items.summary: Returns the string representation of unit as an four slots array.

items.name: getDir
items.summary: Returns the object heading in the range 0..360.

items.name: getDirVisual
items.summary: Returns object's heading in the range from 0 to 360 in render time scope.

items.name: getDiverState
items.summary: Returns true when object is in diver state - e.g when the unit would put diving goggles on.

items.name: getDLCAssetsUsage
items.summary: Returns an array of the DLC usage times.

items.name: getDLCAssetsUsageByName
items.summary: Returns an array with the session and global time the asset has been used.

items.name: getDLCs
items.summary: Returns array of app IDs of DLCs.

items.name: getDLCUsageTime
items.summary: Returns total time the assets of the given DLC have been used. See Arma 3 DLCs & Expansions for a list of DLCs and ids.

items.name: getEditorCamera
items.summary: Fetches a reference to the mission editor camera.

items.name: getEditorMode
items.summary: Returns the current mode of the editor.

items.name: getEditorObjectScope
items.summary: Returns the editor object scope of the specified editor object.

items.name: getElevationOffset
items.summary: Returns the map elevation offset from [map]/config.cpp.

items.name: getEngineTargetRPMRTD
items.summary: Returns RPM of all engines.

items.name: getEntityInfo
items.summary: Returns various properties for the given entity. Most properties should be checked where entity is local

items.name: getEnv3DSoundController
items.summary: Returns value of the specified 3D controller, see getAllEnv3DSoundControllers.

items.name: getEnvSoundController
items.summary: Returns value of the specified controller, see getAllEnvSoundControllers

items.name: getEventHandlerInfo
items.summary: Queries given event handler's information.

items.name: getFatigue
items.summary: Returns fatigue of given unit.

items.name: getFieldManualStartPage
items.summary: Returns array of the starting topic and hint the given field manual should display.

items.name: getForcedFlagTexture
items.summary: A getter for forceFlagTexture. Forced texture is different from your normal flag texture, which can be retrieved with flagTexture

items.name: getForcedSpeed
items.summary: Returns forced speed set with forceSpeed or -1 if not set.

items.name: getFriend
items.summary: Returns if sides are friendly or hostile. For a value smaller than 0.6 it results in being enemy, otherwise it is friendly. See also Side Relations.

items.name: getFSMVariable
items.summary: Return the value of variable in the variable space of given FSM. The FSM handle is the number returned by the execFSM command.

items.name: getFuelCargo
items.summary: Returns the fuel amount (1 is full) in the cargo space of a refueling vehicle.

items.name: getFuelConsumptionCoef
items.summary: Returns the fuel consumption coefficient, which is a multiplier of the fuel consumption rate in config.

items.name: getGraphValues
syntax: getGraphValues [[graphMinX, graphMaxX, graphMinY, graphMaxY, valueCount, randomOffset], x1, y1, x2, y2, ...]
items.summary: Generate graph y - coordinates of all input values within specific x and y range.

items.name: getGroupIcon
items.summary: Get group icon properties. Since Arma 3 v2.22 command also returns 3d offsets.

items.name: getGroupIconParams
items.summary: Returns group icons params used for command bar drawing such as color, text, scale, visibility, waypoint visibility, waypoint color.

items.name: getGroupIcons
items.summary: Returns all group icons. Since Arma 3 v2.22 command also returns 3d offsets.

items.name: getHideFrom
items.summary: Returns the Position where object believes the enemy to be. If there is no direct line of sight between the object and the enemy, this position is extrapolated based on the last known position and speed of the enemy.

items.name: getHit
items.summary: Returns selection damage. Same as getHitPointDamage, only the argument is selection part instead of hit point.

items.name: getHitIndex
items.summary: Return current level of damage for a specific Hit Point (specified by its hit part index). All hit points can be obtained with getAllHitPointsDamage command. - 0: no damage - 1: full damage

items.name: getHitPointDamage
items.summary: Return current level of damage in range 0..1 for a specific Hit Point (specified by its config class). If you need to get damage of a selection instead of hit point, use getHit.

items.name: getItemCargo
items.summary: Returns all items names and count from ammo box (or any general weapon holder container).

items.name: getLeaning
items.summary: Returns the leaning factor of the given unit.

items.name: getLightInfo
items.summary: Returns various properties for the given `1. lightpoint` or `1. lightreflector`. ConePars and VolumeShapePars are exclusive properties of `1. lightreflector` only.

items.name: getLighting
items.summary: Gets general environment's light settings.

items.name: getLightingAt
items.summary: Gets provided object's lighting information.

items.name: getLoadedModsInfo
items.summary: Returns information about all loaded modifications.

items.name: getMagazineCargo
items.summary: Returns all magazines types and count from the cargo space

items.name: getMarkerColor
items.summary: Returns marker color for given marker.

items.name: getMarkerPos
items.summary: Returns marker position.

items.name: getMarkerSize
items.summary: Returns the size of the given marker. A getter for setMarkerSize and an alias of markerSize.

items.name: getMarkerType
items.summary: Gets type of marker. See CfgMarkers for a list of standard markers.

items.name: getMass
items.summary: Returns mass of a PhysX object.

items.name: getMissionConfig
items.summary: Returns Config entry for the given scenario attribute from the 1st tier. The attribute can be config class or config property. If it is defined in multiple places, the command checks them in the following order: 1.

items.name: getMissionConfigValue
items.summary: Returns value of the given scenario attribute from the 1st tier. Since only config properties have values, the attribute should be config property. If it is not found or config class is given, the return is nil.

items.name: getMissionDLCs
items.summary: Returns list of DLCs that are used in the mission.

items.name: getMissionLayerEntities
items.summary: Returns all entities within the specific Eden Editor layer and its sub-layers. To be used when the scenario is running, not in the editor workspace.

items.name: getMissionLayers
items.summary: Returns a list of all layers created in Eden Editor. Designed to be used during a scenario. Default layers (BLUFOR, OPFOR...) are not returned.

items.name: getMissionOptions
items.summary: Returns various mission options

items.name: getMissionPath
items.summary: Returns mission root plus the filename in a form of filepath to be used with commands requiring absolute path such as playSound3D, drawIcon3D, createSimpleObject, etc.

items.name: getModelInfo
items.summary: Returns object's model info. Model path is suitable for use with createSimpleObject command.

items.name: getMousePosition
items.summary: Returns mouse position in UI coordinates.

items.name: getMusicPlayedTime
items.summary: Returns elapsed time in seconds for currently playing music track.

items.name: getNumber
items.summary: Extract number from config entry.

items.name: getObjectArgument
items.summary: Return name of object argument in mission editor.

items.name: getObjectChildren
items.summary: Return a list of all the children of the specified object.

items.name: getObjectDLC
items.summary: Returns appID of the DLC the object belongs to or nil if object is vanilla.

items.name: getObjectFOV
items.summary: Returns Field of View of the given object in radians. Static objects return default value, which is 1. FOV of objNull is 0.

items.name: getObjectID
items.summary: Returns Visitor ID of the given object. Visitor IDs of static map objects can change if map is in development and updated with new static objects.

items.name: getObjectMaterials
items.summary: Gets all custom materials associated with the object.

items.name: getObjectProxy
items.summary: Return the proxy object associated with the given editor object.

items.name: getObjectScale
items.summary: Returns the render scale of an object relative to the original model.

items.name: getObjectTextures
items.summary: Gets all custom textures (hiddenSelectionsTextures) associated with the object.

items.name: getObjectType
items.summary: Returns object type as a number: - 1 - Primary - Normal object placed in Visitor, part of landscape - 2 - Network - Road placed in Visitor, part of landscape - 4 - Temporary - Temporary object (like tracks) - 8 -…

items.name: getObjectViewDistance
items.summary: Gets the values of rendering distances of objects and shadows.

items.name: getOpticsMode
items.summary: Returns the class name of the current optic mode of the current weapon.

items.name: getOrDefault
items.summary: Retrieves a value out of a HashMap after looking it up by its key. When the HashMap doesn't contain the key, the default value is returned

items.name: getOrDefaultCall
items.summary: Retrieves a value from the HashMap for the given 'key', executes given 'code' if key was not found and returns result. Additionally sets key to the code result value if *set* is true.

items.name: getOxygenRemaining
items.summary: Returns amount of remaining oxygen.

items.name: getPersonUsedDLCs
items.summary: Returns a list of all DLCs objects the unit is currently using. For example if a unit is inside a vehicle from DLC, it will return the code of that DLC.

items.name: getPhysicsCollisionFlag
items.summary: Returns the currently set physics collision flags.

items.name: getPilotCameraDirection
items.summary: Returns model space vector of the object airplane or helicopter pilotCamera .

items.name: getPilotCameraOpticsMode
items.summary: Returns the optics mode index (zoom) for the pilotCamera

items.name: getPilotCameraPosition
items.summary: Returns model space coordinates of the object airplane or helicopter pilotCamera.

items.name: getPilotCameraRotation
items.summary: Returns rotation (relative to the centered camera position) of the object airplane or helicopter pilotCamera .

items.name: getPilotCameraTarget
items.summary: Returns the target of the object airplane or helicopter pilotCamera tracking. Returns `[false, [0,0,0], objNull]` if camera is not in a tracking mode or if object has no pilotCamera.

items.name: getPiPViewDistance
items.summary: Get the set PiP (Picture-in-Picture) view distance (that can be set by setPiPViewDistance).

items.name: getPlateNumber
items.summary: Get the license plates from any vehicle which has plates configured.

items.name: getPlayerChannel
items.summary: Returns channel number for given player, provided that player is SPEAKING, otherwise -1. Having mic on is not enough, player has to make a sound.

items.name: getPlayerID
items.summary: Returns user DirectPlay ID, which can be used with getUserInfo, and is found in allMapMarkers results and in some mission event handlers such as PlayerConnected.

items.name: getPlayerScores
items.summary: Returns the unit's table of scores (infantry kills, soft vehicle kills, armor kills, air kills, deaths, total score) in multiplayer or an empty array in singleplayer.

items.name: getPlayerUID
items.summary: Return a UniqueID of the given unit (player).

items.name: getPlayerVoNVolume
items.summary: Gets provided player's Voice over Network (VoN) volume.

items.name: getPos
items.summary: Returns object or location position. If the argument is an object, the return value is in format PositionAGLS.

items.name: getPosASL
items.summary: Returns the object position height above sea level.

items.name: getPosASLVisual
items.summary: Returns an object's rendered ASL position (z value above sea level) in render time scope.

items.name: getPosASLW
items.summary: Returns the object position height above water surface (waves and pond objects included).

items.name: getPosATL
items.summary: Returns the position of an object relative to the terrain.

items.name: getPosATLVisual
items.summary: Returns an object's rendered ATL position (z value above ground) in render time scope.

items.name: getPosVisual
items.summary: Returns an object's AGLS position in render time scope. Alias of visiblePosition.

items.name: getPosWorld
items.summary: Returns the provided object's model centre position ([0,0,0]) in PositionASL, rather than the transformed boundingCenter or LandContact vertices.

items.name: getPosWorldVisual
items.summary: Returns the provided object's, model centre position in render version in format PositionASL, rather than transformed boundingCenter or LandContact vertices.

items.name: getPylonMagazines
items.summary: Return array of magazines on pylons.

items.name: getRelDir
items.summary: Returns direction, which is relative to object's current direction, from given object to another object or position in the range from 0 to 360, the equivalent of BIS_fnc_relativeDirTo.

items.name: getRelPos
items.summary: Returns position that is given distance and relative direction away from original object. The alternative syntax available from Arma 3 v 2.14, returns the position offset of the attached object.

items.name: getRemoteSensorsDisabled
items.summary: Get status of disabled raycasts for remote entities. See disableRemoteSensors for detailed description.

items.name: getRepairCargo
items.summary: Returns the amount (1 is full) of repair resources in the cargo space of a repair vehicle.

items.name: getResolution
items.summary: Returns an array containing all information about current client screen resolution.

items.name: getRespawnVehicleInfo
items.summary: Returns various properties for the respawning vehicle (see Vehicle Respawn). All properties are synched over the network and should be the same on every client including JIP.

items.name: getRoadInfo
items.summary: Returns road piece information.

items.name: getRotorBrakeRTD
items.summary: Returns if rotor break is on.

items.name: getSelectionBones
items.summary: Returns an array of bone names to which the specified selection is attached.

items.name: getSensorTargets
items.summary: Returns vehicle sensors' potential targets.

items.name: getSensorThreats
items.summary: Returns vehicle sensors' threats.

items.name: getServerInfo
items.summary: Get the current server instance's settings from server config.

items.name: getShadowDistance
items.summary: Gets the shadows rendering distance.

items.name: getShotInfo
items.summary: Returns various properties for the given shot.

items.name: getShotParents
items.summary: Returns shot information for the given projectile. If shot was fired by a soldier on foot or in FFV position in vehicle, the soldier is returned for the vehicle.

items.name: getSlingLoad
items.summary: Return object which is sling loaded by vehicle

items.name: getSlotItemName
items.summary: Returns the name of assigned item in given slot or the empty string.

items.name: getSoundController
items.summary: Returns value of the given sound controller.

items.name: getSoundControllerResult
items.summary: Returns the calculated value of simple expression defined in config. Config could be any config entry, even mission config entry. It is more important that the vehicle is a transport and not any object.

items.name: getSpeed
items.summary: Get the speed for the given speed mode.

items.name: getStamina
items.summary: Get current stamina (~ seconds until depletion)

items.name: getStatValue
items.summary: Returns value of the given stat.

items.name: getSteamFriendsServers
items.summary: Returns servers information of Steam friends currently playing the game.

items.name: getSubtitleOptions
items.summary: Returns subtitles settings.

items.name: getSuppression
items.summary: Gets the suppression value for the given unit. Returns varying Number between 0 and 1, or -1 if suppression is disabled (`disableAI "SUPPRESSION"`) or the suppression value is not available.

items.name: getTerrainGrid
items.summary: A getter for setTerrainGrid, returns the current terrain grid.

items.name: getTerrainHeight
items.summary: Returns terrain height at the specified location.

items.name: getTerrainHeightASL
items.summary: Returns the terrain height above the sea for the given position.

items.name: getTerrainInfo
items.summary: Returns the terrain heightmap information, as well as sea level offset (due to tides, if available).

items.name: getText
items.summary: Extracts localized text from config entry, if entry is subject to localization, otherwise returns text value. To obtain the translation key itself, see getTextRaw.

items.name: getTextRaw
items.summary: Returns raw text from config entry. If entry is subject to localization, the translation key is returned. To obtain the localized text, see getText.

items.name: getTextureInfo
items.summary: Return texture information - resolution in pixels (mipmap level 0) and average colour. Multiply the pixel values by pixelW and pixelH to get screen coordinates.

items.name: getTextWidth
items.summary: Returns estimated width of the text based on font type and size. Similar to ctrlTextWidth but does not require a control and can be used to estimate text width for any control including buttons.

items.name: getTIParameters
