items.summary: Returns all Thermal Imaging parameters.

items.name: getTotalDLCUsageTime
items.summary: Returns total DLC usage time in this game session

items.name: getTowParent
items.summary: Get the vehicle towing the provided one.

items.name: getTrimOffsetRTD
items.summary: Returns controls trim offset.

items.name: getTurretLimits
items.summary: Returns the rotation and elevation limits for the given turret.

items.name: getTurretOpticsMode
items.summary: Get the current optics mode of the optics in the turret occupied by the specified unit. The alternative syntax allows a vehicle and turret path to be specified without needing a unit.

items.name: getUnitFreefallInfo
items.summary: Returns a unit's freefall information.

items.name: getUnitLoadout
items.summary: Returns a Unit Loadout Array with all assigned items, weapons, containers and their stored items.

items.name: getUnitMovesInfo
items.summary: Returns various information about the unit moves (primary animation) and gestures (masked animation)

items.name: getUnitState
items.summary: Returns current state of the given AI unit, which could be one of the following: - "WAIT" - another plan is needed (current partial plan was done or is not present) - "INIT" - operative planing should start, endpoint is…

items.name: getUnitTrait
items.summary: Gets the current value of a trait of the given unit.

items.name: getUnloadInCombat
items.summary: A getter for setUnloadInCombat. To return global config value see canUnloadInCombat

items.name: getUserInfo
items.summary: Returns extended information about given server user.

items.name: getUserMFDText
items.summary: Returns array of user text variables used in MFD.

items.name: getUserMFDValue
items.summary: Returns array of user text variables used in MFD.

items.name: getVariable
items.summary: Returns the value of variable in the variable space assigned to various data types. All available data types combinations:

items.name: getVehicleCargo
items.summary: Get a list of vehicles loaded as cargo inside this vehicle. The returned array is in the order the cargo vehicles were added to containing vehicle.

items.name: getVehicleTIPars
items.summary: Returns TI parameters of a vehicle.

items.name: getVideoOptions
items.summary: Obtain the current system's video settings.

items.name: getWaterFillPercentage
items.summary: Get an object's water filling.

items.name: getWaterLeakiness
items.summary: Get an object's water intake ratio when immersed.

items.name: getWeaponCargo
items.summary: Returns all weapons types and count from the cargo space

items.name: getWeaponSway
items.summary: Returns current size of weapon sway of a given unit, in radians. This command may still return a value greater 0 even if sway was effectively set to 0 with `player setCustomAimCoef 0;`.

items.name: getWingsOrientationRTD
items.summary: Returns orientation of horizontal stabilizers.

items.name: getWingsPositionRTD
items.summary: Returns position of stabilizers.

items.name: getWPPos
items.summary: Returns the position of a selected waypoint of a given group. Waypoints include only those which were placed in the mission editor.

items.name: glanceAt
items.summary: Control what the unit(s) is/are glancing at (target or Position). If target is used, it will get revealed fully.

items.name: globalChat
items.summary: Types text to the global radio channel. The text will be visible only on the PC where command was executed. If you need the message to show on all computers, you have to execute it globally (see remoteExec).

items.name: globalRadio
items.summary: Sends the audio message to the global radio channel. The message is defined in CfgRadio in the description.ext file or config radio protocol. The transmission will play only on the PC where command was executed.

items.name: goggles
items.summary: Returns name of currently used goggles (for NVGoggles use hmd).

items.name: goto
items.summary: Break script flow and go to given label (defined by # - NOT to be confused with SQF's hash sign!)

items.name: group
items.summary: Returns the group a unit is assigned to.

items.name: groupChat
items.summary: Types text to the group radio channel. The text will be visible only on the PC where command was executed. If you need the message to show on all computers, you have to execute it globally (see remoteExec).

items.name: groupFromNetId
items.summary: Get group from the provided unique ID. For objects, use objectFromNetId.

items.name: groupIconSelectable
items.summary: Returns whether or not group icons raise onGroupIconClick, onGroupIconOverEnter and onGroupIconOverLeave events.

items.name: groupIconsVisible
items.summary: Returns array with group icons visibility. A getter for setGroupIconsVisible

items.name: groupId
items.summary: Returns a group's name or a unit's group ID number.

items.name: groupOwner
items.summary: Returns the machine network ID of the client to which the group is local. This command only works when called from the server. When called from a client, it always returns 0.

items.name: groupRadio
items.summary: Sends the audio message to the group radio channel. The message is defined in CfgRadio in the description.ext file or config radio protocol.

items.name: groups
items.summary: Returns an array with all groups of given side.

items.name: groupSelectedUnits
items.summary: Returns selected units in source group for normal commanding mode (individual units). For the High Command equivalent, see hcSelected.

items.name: groupSelectUnit
items.summary: Selects a unit from player's group. If player is the leader, the effect of this command is similar to player pressing <kbd>F1</kbd>, <kbd>F2</kbd>, <kbd>F3</kbd> etc to highlight units in his squad, after which the unit…

items.name: grpNull
items.summary: A non-existing Group. To compare non-existent groups use isNull or isEqualTo:

items.name: gunner
items.summary: Returns the gunner of a vehicle.

items.name: gusts
items.summary: Return the current gusts value.

items.name: halt
items.summary: This command was meant to break the script into debugger, however currently it does not do anything except displaying and logging the following error: `Error Debugger breakpoint hit`.

items.name: handgunItems
items.summary: Returns array with all items assigned to the handgunWeapon except magazines. Use handgunMagazine command for the latter. This command is used for infantry weapons only.

items.name: handgunMagazine
items.summary: Collects all loaded magazines from all handgunWeapon muzzles and returns them in Array, otherwise it returns []. This command is used for infantry weapons only.

items.name: handgunWeapon
items.summary: Returns the name of a unit's handgun (an empty string if there is none).

items.name: handsHit
items.summary: Checks if a soldier's hands are hit, which results in inaccurate aiming.

items.name: hasCustomFace
items.summary: Get whether or not a player has an available custom face file.

items.name: hashValue
items.summary: Processes provided *value*'s hash, and encodes it using Base64. The hash algorithm is FNV-1A 64bit.

items.name: hasInterface
items.summary: Returns true if the computer has an interface (a real player). False for a dedicated server or for a headless client.

items.name: hasPilotCamera
items.summary: Returns true if the object airplane or helicopter has a pilotCamera.

items.name: hasWeapon
items.summary: Checks if a unit has the given weapon in hands or on back/in holster. Weapons inside unit containers such as vest and backpack are not counted.

items.name: hcAllGroups
items.summary: Returns selected groups in high command.

items.name: hcGroupParams
items.summary: Returns parameters describing group in high command bar. Return value is array in format [groupName, teamName] or [] if error.

items.name: hcLeader
items.summary: Returns group's high command commander.

items.name: hcRemoveAllGroups
items.summary: Remove all groups from unit's high command bar.

items.name: hcRemoveGroup
items.summary: Removes group from unit's high command bar.

items.name: hcSelected
items.summary: Returns selected groups in high command.

items.name: hcSelectGroup
items.summary: Select given group in high command bar.

items.name: hcSetGroup
items.summary: Add group to unit's high command bar.

items.name: hcShowBar
items.summary: Shows or hides high command bar. There must be some groups under HC command to show HC bar.

items.name: hcShownBar
items.summary: Return whether the High Command bar is shown/active.

items.name: headgear
items.summary: Returns headgear of unit.

items.name: hiddenActions
items.summary: Getter for hideActions, see also shownAction.

items.name: hideActions
items.summary: Hides/unhides user UI actions given by their enum number (see shownAction).

items.name: hideBody
items.summary: Hides dead body of the given unit. After a short delay, the body slowly sinks into the ground. After awhile, when group of the unit becomes grpNull, the body gets deleted and becomes objNull.

items.name: hideObject
items.summary: Hide entity. Can be used on soldiers and vehicles, also on static objects.

items.name: hideObjectGlobal
items.summary: This command is designed for MP. Hides object on all connected clients as well as JIP. Can be used on static objects. In singleplayer this command behaves just like hideObject.

items.name: hideSelection
items.summary: Hides or shows the simple object's provided selection.

items.name: hint
items.summary: Outputs a hint message to the right of the screen (left of the screen in Operation Flashpoint) with a sound (except in Armed Assault).

items.name: hintC
items.summary: Displays a very basic message dialog in the center of the screen. Player control is taken away until "Continue" is pressed. The message dialog can be dragged around on the screen.

items.name: hintCadet
items.summary: Shows a text hint only when in cadetMode.

items.name: hintSilent
items.summary: Same as hint, but without a sound.

items.name: hmd
items.summary: Returns class name of currently used Head Mounted Display. Returns an empty string if the slot is empty.

items.name: hostMission
items.summary: Host the multiplayer mission defined in the config class and opens the lobby with the scenario loaded. Must be called in UI action from a dialog.

items.name: htmlLoad
items.summary: Load HTML from file or URI using given control. File path is relative to current mission dir or an absolute path (with drive letter etc.). The command is subject to restrictions, imposed by CfgCommands class.

items.name: HUDMovementLevels
items.summary: Returns movement borders for HUD

items.name: humidity
items.summary: Returns the current humidity value. 0 is no humidity and 1 is 100% humidity. Humidity value quickly changes from 0 to 1 when rain starts, then slowly changes from 1 to 0 when rain stops.

items.name: if
items.summary: This operator creates a If Type which is used in the if-construct as described here.

items.name: ignore3DENHistory
items.summary: Ignores all history steps created by executing the given code.

items.name: ignoreTarget
items.summary: Sets a target to be ignored by this Group. It will not appear in nearTargets and the group will not notice its presence. targetKnowledge can be used to check if a target is currently ignored.

items.name: image
items.summary: Creates a structured text containing the given image. Use setAttributes to set additional attributes on the image.

items.name: import
items.summary: Imports one or multiple local variables from the parent scope, and defines them as private variables in the current scope. It can bypass privateAll.

items.name: importAllGroups
items.summary: Imports all groups into the RTE.

items.name: importance
items.summary: Returns a location's importance value.

items.name: in
items.summary: Checks whether value is in array, unit is in vehicle, position is inside location or ANSI string is part of other ANSI string. If Unicode support is desired, see forceUnicode.

items.name: inArea
syntax: position inArea [center, a, b, angle, isRectangle, c, usePosWorld]
items.summary: Checks whether given position or object is inside given area. Use inAreaArray to check multiple positions/objects within area.

items.name: inAreaArray
syntax: positions inAreaArray [centre, a, b, angle, isRectangle, c, usePosWorld]
items.summary: Returns given list of Objects and/or Positions that are in the given area, area defined by a trigger, marker, location or array.

items.name: inAreaArrayIndexes
syntax: positions inAreaArrayIndexes [centre, a, b, angle, isRectangle, c, usePosWorld]
items.summary: Returns indices of positions that are within the provided area.

items.name: incapacitatedState
items.summary: Returns the incapacitated sub-state of the given unit, when the lifeState of the unit is "INCAPACITATED". Could be one of: - "UNCONSCIOUS" - "MOVING" - "SHOOTING"

items.name: independent
items.summary: Pre-defined variable for the independent side.

items.name: inflame
items.summary: Sets the state of a fireplace.

items.name: inflamed
items.summary: Checks if fireplace is inflamed (burning) or not. To check if a unit is receiving damage from fire, use isBurning command.

items.name: infoPanel
items.summary: Returns information about what is currently displayed on given player's info panel.

items.name: infoPanelComponentEnabled
items.summary: Controls availability of component to given object info panel.

items.name: infoPanelComponents
items.summary: Returns array of all components available to given object info panel.

items.name: infoPanels
items.summary: Returns array all info panels configured for given object or object and turret path.

items.name: inGameUISetEventHandler
items.summary: Sets given event handler of in-game UI. If EH function returns true, performed action is overridden.

items.name: inheritsFrom
items.summary: Returns base entry of config entry.

items.name: initAmbientLife
items.summary: Initialises the ambient life on local client from `CfgWorlds >> worldName >> AmbientA3`. Has no effect on dedicated server or headless client.

items.name: inPolygon
items.summary: Checks whether position is inside given polygon. The polygon is only checked in 2 dimensions, i.e. the value of Z is ignored.

items.name: inputAction
items.summary: Return the state of input devices mapped to given input action.

items.name: inputController
items.summary: Returns the state of controller inputs. The controller is a standard XBOX controller which is selected with Windows XBOX controller scheme.

items.name: inputMouse
items.summary: Returns the state of mouse button action, alone or in combination with key presses.

items.name: inRangeOfArtillery
items.summary: Returns true if all given units are able to fire at given position with given magazineType.

items.name: insert
items.summary: Inserts multiple values into Array/String/HashMap.

items.name: insertEditorObject
items.summary: Insert an object to the editor and assign arguments. Create script is,not called. Returns the ID of the new EditorObject. Subtype class is,optional.

items.name: insideBuilding
items.summary: Returns how much a man is inside a building. The value is the same as normally returned by weapons/ammo sound controller "interior".

items.name: intersect
items.summary: Finds named selections in object which are in specified LOD, intersected by given section of a line. Return value is in the form of [selection, distance]. Multiple returned arrays are nested within a single array.

items.name: is3DEN
items.summary: Returns true if the Eden Editor is currently being used.

items.name: is3DENMultiplayer
items.summary: Returns true if the Eden Editor is in multiplayer mode.

items.name: is3DENPreview
items.summary: Returns true if the Eden Editor is currently in mission preview mode, single player or multiplayer. (see also is3DEN, is3DENMultiplayer)

items.name: isAbleToBreathe
items.summary: If unit is diving and doesn't have a rebreather, it returns false. Diving means the unit's head is underwater. If unit is underwater and has a rebreather, the command returns true.

items.name: isActionMenuVisible
items.summary: Returns true if scroll menu is visible.

items.name: isAgent
items.summary: Check if team member is an agent.

items.name: isAimPrecisionEnabled
items.summary: Returns true if procedural aiming precision affects weapon sway.

items.name: isAISteeringComponentEnabled
items.summary: Returns whether the AI steering component feature is enabled for the specified vehicle.

items.name: isAllowedCrewInImmobile
items.summary: Whether or not units can be in a vehicle with broken tracks/wheels.

items.name: isArray
items.summary: Check if config entry represents array.

items.name: isAutoHoverOn
items.summary: Return true if vehicle has enabled auto hover. (always returns false if the vehicle can't set auto hover)

items.name: isAutonomous
items.summary: Returns whether the UAV is in autonomous mode or not.

items.name: isAutoStartUpEnabledRTD
items.summary: Returns state of automatic start up action.

items.name: isAutotest
items.summary: Returns true if game was started with autotest parameter

items.name: isAutoTrimOnRTD
items.summary: Returns state of auto trim functionality.

items.name: isAwake
items.summary: Returns resting state of a PhysX (EPE) object. Some EPE objects are deliberately put to sleep by the engine to save resources. This command returns true when object is simulating and false when it is put to sleep.

items.name: isBleeding
items.summary: Returns whether the unit is bleeding.

items.name: isBurning
items.summary: Returns whether the unit is burning. This returns true only if unit is damaged by nearby fire, it does not check whether a fireplace is burning, use inflamed command for that.

items.name: isClass
items.summary: Check if config entry represents config class.

items.name: isCollisionLightOn
items.summary: Returns true if vehicle collision lights are on otherwise false.

items.name: isCopilotEnabled
items.summary: Returns true if copilots actions are enabled.

items.name: isDamageAllowed
items.summary: A getter for allowDamage command. The command indicates if damage is allowed at current locality, hence local effect of the command.

items.name: isDedicated
items.summary: Returns true if the machine executing the command is a dedicated multiplayer server. Returns false in single player.

items.name: isDLCAvailable
items.summary: Returns true if the DLC (CDLC included) is marked as available on Steam. Official and Creator DLC appIds can be found on Arma 3: DLCs & Expansions and Arma 3: CDLCs pages.

items.name: isEngineOn
items.summary: Returns true if engine is on, false if it is off.

items.name: isEqualRef
items.summary: Compares two values by reference, returns true if equal.

items.name: isEqualTo
items.summary: Performs strict comparison between var1 and var2 and returns true if equal, otherwise false. Strict means that it would check that both arguments are of the same data type and then compare the values.

items.name: isEqualType
items.summary: Compares two values' types. A much faster alternative to `typeName a == typeName b`.

items.name: isEqualTypeAll
items.summary: Compares types of all elements of an array to the type of a single value. Since Arma 3 v2.09.149634 no additional check is needed to make sure the first argument is an Array.

items.name: isEqualTypeAny
items.summary: Compares type of given value to every type in the given array and if match is found, true is returned.

items.name: isEqualTypeArray
items.summary: Compares types of all elements of one array to types of all elements of another array. Since Arma 3 v2.09.149634 no additional check is needed to make sure the first argument is an Array.

items.name: isEqualTypeParams
items.summary: Compares types of all elements of input array to types of all elements of template array.

items.name: isFilePatchingEnabled
items.summary: Returns true if file patching is enabled otherwise false

items.name: isFinal
items.summary: Checks if Code or a variable was compiled final with compileFinal.

items.name: isFlashlightOn
items.summary: Returns true if there is a linked and enabled flashlight on a given weapon.

items.name: isFlatEmpty
syntax: position isFlatEmpty [minDistance, mode, maxGradient, maxGradientRadius, overLandOrWater, shoreLine, ignoreObject]
items.summary: Checks given position against given filter params. Filter includes checks for: - If there are any objects closer than given distance from given position (in 2D) - If the area around position is flat enough to match…

items.name: isForcedWalk
items.summary: Returns true if player is forced to walk with forceWalk.

items.name: isFormationLeader
items.summary: Returns true if the specified unit is subgroup leader.

items.name: isGameFocused
items.summary: Returns the state of game focus changed by pressing <kbd>ALT</kbd>+<kbd>TAB</kbd> or similar action.

items.name: isGamePaused
items.summary: Returns the state of game simulation. Simulation can get paused by pressing <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> or a system dialog opening (e.g. <kbd>Esc</kbd> menu).

items.name: isGroupDeletedWhenEmpty
items.summary: Checks if the given group marked for auto-deletion when empty. See deleteGroupWhenEmpty.

items.name: isHidden
items.summary: Returns whether a person is hidden (reached the hiding position).

items.name: isInRemainsCollector
items.summary: Checks if unit or vehicle is queued for disposal after death.

items.name: isInstructorFigureEnabled
items.summary: Returns the status of INSTRUCTOR FIGURE setting in UI (OPTIONS >> GAME >> GENERAL >> INSTRUCTOR FIGURE).

items.name: isIRLaserOn
items.summary: Returns true if there is a linked and enabled IR on the given weapon.

items.name: isKeyActive
items.summary: Checks whether the given key is active in the current user profile.

items.name: isKindOf
items.summary: Checks whether the given object or type is (a subtype) of the given type.

items.name: isLaserOn
items.summary: Returns true if the vehicle has its laser turned on. Not to be confused with isIRLaserOn which is for units. Main syntax is for primary gunner turret.

items.name: isLightOn
items.summary: Returns true if vehicle headlights are on otherwise false.

items.name: isLocalized
items.summary: Checks whether given *stringName* is localized.

items.name: isManualFire
items.summary: Returns true if manual fire is on. Manual fire could either be selected in vehicle action menu (if available) or with action "ManualFire" and "ManualFireCancel". Always returns false for a soldier.

items.name: isMarkedForCollection
items.summary: Checks whether the object is marked for weapons collection.

items.name: isMissionProfileNamespaceLoaded
items.summary: The missionProfileNamespace variables are loaded at the start of a mission, before 'init.sqf' is executed.

items.name: isMultiplayer
items.summary: Return true if multiPlayer.

items.name: isMultiplayerSolo
items.summary: Returns true when playing a game in solo multiplayer (for example Apex coop campaign PLAY SOLO option).

items.name: isNil
items.summary: Tests whether a variable is nil or undefined from its identifier, or whether the given expression evaluates to nil or Nothing.

items.name: isNotEqualRef
items.summary: Compares two values by reference, returns true if not equal.

items.name: isNotEqualTo
items.summary: Performs strict comparison between var1 and var2 and returns false if equal, otherwise true.

items.name: isNull
items.summary: Checks whether the tested item is null.

items.name: isNumber
items.summary: Check if config entry represents number.

items.name: isObjectHidden
items.summary: Checks visibility of a given object on the local machine.

items.name: isObjectRTD
items.summary: Returns true if RTD model is loaded.

items.name: isOnRoad
items.summary: Checks if given position is inside road segment. Same as roadAt, only return is boolean instead of road object.

items.name: isPiPEnabled
items.summary: Returns whether Picture-In-Picture video option (Render to Texture) is enabled or not.

items.name: isPlayer
items.summary: Checks if given person is a player. Returns true for headless clients as well.

items.name: isRealTime
items.summary: Returns true if the mission editor is operating in real time mode.

items.name: isRemoteControlling
items.summary: Returns true if the given player is remote-controlling a unit.

items.name: isRemoteExecuted
items.summary: Returns true if the code context is being remote executed by remoteExec or remoteExecCall. In SP always returns false. See also isRemoteExecutedJIP:

items.name: isRemoteExecutedJIP
items.summary: Returns true if the code context is being remote executed from the JIP queue by remoteExec or remoteExecCall (when JIP param was set). It is a subset of isRemoteExecuted:

items.name: isSaving
items.summary: Returns the status of autosave request, made when saveGame command is executed. When request is made, the command immediately returns true.

items.name: isSensorTargetConfirmed
items.summary: Returns if given unit is confirmed target for given side.

items.name: isServer
items.summary: Returns true if the machine executing the command is the server in a multiplayer game or is running single player. It will return true for both dedicated and player-hosted server. See also Multiplayer Scripting/machines.

items.name: isShowing3DIcons
items.summary: Returns true if the editor is set to draw 3D icons.

items.name: isSimpleObject
items.summary: Returns true if given object is simple object

items.name: isSprintAllowed
items.summary: Returns true if player is allowed to sprint

items.name: isStaminaEnabled
items.summary: Check if stamina depletion is enabled.

items.name: isSteamMission
items.summary: Returns true if the current mission is a Steam Workshop mission.

items.name: isSteamOverlayEnabled
items.summary: Returns true if Steam overlay is enabled, otherwise false.

items.name: isStreamFriendlyUIEnabled
items.summary: Returns the status of STREAM FRIENDLY UI setting in UI (OPTIONS >> GAME >> GENERAL >> STREAM FRIENDLY UI).

items.name: isStressDamageEnabled
items.summary: Returns true if stress damage is enabled in the game settings. A getter for enableStressDamage.

items.name: isSwitchingWeapon
items.summary: Returns wether or not the unit is in the process of switching weapon.

items.name: isText
items.summary: Checks if config entry represents a text value.

items.name: isThrowable
items.summary: Returns true if the given magazine is a throwable.

items.name: isTouchingGround
items.summary: Returns true if object is touching the ground.

items.name: isTurnedOut
items.summary: Returns true if given unit is turned out, otherwise false. The output changes to true after unit finished turning out, however will change to false almost immediately after unit is ordered to turn in.

items.name: isTutHintsEnabled
items.summary: Returns the status of TUTORIAL HINTS setting in UI (OPTIONS >> GAME >> GENERAL >> TUTORIAL HINTS).

items.name: isUAVConnectable
items.summary: Returns true if UAV is connectable by AV terminal(s).

items.name: isUAVConnected
items.summary: Returns true if UAV is connected to some terminal. Terminal connection is handled locally, therefore the result of this command will be returned only for the client on which this command is executed.

items.name: isUIContext
items.summary: Returns true if the script originated from some UI control event, for example from "onButtonDown" EH. Exists within parent scope and immediate child scopes.

items.name: isUniformAllowed
items.summary: Check whether given uniform can be dressed by target soldier.

items.name: isUsingAISteeringComponent
items.summary: Returns whether the AI steering component setting is enabled globally.

items.name: isVehicleCargo
items.summary: Despite a misleading name, returns the vehicle that is transporting given vehicle in cargo. If the given vehicle is not in vehicle cargo, objNull is returned.

items.name: isVehicleRadarOn
items.summary: Returns true if vehicle has active sensors on.

items.name: isVehicleSensorEnabled
items.summary: Returns class name (to identify list based on component name) and info if given sensor is enabled.

items.name: isWalking
items.summary: Returns true if walk is toggled (default <kbd>W</kbd>+<kbd>S</kbd> in Arma 3).

items.name: isWeaponDeployed
items.summary: Returns true if weapon is currently deployed.

items.name: isWeaponRested
items.summary: Returns true if weapon is currently rested.

items.name: itemCargo
items.summary: Get array with items from ammo box (or any general weapon holder container).

items.name: items
items.summary: Returns an array of names of all unit's stored items, including weapons but excluding magazines (see itemsWithMagazines) and assignedItems.

items.name: itemsWithMagazines
items.summary: Returns combined array including all unit's stored items and all unit's stored magazines and all unit's stored weapons.

items.name: join
items.summary: Joins units into a given Group.

items.name: joinAs
items.summary: Joins the unit to the given group, if position id is available, this one is used.

items.name: joinAsSilent
items.summary: Joins the unit to the given group, if position id is available, this one is used. Avoid any radio communication related to joining.

items.name: joinSilent
items.summary: Join all units in the array to given group silently (without radio message). To have a group member leave a group, join him with the grpNull group (e.g.

items.name: joinString
items.summary: Joins *array* into String with provided *separator*. Array can be of mixed types, all elements will be converted to String prior to joining, but the fastest operation is on the array of Strings.

items.name: kbAddDatabase
items.summary: Register knowledge base database to given person. See Conversations for more details.

items.name: kbAddDatabaseTargets
items.summary: Register target list knowledge base database to given person. See Conversations for more details.

items.name: kbAddTopic
items.summary: Register conversation topic to given person. See Conversations for more details.

items.name: kbHasTopic
items.summary: Check if conversation topic was registered to given person. See Conversations for more details.

items.name: kbReact
syntax: person kbReact [receiver, topicName, sentenceID, argumentArray1, argumentArray2, ...]
items.summary: Pass a non-verbal communication to the receiver. This command does as if the sentence was said and triggers the reaction scripts (AI FSM or player's conversation EH). See Conversations for more details.

items.name: kbRemoveTopic
items.summary: Unregister conversation topic from given person. See Conversations for more details.

items.name: kbTell
syntax: person kbTell [receiver, topicName, sentenceClass, argumentArray1, argumentArray2, ..., forceRadio]
items.summary: Make the person tell to the receiver the sentence. See Conversations for more details.

items.name: kbWasSaid
items.summary: Check if given item was said by person to someone. See Conversations for more details.

items.name: keyImage
items.summary: Returns a structured text, containing an image or name (if no image is found) of the button, on the keyboard, mouse or joystick, with the given code.

items.name: keyName
items.summary: Returns the name of a button with extra quotation marks (on the keyboard, mouse or joystick) with the given code.

items.name: keys
items.summary: Retrieves a list of all keys in a HashMap.

items.name: knowsAbout
items.summary: Checks if a group or a side knows about target. - Enemy knowledge is instantly shared among the group units - Units in the same group always perfectly know about each others - AI knowledge cannot check beyond current…

items.name: land
items.summary: Forces a helicopter landing. If there is a helipad nearby, the helicopter will attempt to land on it. VTOL he other hand will just land somewhere. To make helicopter or VTOL land on a specific helipad use landAt.

items.name: landAt
items.summary: Order an AI airplane to land at a given airport. ID is the number to identify which map airport you want the airplane to land at. See Arma: Airport IDs for more information. See also land.

items.name: landResult
items.summary: Return the result of helicopter landing position searching (performed after the land command).

items.name: language
items.summary: Returns current game language.

items.name: laserTarget
items.summary: Returns the laser target object created by given unit (vehicle or soldier) when using a laser targeting device. The main syntax targets the primary gunner turret.

items.name: lbAdd
items.summary: Adds an item with the given text to the CT_LISTBOX or CT_COMBO or CT_TOOLBOX.

items.name: lbClear
items.summary: Clear all items from a CT_LISTBOX or CT_COMBO control.

items.name: lbColor
items.summary: Returns the text color of the item with the given index of the CT_LISTBOX or CT_COMBO with IDC of the topmost user dialog.

items.name: lbColorRight
items.summary: Returns the text color of the item (right) with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

items.name: lbCurSel
items.summary: Returns the index of the selected item of the CT_LISTBOX, CT_LISTNBOX, CT_COMBO or CT_TOOLBOX. For CT_LISTBOX with multi selection enabled use lbSelection.

items.name: lbData
items.summary: Returns the data set in given index of the CT_LISTBOX or CT_COMBO.

items.name: lbDelete
items.summary: Removes the item with the given index from the CT_LISTBOX, CT_COMBO or CT_TOOLBOX.

items.name: lbIsSelected
items.summary: Checks whether or not given row of the given listbox is selected.

items.name: lbPicture
items.summary: Returns the picture name of the item with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

items.name: lbPictureRight
items.summary: Returns the right picture name of the item with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

items.name: lbSelection
items.summary: Returns Array of selected rows indices in the given listbox. If listbox is of style LB_MULTI (multi-selection) the array will contain multiple elements, otherwise only a single element.

items.name: lbSetColor
items.summary: Sets the color of the item (left) with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user Dialog to color.

items.name: lbSetColorRight
items.summary: Sets the color of the item (right) with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog to color.

items.name: lbSetCurSel
items.summary: Selects the item with the given index in the listbox, listnbox, combobox, xcombobox, xlistbox

items.name: lbSetData
items.summary: Sets the additional text (invisible) in the item with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog to the given data.

items.name: lbSetPicture
items.summary: Sets the left picture in the row with given index of CT_LISTBOX or CT_COMBO.

items.name: lbSetPictureColor
items.summary: Sets the color of item's picture (left) with the given index of the listbox with id idc of the topmost user dialog to the given color. Color is in format Color (RGBA).

items.name: lbSetPictureColorDisabled
items.summary: Sets the disabled color of item's picture (left) with the given index of the listbox with id idc of the topmost user dialog to the given color. Color is in format Color (RGBA).

items.name: lbSetPictureColorSelected
items.summary: Sets the selected color of item's picture (left) with the given index of the listbox with id idc of the topmost user dialog to the given color. Color is in format Color (RGBA).

items.name: lbSetPictureRight
items.summary: Sets the second (right aligned) picture in the item with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog. Name is the picture name.

items.name: lbSetPictureRightColor
items.summary: Sets the color of the second (right aligned) picture of the given index of the listbox with id idc of the topmost user dialog to the given color. Color which consists from only zeros means disable this override.

items.name: lbSetPictureRightColorDisabled
items.summary: Sets the disabled color of second (right aligned) picture of the item with the given index of the listbox with id idc of the topmost user dialog to the given color.

items.name: lbSetPictureRightColorSelected
items.summary: Sets the selected color of the second (right aligned) picture of the item with the given index of the listbox with id idc of the topmost user dialog to the given color.

items.name: lbSetSelectColor
items.summary: Sets the select color of the item with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog to color.

items.name: lbSetSelectColorRight
items.summary: Sets the select color of the of the secondary text (right aligned) of the item with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog to color.

items.name: lbSetSelected
items.summary: Sets the selection state of the given row of the given listbox of style LB_MULTI. The command has to be called for every row which is needed to be selected in multi-selection listbox.

items.name: lbSetText
items.summary: Sets the text on the left side of the item with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

items.name: lbSetTextRight
items.summary: Sets the text on the right side of the item with the given row index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

items.name: lbSetTooltip
items.summary: Sets tooltip for item with given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog to the given data.

items.name: lbSetValue
items.summary: Sets the additional value in the row with the given index of a CT_LISTBOX or CT_COMBO control.

items.name: lbSize
items.summary: Returns the number of items in a CT_LISTBOX or CT_COMBO control. For CT_TOOLBOX size see lnbSize.

items.name: lbSort
items.summary: Sorts listbox entries alphabetically ascending by their lbText.

items.name: lbSortBy
syntax: controlOrIDC lbSortBy [sortByType, reversedOrder, caseSensitive, useTextRight, unicodeOff]
items.summary: Sorts given ListBox by either lbText, lbValue or lbData in normal or reversed order, using case-sensitive or case-insensitive comparison. This command supports UNICODE characters.

items.name: lbSortByValue
items.summary: Sorts the ListBox entries by lbValue. The entries are sorted in ascending order. Also note that this command will mix up the entries randomly if multiple entries have the same value.

items.name: lbText
items.summary: Returns the shown text of the item with the given index of the CT_LISTBOX or CT_COMBO.

items.name: lbTextRight
items.summary: Returns the shown right text in the item with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

items.name: lbTooltip
items.summary: Returns tooltip for ListBox, ComboBox and Toolbox

items.name: lbValue
items.summary: Returns the additional integer value of the item with the given index of the CT_LISTBOX or CT_COMBO.

items.name: leader
items.summary: Returns the group leader for the given unit or group. For dead units, objNull is returned.

items.name: leaderboardDeInit
items.summary: Deletes internal class for the leaderboard with given name. Returns true if the board has been found and deinitialized.

items.name: leaderboardGetRows
items.summary: Returns values for the given leaderboard; this can be called after the one of the row request function has been called and successfully finished!

items.name: leaderboardInit
items.summary: Initialize the leaderboard structure for board with given name. Returns true if board is already initialized.

items.name: leaderboardRequestRowsFriends
items.summary: Requests given leaderboard to download friends rows from the given leaderboard

items.name: leaderboardRequestRowsGlobal
items.summary: Requests given leaderboard to download values from global table.

items.name: leaderboardRequestRowsGlobalAroundUser
items.summary: Requests given leaderboard to download values around the user position in the table.

items.name: leaderboardsRequestUploadScore
items.summary: Starts async. operation to upload score to board with given name, value always overwrite the current value in the board. The board has to be initialized before the call.

items.name: leaderboardsRequestUploadScoreKeepBest
items.summary: Starts async. operation to upload score to board with given name, value is only stored to board if it is better than one already in the board. The board has to be initialised before the call.

items.name: leaderboardState
items.summary: Returns the state of the board with the given name.

items.name: leaveVehicle
items.summary: Ceases the using of the vehicle by a group and unassigns vehicle from the group. If the argument is a single unit, the vehicle will be unassigned from unit's group.

items.name: libraryCredits
items.summary: Returns the credits for the libraries used by the game.

items.name: libraryDisclaimers
items.summary: Returns the library disclaimers.

items.name: lifeState
items.summary: Returns the life state of the given unit.

items.name: lightAttachObject
items.summary: Attach light to given object at given position on object.

items.name: lightDetachObject
items.summary: Detach light from object.

items.name: lightIsOn
items.summary: Check if lampost is on (shining).

items.name: lightnings
items.summary: Return the current lightnings value.

items.name: limitSpeed
items.summary: Limit the speed of an AI-driven vehicle or AI person to given value. It has continuous effect and AI will not break through the speed limitation until one is contacted, engaged or regrouped.

items.name: linearConversion
syntax: linearConversion [minFrom, maxFrom, value, minTo, maxTo, clip]
items.summary: Converts given value from given "from" range to wanted "to" range. If clipping is set to true, the resulting value is guaranteed to be within "to" range no matter what.

items.name: lineBreak
items.summary: Creates a structured text containing a line break.

items.name: lineIntersects
items.summary: Checks for object intersection with a virtual line between two positions. Since Arma 3 v2.20, there is an alternative syntax that does multiple checks in parallel, faster than multiple calls.

items.name: lineIntersectsObjs
syntax: lineIntersectsObjs [begPos, endPos, ignoreObj1, ignoreObj2, sortByDistance, flags]
items.summary: Returns a list of objects intersected by the line from *begPos* to *endPos*. Since Arma 3 v2.20, there is an alternative syntax that does multiple checks in parallel, faster than multiple calls.

items.name: lineIntersectsSurfaces
syntax: lineIntersectsSurfaces [begPosASL, endPosASL, ignoreObj1, ignoreObj2, sortMode, maxResults, LOD1, LOD2, returnUnique]
items.summary: Returns a list of intersections with surfaces and ground from *begPosASL* to *endPosASL*. Doesn't return intersection with sea surface. Works underwater, unlike lineIntersects. Hardcoded max distance: 5000m.

items.name: lineIntersectsWith
items.summary: Returns objects intersecting with the virtual line from *begPos* to *endPos*. By default, the resulting array of intersecting objects is unsorted (see *sortByDistance*).

items.name: linkItem
items.summary: Create and assign item to the correct slot. If there is an item in the targeted slot, it gets replaced. See also assignItem.

items.name: list
items.summary: List of units that would activate given Trigger.

items.name: listObjects
items.summary: Return the list of all objects of given type.

items.name: listRemoteTargets
items.summary: Return list of datalink targets and time for which they will be/were known.

items.name: listVehicleSensors
items.summary: Returns an array of the sensors in the given vehicle's config (configFile >> "CfgVehicles" >> *vehicle* >> "Components" >> "SensorsManagerComponent" >> "Components").

items.name: ln
items.summary: Returns the natural logarithm of x.

items.name: lnbAddArray
items.summary: Adds list of rows of strings.

items.name: lnbAddColumn
items.summary: Adds a column at given position.

items.name: lnbAddRow
items.summary: Adds a row of strings.

items.name: lnbClear
items.summary: Clears all items in the given listbox or combobox.

items.name: lnbColor
items.summary: Returns the text color of the item with the given position of the 2D listbox. The color is returned in format Color (RGBA).

items.name: lnbColorRight
items.summary: Returns the right color of given row.

items.name: lnbCurSelRow
items.summary: Returns the index of the selected row id 2D listbox.

items.name: lnbData
items.summary: Returns the additional text (invisible) in an item with the given position of the 2D listbox.

items.name: lnbDeleteColumn
items.summary: Removes column with given index from ListNBox control.

items.name: lnbDeleteRow
items.summary: Removes row with the given index from the given listbox or combobox.

items.name: lnbGetColumnsPosition
items.summary: Returns relative screen X of ListNBox control columns position [0.1,0.3,0.6...]. Use lnbSetColumnsPos to set positions.

items.name: lnbPicture
items.summary: Returns the picture name or path of the item with the given position of the 2D listbox.

items.name: lnbPictureRight
items.summary: Returns the right picture of given row. The *column* parameter does not matter.

items.name: lnbSetColor
items.summary: Sets the color of the item with the given position of the 2D listbox. Color is in format Color (RGBA).

items.name: lnbSetColorRight
items.summary: Sets the right color.

items.name: lnbSetColumnsPos
items.summary: Sets relative screen X for ListNBox control columns positions. Setter for lnbGetColumnsPosition.

items.name: lnbSetCurSelRow
items.summary: Selects the row with the given index of the 2D listbox.

items.name: lnbSetData
items.summary: Sets the additional text (invisible) on the item with the given position of the 2D listbox.

items.name: lnbSetPicture
items.summary: Sets the picture in the item with the given position of the 2D listbox.The picture is searched in the mission, directory, the dtaExt subdirectory of the campaign directory, and the dtaExt directory and the data bank (or…

items.name: lnbSetPictureColor
items.summary: Sets the cell picture's colour.

items.name: lnbSetPictureColorRight
items.summary: Sets color of the right picture in a CT_LISTNBOX.

items.name: lnbSetPictureColorSelected
items.summary: Sets the cell picture's colour on cell selection.

items.name: lnbSetPictureColorSelectedRight
items.summary: Sets the color of the right picture when it is selected.

items.name: lnbSetPictureRight
items.summary: Sets the cell's right-picture. The picture is set to the end of the row, the *column* parameter does not matter.

items.name: lnbSetText
items.summary: Sets the text in the item with the given position of the 2D listbox.

items.name: lnbSetTextRight
items.summary: Sets cell's right-aligned text. Does not replace cell's text.

items.name: lnbSetTooltip
items.summary: Sets tooltip on the item with the given row and column of CT_LISTNBOX.

items.name: lnbSetValue
items.summary: Sets the additional integer value in the item with the position index of the 2D listbox.

items.name: lnbSize
items.summary: Returns size of CT_LISTNBOX. This command supports CT_TOOLBOX control since Arma 3 v2.06. For CT_COMBO or CT_LISTBOX see lbSize.

items.name: lnbSort
items.summary: Sorts given multicolumn listbox by lnbText in given column in ascending or descending order.

items.name: lnbSortBy
syntax: [controlOrIDC, column] lnbSortBy [sortByType, reversedOrder, caseSensitive, useTextRight, unicodeOff]
items.summary: Sorts given multi-column ListNBox in the given column by either lnbText, lnbValue or lnbData in normal or reversed order, using case-sensitive or case-insensitive comparison.

items.name: lnbSortByValue
items.summary: Sorts given multicolumn listbox by lnbValue in given column in ascending or descending order.

items.name: lnbText
items.summary: Returns the shown text in the item with the given position of the given 2D listbox.

items.name: lnbTextRight
items.summary: Returns CT_LISTNBOX's right aligned cell text.

items.name: lnbValue
items.summary: Returns the additional integer value in the item with the given position of the 2D listbox.

items.name: load
items.summary: Returns the percentage of fullness of a unit's cargo. Output is usually in range 0..1, but can be higher after using certain scripting commands (like addWeaponWithAttachmentsCargoGlobal) which ignore load values when…

items.name: load3DENScenario
items.summary: Load the provided scenario or an empty scenario in the provided world.

items.name: loadAbs
items.summary: Returns current sum of mass from items stored in all unit's containers, linked items and weapons.

items.name: loadBackpack
items.summary: Returns current percentage of mass from items stored in a backpack relative to the maximum capacity of the backpack.

items.name: loadConfig
items.summary: Loads the given file as a Config, allowing easy processing of the config file contents using commands such as configClasses, configProperties, >>, etc.

items.name: loadCuratorSelectionPreset
items.summary: Load the given selection preset to the current selection of the curator.

items.name: loadFile
items.summary: Returns the content of given files. If you plan to compile said string, be aware that the file should not contain comments or compile will throw an error.

items.name: loadGame
items.summary: Loads game from the last autosave made with saveGame. If no autosave exists, restarts the mission. When used in campaign it will also deduct 1 life, defined in:

items.name: loadIdentity
items.summary: Loads person's identity from Objects.sav file in campaign directory (from entry name).

items.name: loadMagazine
items.summary: Initiates the loading action on given weapon of the turret of a transport. So the new magazine is not available instantly, yet according to the reloadTime.

items.name: loadOverlay
items.summary: Creates the load overlay dialog for the specified type of overlay.

items.name: loadStatus
items.summary: Loads object's properties from Objects.sav file in campaign directory (from entry name).

items.name: loadUniform
items.summary: Returns current percentage of mass from items stored in a uniform relative to the maximum capacity of the uniform.

items.name: loadVest
items.summary: Returns current percentage of mass from items stored in a vest relative to the maximum capacity of the vest.

items.name: local
syntax: local variable = value From Arma 2 v1.00 until Arma 3 v1.54 - see private for later versions
items.summary: Check if given unit is local on the computer in multiplayer games - see Multiplayer Scripting#Locality.

items.name: localize
items.summary: Used to internationalise text messages. The provided translation key is looked up in Stringtable.xml (or Stringtable.csv).

items.name: localNamespace
items.summary: Returns local Namespace attached to the mission. Has the same lifetime as missionNamespace but variables cannot be broadcasted out of or into this namespace in multiplayer and will not be serialized when game is saved.

items.name: locationNull
items.summary: A non-existing Location. To compare non-existent locations use isNull or isEqualTo:

items.name: locationPosition
items.summary: Returns the position of a location. If the location is attached to an object, that object's position is returned.

items.name: lock
items.summary: Lock vehicle (disable mounting / dismounting) for player. This command will remove user get in/get out actions but will not stop player getting into or out of vehicle via script commands (e.g moveInCargo).

items.name: lockCameraTo
items.summary: Lock/Unlock stabilized camera to target. Works only on turrets which have optic mode selected with direction stabilization enabled.

items.name: lockCargo
items.summary: Lock all cargo positions of a vehicle or lock by index. This command will remove user "get in" action (not get out) but will also stop player getting into vehicle via script commands (e.g moveInCargo) unlike lock…

items.name: lockDriver
items.summary: Lock the driver position of the vehicle. This command must be executed where vehicle is local.

items.name: locked
items.summary: Check if vehicle is locked. If it is locked, Persons cannot mount / dismount without order.

items.name: lockedCameraTo
items.summary: Return the turret lock target.

items.name: lockedCargo
items.summary: Check whether cargo position of the vehicle is locked.

items.name: lockedDriver
items.summary: Check whether driver position of the vehicle turret is locked.

items.name: lockedInventory
items.summary: Get a vehicle's inventory lock state. Can also be used on a unit's backback (see lockInventory).

items.name: lockedTurret
items.summary: Check whether gunner position of the vehicle turret is locked.

items.name: lockIdentity
items.summary: Locks the identity of a person. This will disable default identity.

items.name: lockInventory
items.summary: Lock or unlock a vehicle's inventory access. This command can also lock backpack a unit is wearing to prevent access by a third party. If set to true (locked), the inventory cannot be accessed via hotkey or action menu.

items.name: lockTurret
items.summary: Lock the gunner position of the vehicle turret. This command will remove user "get in" action (not "get out") but will also stop player getting into vehicle via script commands unlike lock command.

items.name: lockWP
items.summary: Disable switching to next waypoint (current waypoint will never complete while lockwp is used). Sometimes used during cut-scenes.

items.name: log
items.summary: Base-10 logarithm of x.

items.name: logEntities
items.summary: Creates a log file containing the list of all game entities in scene. The file is created in the same directory as .rpt file.

items.name: logNetwork
items.summary: Registers new log file recording a network traffic and returns handle of the log. The log file is saved inside the Arma 3 root folder.

items.name: logNetworkTerminate
items.summary: Terminates a network log file started with logNetwork with the given handle

items.name: lookAt
items.summary: Control what the unit(s) is/are looking at (target or Position). If target is used, it will get revealed fully.

items.name: lookAtPos
items.summary: Point the camera and center the map on the position.

items.name: magazineCargo
items.summary: Get array with magazines from ammo box (or any general weapon holder container).

items.name: magazines
items.summary: Returns array of type names of all vehicle's magazines. When applied to a unit, the command behaves differently and will omit magazines already loaded into unit's weapons.

items.name: magazinesAllTurrets
items.summary: Returns all magazines (including empty) from all vehicle turrets (including driver turret [-1]) and their ammo counts. Since Arma 3 v2.08.148327 it is possible to exclude person turrets from returned results.

items.name: magazinesAmmo
items.summary: Returns all vehicle's magazines and their ammo count (also works on supply boxes). When applied to a unit (soldier), the command behaves differently and will omit magazines already loaded into unit's weapons.

items.name: magazinesAmmoCargo
items.summary: Returns an array of subarrays with the type names and ammo left of all the vehicle's cargo or container magazines.

items.name: magazinesAmmoFull
items.summary: Returns array of arrays of all unit's or vehicle's magazines with extended information about them. The magazines returned are for primary gunner. If you need magazines for all turrets, see magazinesAllTurrets.

items.name: magazinesDetail
items.summary: Returns an array of strings with description of all vehicle's magazines, their ammo count (current/default) and their ids for the primary gunner.

items.name: magazinesDetailBackpack
items.summary: Returns an array with the type names of all the unit's backpack magazines.

items.name: magazinesDetailUniform
items.summary: Returns an array with the type names of all the unit's uniform magazines.

items.name: magazinesDetailVest
items.summary: Returns an array with the type names of all the unit's vest magazines.

items.name: magazinesTurret
items.summary: Returns all magazines of given turret. Use turret path [-1] for driver's turret. Alternatively, use magazinesAllTurrets.

items.name: magazineTurretAmmo
items.summary: Returns ammo count of given magazine from given turret (see setMagazineTurretAmmo for more info)

items.name: mapAnimAdd
items.summary: Add next frame to map animation.

items.name: mapAnimClear
items.summary: Clear map animation.

items.name: mapAnimCommit
items.summary: Play map animation.

items.name: mapAnimDone
items.summary: Check if map animation is finished.

items.name: mapCenterOnCamera
items.summary: The main syntax enables/disables continuous centering of the main map type control on the camera position. Needs to be executed once.

items.name: mapGridPosition
items.summary: Returns the map grid position of an object or position.

items.name: markAsFinishedOnSteam
items.summary: Marks current mission as finished on Steam. Returns true if Steam query is successfully started or false otherwise.

items.name: markerAlpha
items.summary: Gets the marker alpha. See setMarkerAlpha.

items.name: markerBrush
items.summary: Gets the marker brush. See setMarkerBrush.

items.name: markerChannel
items.summary: Returns the channel to which a marker belongs.

items.name: markerColor
items.summary: Returns colour of the given marker. See also setMarkerColor/Local.

items.name: markerDir
items.summary: Get marker direction.

items.name: markerDrawPriority
items.summary: Returns marker draw priority.

items.name: markerPolyline
items.summary: Returns a polyline marker's path data.

items.name: markerPos
items.summary: Returns marker position. See also setMarkerPos.

items.name: markerShadow
items.summary: Returns if the marker is drawn with shadow enabled.

items.name: markerShape
items.summary: Returns the shape of given marker. markerShape#Example_2

items.name: markerSize
items.summary: Returns marker size. This command is identical to getMarkerSize.

items.name: markerText
items.summary: Get marker text.

items.name: markerType
items.summary: Gets type of marker. See CfgMarkers for a list of standard markers.

items.name: matrixMultiply
items.summary: Returns resulting matrix from the multiplication of two matrices. First matrix must be of the size n × k, while the second must be of the size k × m, i.e `columns` matrix1 == `rows` matrix2.

items.name: matrixTranspose
items.summary: Returns transposed version of the given matrix. The matrix is an Array of rows. Each row is an Array of corresponding column values for the row. The minimum number of rows is 1.

items.name: max
items.summary: The greater value of a and b.

items.name: maxLoad
items.summary: Returns maximum load limit for a unit, uniform/vest/backpack containers, vehicle cargo, supply boxes and weapon holders.

items.name: members
items.summary: Return a list of members in given team.

items.name: menuAction
items.summary: Returns action stored in item on given path in CT_MENU_STRIP control.

items.name: menuAdd
items.summary: Adds new submenu entry into item on given path.

items.name: menuChecked
items.summary: Returns if item on given path is checked or not.

items.name: menuClear
items.summary: Removes all entries from given menu strip.

items.name: menuCollapse
items.summary: Collapses item on given path and all its children.

items.name: menuData
items.summary: Returns data stored in menu entry on given path.

items.name: menuDelete
items.summary: Deletes menu entry on given path.

items.name: menuEnable
syntax: control menuEnable path > [!CAUTION] > This information is obsolete. This old syntax is kept only for backward compatibility.
items.summary: Enables or disables menu entry on given path.

items.name: menuEnabled
items.summary: Returns if menu entry on given path is enabled or not.

items.name: menuExpand
items.summary: Expands given menu entry on given path and all its parents so entry is visible.

items.name: menuHover
items.summary: Returns path to menu entry mouse is currently hovering over.

items.name: menuPicture
items.summary: Returns picture set into item on given path.

items.name: menuSetAction
items.summary: Sets new action into menu entry on given path.

items.name: menuSetCheck
items.summary: Sets item on given path to be checked or not. By default menu strip entries are not checkable. Once this command was executed, an entry can become checked and unchecked.

items.name: menuSetData
items.summary: Sets data into menu entry on given path.

items.name: menuSetPicture
items.summary: Sets new picture into menu entry on given path. The picture will be replaced by a tick if the entry was set to checkable with menuSetCheck.

items.name: menuSetShortcut
items.summary: Sets shortcut of given menu strip entry.

items.name: menuSetText
items.summary: Sets text of given menu strip entry.

items.name: menuSetURL
items.summary: Sets weblink (URL) of given menu strip entry, subject to `allowedHTMLLoadURIs[]` whitelisting in CfgCommands config.

items.name: menuSetValue
items.summary: Sets new value into menu entry on given path.

items.name: menuShortcut
items.summary: Returns shortcut related to menu entry on given path in form of a bitflag. To get the shortcut text use menuShortcutText.

items.name: menuShortcutText
items.summary: Returns a string containing shortcut text for menu item on the given path.

items.name: menuSize
items.summary: Returns how many sub entries is in item on given path.

items.name: menuSort
items.summary: Sorts subentries of item on given path by their text.

items.name: menuText
items.summary: Returns current text set in menu entry on given path.

items.name: menuURL
items.summary: Returns current URL set in entry on given path.

items.name: menuValue
items.summary: Returns current value set in menu entry on given path.

items.name: merge
items.summary: Merges two HashMaps.

items.name: min
items.summary: The smaller of a and b.

items.name: mineActive
items.summary: Checks if the given mine is active.

items.name: mineDetectedBy
items.summary: Returns true if mine has been detected by a given side

items.name: missileState
items.summary: Get the provided *guided* missile's engine, target lock and flight profile states.

items.name: missileTarget
items.summary: Returns a guided missile's target.

items.name: missileTargetPos
items.summary: Returns a guided missile's target position.

items.name: missionConfigFile
items.summary: Return root of mission Description.ext entries hierarchy.

items.name: missionDifficulty
items.summary: Return difficulty that has been forced for this mission, returns -1 if difficulty is not forced and it is used one from player's options.

items.name: missionEnd
items.summary: Returns mission end type and how it was ended or an empty array [] is mission was not ended.

items.name: missionName
items.summary: Return currently loaded mission file (path to mission.pbo, relative to game exe).

items.name: missionNameSource
items.summary: Return workshop-compatible currently loaded mission file (path to mission.pbo, relative to game exe).

items.name: missionNamespace
items.summary: Returns the global namespace attached to mission.

items.name: missionProfileNamespace
items.summary: This namespace has the same lifetime as profileNamespace but is also connected to the mission it is saved from. See saveMissionProfileNamespace for more details.

items.name: missionStart
items.summary: Returns date and time when mission started. Because this command returns the time of the actual start of the mission, it might not be available in *pre-init* or *init*, but is guaranteed to be available in *post-init*…

items.name: missionVersion
items.summary: Returns the version of the current mission. - Mission from the 2D Editor: 12 - Mission from the Eden Editor: 15 and higher (for example current version for Eden Editor mission in Arma 3 v1.57 is 51)

items.name: mod
items.summary: Remainder of a divided by b.

items.name: modelToWorld
items.summary: Translates relative position from object model space to world space in PositionAGL format.

items.name: modelToWorldVisual
items.summary: Converts position from object model space to world space in render time scope. For ASL version see modelToWorldVisualWorld.

items.name: modelToWorldVisualWorld
items.summary: Converts position from object model space to world space in render time scope. For the PositionAGL version see modelToWorldVisual.

items.name: modelToWorldWorld
items.summary: Converts position from object model space to world space in PositionASL format from the object's centre position.

items.name: modParams
items.summary: Returns list of mod parameters according to given options, values are in same order as the given options.

items.name: moonIntensity
items.summary: Returns the intensity of the moon's brightness in range 0..1.

items.name: moonPhase
items.summary: Returns the phase of the in-game Moon on the given date. According to this command, the fullest Moon in Arma 3 at midnight is on `setDate [4804, 7, 13, 0, 0];`.

items.name: morale
items.summary: Get the provided unit's current morale level.

items.name: move
items.summary: Let group move to given position. Active waypoints will be ignored when command is used.

items.name: move3DENCamera
items.summary: Moves the Eden Editor camera.

items.name: moveInAny
items.summary: Moves unit to the first available seat in the specified vehicle.

items.name: moveInCargo
items.summary: Moves a unit into a vehicle cargo position (immediately and without animation).

items.name: moveInCommander
items.summary: Move soldier into vehicle commander position (Immediate, no animation).

items.name: moveInDriver
items.summary: Moves soldier into vehicle driver position (immediate, no animation).

items.name: moveInGunner
items.summary: Move the unit into vehicle gunner position (immediate, no animation).

items.name: moveInTurret
items.summary: Moves the soldier into the vehicle's turret. (Immediately, without animation).

items.name: moveObjectToEnd
items.summary: Shifts an editor object to the end of the objects array. This means,that the object will be drawn last (after all other objects).

items.name: moveOut
items.summary: Moves the soldier out of the vehicle.

items.name: moveTarget
items.summary: Change information about a target.

items.name: moveTime
items.summary: Returns the current time of the most important RTM animation currently being played on the soldier.

items.name: moveTo
items.summary: Low level command to person to move to given position. It is good to check first if AI pilot unit state is COMPLETED moveToCompleted first as this command will set unit into WAIT state waiting for instruction, but only…

items.name: moveToCompleted
items.summary: Check if latest low level moveTo command is finished. Returns true if given AI pilot unit state == COMPLETED

items.name: moveToFailed
items.summary: Check if latest low level moveTo command failed.

items.name: musicVolume
items.summary: Returns the current music volume (set by fadeMusic)

items.name: name
items.summary: When argument is Object, the command returns the name given to a unit using the setIdentity instruction or selected randomly by the game engine if setIdentity has not been used on the unit.

items.name: namedProperties
items.summary: Returns a list of named properties on Geometry LOD.

items.name: nameSound
items.summary: Returns the nameSound of a person.

items.name: nearEntities
items.summary: Finds entities inside a sphere with the given radius. If the alternative syntax is used, only entities of given types or subtypes are listed. Entities returned are not sorted by distance.

items.name: nearestBuilding
items.summary: Finds the nearest building to a given object or position. A "building" is defined as an object that is of class "House" and contains a path LOD.

items.name: nearestLocation
items.summary: Return the closest location of specified class to a given position. Checked range is unlimited (i.e. covers the whole map).

items.name: nearestLocations
items.summary: Returns an array of locations of chosen type(s) within the given radius of the given position, sorted from nearest to farthest.

items.name: nearestLocationWithDubbing
items.summary: Find the nearest location having a non-empty speech.

items.name: nearestMines
items.summary: Returns a list of nearest mines of the given types to the given position or object, within the specified distance.

items.name: nearestObject
items.summary: Returns the nearest object of given type (or inherited classes) to given position within a sphere. Hardcoded radius is 50 meters.

items.name: nearestObjects
items.summary: Returns a list of nearest objects of the given types to the given position or object, within the specified distance.

items.name: nearestTerrainObjects
items.summary: Returns a list of nearest terrain objects of the given types to the given position or object, within the specified distance.

items.name: nearObjects
items.summary: Find objects (Units, Vehicles, Dead, Map Objects) in a sphere with given radius. The first object in the returned array is *not* necessarily the closest one.

items.name: nearObjectsReady
items.summary: Check whether all data are loaded to nearObjects will return in reasonable time.

items.name: nearRoads
items.summary: Find the road segments within the circle of given radius.

items.name: nearSupplies
items.summary: Find supplies (weapon holders, ammo crates, fuel feeds, other units) in the sphere with given radius.

items.name: nearTargets
items.summary: Returns a list of targets within the defined range. "Targets" are not restricted to enemy units.

items.name: needReload
items.summary: Returns how much vehicle wants to reload its weapons.

items.name: needService
items.summary: Returns array with how much vehicle needs repairing, refueling and rearming.

items.name: netId
items.summary: Get the unique ID of an object or a group.

items.name: netObjNull
items.summary: A non-existent NetObject. To compare non-existent objects use isNull or isEqualTo:

items.name: newOverlay
items.summary: Creates the new overlay dialog for the specified type of overlay.

items.name: nextMenuItemIndex
items.summary: Returns the next available menu item index.

items.name: nextWeatherChange
items.summary: Return the remaining time (in seconds) over which the current weather change will occur.

items.name: nil
items.summary: Nil value. This value can be used to undefine existing variables.

items.name: nMenuItems
items.summary: Returns the total number of user-added menu items belonging to the given menu.

items.name: not
items.summary: not a is exactly the same as ! a.

items.name: numberOfEnginesRTD
items.summary: Returns the number of engines a helicopter has.

items.name: numberToDate
items.summary: Convert float number to a date.

items.name: objectCurators
items.summary: Returns array with all curators which can edit given object.

items.name: objectFromNetId
items.summary: Get object with given unique ID. For groups, use groupFromNetId.

items.name: objectParent
items.summary: Returns the parent of an object if said object is a proxy.

items.name: objNull
items.summary: A non-existent Object. To compare non-existent objects use isNull or isEqualTo:

items.name: objStatus
items.summary: Sets the status of an objective that was defined in briefing.html.

items.name: onBriefingGroup
items.summary: Select a sound declared in the Description.ext of the mission to be played the first time the Group tab is selected in the briefing.

items.name: onBriefingNotes
items.summary: Select a sound declared in the Description.ext of the mission to be played the first time the Notes tab is selected in the briefing.

items.name: onBriefingPlan
items.summary: Select a sound declared in the Description.ext of the mission to be played the first time the Plan tab is selected in the briefing.

items.name: onBriefingTeamSwitch
items.summary: Select a sound defined in the CfgSounds of the mission to be played the first time the TeamSwitch tab is selected in the briefing.

items.name: onCommandModeChanged
items.summary: Defines code performed when hc command mode changes either because of (Left Ctrl + Space) shortcut or hcShowBar scripting command.

items.name: onDoubleClick
items.summary: Defines an action performed when the user double clicks on the map. Command receives:,_pos array position,_units array selected units,_shift,_alt bool key state

items.name: onEachFrame
items.summary: Runs given statement every frame in an unscheduled environment.

items.name: onGroupIconClick
items.summary: Defines an action performed when player clicked on group marker (3D or in a map). The code executed once.

items.name: onGroupIconOverEnter
items.summary: Defines an action performed when player moves pointer over group marker (3D or in a map). The code will execute continuously while pointer is over icon.

items.name: onGroupIconOverLeave
items.summary: Defines an action performed when pointer, previously positioned over icon, is moved away from it (3D or in a map). The code is executed once.

items.name: onHCGroupSelectionChanged
items.summary: Defines an action performed when high command group selection has been changed.

items.name: onMapSingleClick
items.summary: Defines the action performed when user clicks in map by executing command string.

items.name: onPlayerConnected
items.summary: This command will execute the provided code on the server whenever a player connects to a multiplayer session.

items.name: onPlayerDisconnected
items.summary: This command will execute attached code whenever a player is leaving an MP session. The code will receive a number of special variables:

items.name: onPreloadFinished
items.summary: Defines an action performed after the preload screen finished. Preload event occurs after briefing screen on mission start.

items.name: onPreloadStarted
items.summary: Defines an action performed just before the preload screen started. Preload event occurs after briefing screen on mission start.

items.name: onShowNewObject
items.summary: Defines an action performed when the user right clicks on the map and,selects New Object. Set to empty for default behavior. Command receives:,_pos array position,

items.name: onTeamSwitch
items.summary: Defines an action performed when the team switch is finished. Commandset receives the following special variables: *_from* object previous unit, *_to* object current unit.

items.name: openCuratorInterface
items.summary: Force opens curator interface.

items.name: openDLCPage
items.summary: Opens a Steam page of the app with given appId. Only works for known appId (game + linked DLCs)

items.name: openGPS
items.summary: Opens or closes minimap if player has `"ItemGPS"` linked in inventory and `"MinimapDisplayComponent"` is not disabled with enableInfoPanelComponent. Returns true on success.

items.name: openMap
items.summary: Opens or closes in-game map.

items.name: openSteamApp
items.summary: Opens a Steam application, returns false if it was not possible to run the application.

items.name: openYoutubeVideo
items.summary: Opens Steam overlay with given YT video. Video URL is the end part of the YT URL, starting with watch?v=....

items.name: opfor
items.summary: Pre-defined variable for the opfor side.

items.name: or
items.summary: Returns true if one or both conditions are true. In case of the alternative syntax, lazy evaluation is used. That means that if left operand is true, evaluation of the right side is skipped completely.

items.name: orderGetIn
items.summary: Force all units in the array to get in or out of their assigned vehicles. Units must be assigned to a vehicle before this command will do anything.

items.name: overcast
items.summary: Return the current overcast level. Zero is clear skies, one is maximum cloud cover.

items.name: overcastForecast
items.summary: Return the overcast forecast.

items.name: owner
items.summary: On server machine, returns the machine network ID of the client to which the object is local. Otherwise returns 0. For use on clients clientOwner command is available. To find out the owner of a Group, use groupOwner.

items.name: param
items.summary: Extracts a single value with given index from input argument, similar to BIS_fnc_param.

items.name: params
items.summary: Parses input argument into array of private variables. When used without argument, as shown in main syntax, internal variable _this, which is usually available inside functions and event handlers, is used as argument.

items.name: parentAttached
items.summary: Get the parent of a attachChild attached child.

items.name: parseNumber
items.summary: Parses the string, interpreting its content as a floating point number.

items.name: parseSimpleArray
items.summary: Converts given, formatted as simple array, String into a valid Array. Simple array is array consisting of Numbers, Strings, Booleans and Arrays of all of the above.

items.name: parseText
items.summary: Creates a structured text by parsing the given XML description. Do not use parseText when displaying a localized text from Stringtable.xml.

items.name: parsingNamespace
items.summary: Returns the global namespace attached to config parser.

items.name: particlesQuality
items.summary: Returns current user settings for particles quality (configure->video->general->particles). 0-low, 1-normal, 2-high

items.name: periscopeElevation
items.summary: Returns current periscope elevation value, see also elevatePeriscope.

items.name: pi
items.summary: pi (180 degrees converted to Radians).

items.name: pickWeaponPool
items.summary: Transfers weapons and magazines from cargo of object into the weapon pool. This is used in the campaign to transfer weapons into the next mission.

items.name: pitch
items.summary: Returns the pitch of a persons voice.

items.name: pixelGrid
items.summary: Returns grid size based on screen resolution, UI size and configs: uiScaleFactor, uiScaleMaxGrids.

items.name: pixelGridBase
items.summary: Returns grid size based on screen resolution.

items.name: pixelGridNoUIScale
items.summary: Returns grid size based on screen resolution and configs: `uiScaleFactor`, `uiScaleMaxGrids`. As mentioned in the name of this command, the user interface scale is ignored.

items.name: pixelH
items.summary: Returns the height of one pixel for current resolution.

items.name: pixelW
items.summary: Returns width of one pixel for current resolution.

items.name: playableSlotsNumber
items.summary: Returns the number of available slots in mission per side (both empty and taken). In singleplayer mission, it returns number of playable units per side.

items.name: playableUnits
items.summary: Returns a list of playable units in a multiplayer game (occupied by both AI or players), created on the following sides east/opfor, west/blufor, resistance/independent and civilian only.

items.name: playAction
items.summary: When used on a person, a smooth transition to the given action will be initiated.

items.name: playActionNow
items.summary: When used on a person, a smooth transition to the given action will be initiated, but all previous playAction are discarded.

items.name: player
items.summary: A person object controlled by user. In Intros and Outros this isn't set by default and must be assigned.
