items.name: playerRespawnTime
items.summary: Return the player's remaining time before respawn, or -1 if it is not available (such as when the player is alive).

items.name: playerSide
items.summary: Returns the player's side. This is valid even when the player controlled person is dead (a difference from side player).

items.name: playersNumber
items.summary: Returns count of occupied role selection slots for given side. Players who claimed a slot in the lobby but did not start the mission are counted as well.

items.name: playerTargetLock
items.summary: Get the local player's current locked target (with weapons that can lock on).

items.name: playGesture
items.summary: When used on a person,a smooth transition to the given move will be initiated. Command doesn't seem to be functional

items.name: playMission
items.summary: The mission is launched (from the main menu).

items.name: playMove
items.summary: When used on a person, smooth transition to given move will be done.

items.name: playMoveNow
items.summary: When used on a person,a smooth transition to the given move will be initiated, but all previous playMove are discarded.

items.name: playMusic
items.summary: Plays music defined in Description.ext's CfgMusic or config.cpp. If the *musicName* could not be found a message is logged into the .rpt file: `Music <*musicName*> not found`.

items.name: playScriptedMission
items.summary: Load the given world, launch an empty mission, and execute the given expression. If provided, *config* can reference to the config entry, replacing Description.ext for this mission.

items.name: playSound
items.summary: Plays a sound from CfgSounds. Sound can be defined in missionConfigFile, configFile or campaignConfigFile.

items.name: playSound3D
syntax: playSound3D [filename, soundSource, isInside, soundPosition, volume, soundPitch, distance, offset, local, loop]
items.summary: Plays positional sound with given *filename* on every computer on network. To stop the sound use stopSound

items.name: playSoundUI
syntax: playSoundUI [sound, volume, soundPitch, isEffect, offset, loop]
items.summary: Plays given CfgSounds sound or a sound file given by file path through a dedicated UI sound channel unaffected by the global mixer volumes. If the file path is given, the leading slash will be ignored.

items.name: pose
items.summary: Returns the pose of the given unit.

items.name: position
items.summary: Returns position of an object (alias of getPos) or location (alias of locationPosition).

items.name: positionCameraToWorld
items.summary: Get the world coordinate space (AGL) from a camera-relative position.

items.name: posScreenToWorld
items.summary: Converts map screen coordinates into world coordinates. Unlike ctrlMapScreenToWorld, this command returns world position is format [x, y, 0], otherwise it is identical to it.

items.name: posWorldToScreen
items.summary: Converts world coordinates into map screen coordinates. This command is identical to ctrlMapWorldToScreen.

items.name: ppEffectAdjust
items.summary: Set post process effect parameters.

items.name: ppEffectCommit
items.summary: Commit post process effect in given time.

items.name: ppEffectCommitted
items.summary: Check whether given post process effect is committed.

items.name: ppEffectCreate
items.summary: Creates Post Process Effects specified by effect name and priority.

items.name: ppEffectDestroy
items.summary: Destroy Post Process Effects given by handle or array of handles.

items.name: ppEffectEnable
items.summary: Enable / disable Post Process Effects

items.name: ppEffectEnabled
items.summary: Checks whether given post process effect is enabled

items.name: ppEffectForceInNVG
items.summary: Forces use of Post Process Effects in NVG.

items.name: precision
items.summary: Return the movement precision of the given entity, how is the entity able to be precise when moving to given target.

items.name: preloadCamera
items.summary: Preload all textures and models around given Position to avoid visual artifacts after camera is moved.

items.name: preloadObject
items.summary: Preloads all textures, materials and proxies needed to render given object. Works with objects and classnames - note that classnames require an object instance in the mission.

items.name: preloadSound
items.summary: Makes sure that a sound can start playing without any delay once it is needed. Command works in Arma 3 but might not be implemented in earlier Arma installments.

items.name: preloadTitleObj
items.summary: Preloads data for the given resource object.

items.name: preloadTitleRsc
items.summary: Resource title - preload data. The resource can be defined in the Description.ext file.

items.name: preprocessFile
items.summary: Reads and processes the content of the specified file. Preprocessor is C-like, supports comments using `//` or `/*` and `- /` and PreProcessor Commands.

items.name: preprocessFileLineNumbers
items.summary: Returns the preprocessed content of the given file. The preprocessor is C-like, it supports comments using /* */ and PreProcessor Commands.

items.name: primaryWeapon
items.summary: Returns name of unit's primary weapon. This command will also return a weapon class name if the weapon is not used by the player, for example, it is on the unit's back.

items.name: primaryWeaponItems
items.summary: Returns array with all items assigned to the primaryWeapon except magazines. Use primaryWeaponMagazine command for the latter. This command is used for infantry weapons only.

items.name: primaryWeaponMagazine
items.summary: Collects all loaded magazines from all primaryWeapon muzzles and returns them in Array, otherwise it returns []. This command is used for infantry weapons only.

items.name: priority
items.summary: Return the priority of the task.

items.name: private
syntax: private _identifier = value From Arma 2 v1.00 to Arma 3 v1.52: see local
items.summary: Sets a variable to the innermost scope. See also param and params.

items.name: privateAll
items.summary: Disables the implicit inheritance of local variables, as defined in the parent scope.

items.name: processDiaryLink
items.summary: Opens the Diary screen on the subject/record specified by link. To get a valid link format, use createDiaryLink.

items.name: productVersion
items.summary: Returns the product's friendly name, identifier, version and build number.

items.name: profileName
items.summary: Returns currently chosen user profile name. For Steam profile name see profileNameSteam.

items.name: profileNamespace
items.summary: Returns the global namespace attached to the active user profile. Use setVariable and getVariable to save and load data to and from this Namespace. A variable can be deleted by setting its value to nil.

items.name: profileNameSteam
items.summary: Returns name of the current Steam profile. For currently chosen user profile name see profileName

items.name: progressLoadingScreen
items.summary: If loading screen is shown, sets progress bar to the given value (interval is from 0 to 1]).

items.name: progressPosition
items.summary: Returns the current position in the progress bar.

items.name: progressSetPosition
items.summary: Sets progress position of a progress bar.

items.name: publicVariable
items.summary: Reliably broadcasts missionNamespace variable and its current value to all computers (server/client).

items.name: publicVariableClient
items.summary: Send the variable value to the client computer - same limitations regarding variable type as publicVariable.

items.name: publicVariableServer
items.summary: Send the variable value to the server - same limitations regarding variable type as publicVariable.

items.name: pushBack
items.summary: Insert an element to the back of the given array. This command modifies the original array. (see also: pushBackUnique)

items.name: pushBackUnique
items.summary: Adds element to the back of the given array but only if it is unique to the array. The index of the added element is returned upon success, otherwise -1. This command modifies the original array.

items.name: putWeaponPool
items.summary: Transfers weapons and magazines from weapon pool into cargo of given object. Used in campaign to transfer weapons into next mission.

items.name: pylonAction
items.summary: Executes an action on a specific pylon. MP effect and locality depend on the specific action.

items.name: queryItemsPool
items.summary: Returns the number of items of type in the weapon pool (used in campaigns to transfer weapons to the next mission).

items.name: queryMagazinePool
items.summary: Return number of magazines of type name in magazine pool (used in campaign to transfer magazines into next mission).

items.name: queryWeaponPool
items.summary: Return number of weapons of type name in weapon pool (used in campaign to transfer weapons into next mission).

items.name: rad
items.summary: Converts given value in degrees to radians. 1 radian equals 180 degrees divided by pi.

items.name: radioChannelAdd
items.summary: Add the units to the custom channel.

items.name: radioChannelCreate
items.summary: Create a custom radio channel with the given color, label, call sign and registered characters. The custom channel ID returned can be used to manipulate the created channel later.

items.name: radioChannelInfo
items.summary: Obtains custom radio channel's details. if 'customChannelID' is invalid, the return is either the first custom radio channel (customChannelID < firstCCChannel) or the last (customChannelID > lastCCChannel).

items.name: radioChannelRemove
items.summary: Remove the units from the custom radio channel.

items.name: radioChannelSetCallSign
items.summary: Set the custom radio chat channel's callsign / VoN callsign.

items.name: radioChannelSetLabel
items.summary: Set the custom radio channel's label.

items.name: radioEnabled
items.summary: A getter for enableRadio.

items.name: radioVolume
items.summary: Returns the current radio volume (set by fadeRadio).

items.name: rain
items.summary: Returns the current value of rain density.

items.name: rainbow
items.summary: Returns the current rainbow intensity.

items.name: rainParams
items.summary: Returns currently set RainParticles params, custom or default.

items.name: rank
items.summary: Returns the rank of the given unit. Rank can be one of the following: - `"PRIVATE"` - `"CORPORAL"` - `"SERGEANT"` - `"LIEUTENANT"` - `"CAPTAIN"` - `"MAJOR"` - `"COLONEL"`

items.name: rankId
items.summary: Return the rank of the given unit for comparison.

items.name: rating
items.summary: Check unit rating. Rating is increased for killing enemies, decreased for killing friendlies (see Rating Values). Can be changed via addRating by the mission designer.

items.name: rectangular
items.summary: Checks if a location is rectangular (returns true) or elliptical (returns false).

items.name: regexFind
items.summary: Searches in a string with a regular expression.

items.name: regexMatch
items.summary: Returns whether the *haystack* matches the *pattern*.

items.name: regexReplace
items.summary: Searches given *haystack* with given *pattern* and replaces all matches with given *replaceString*.

items.name: registeredTasks
items.summary: Returns array with all registered task types for the given agent. The values are the names set in `CfgTasks` classes `name` property and are the same names used for unregisterTask.

items.name: registerTask
items.summary: Registers a new task type. Parameters are defined in the given config class (subclass of `CfgTasks`)

items.name: reload
items.summary: Main syntax: Reload first found muzzle that needs reloading (with some inconsistencies).

items.name: reloadEnabled
items.summary: A getter for enableReload. The value returned is wether or not auto-reload is enabled for current client only.

items.name: remoteControl
items.summary: Switches on remote control of the unit. The command was Global Argument prior to Arma 3 v2.14). For more info see Remote Control Tutorial.

items.name: remoteControlled
items.summary: Returns the player controlling the given unit if the argument is the unit, or the unit controlled by the player if the argument is the player.

items.name: remoteExec
items.summary: Asks the server to execute the given function or script command on the given target machine(s). - Functions are executed in the scheduled environment; suspension is allowed.

items.name: remoteExecCall
items.summary: Unscheduled version of remoteExec. The only difference between remoteExec and remoteExecCall is that remoteExecCall will run functions in unscheduled environment.

items.name: remoteExecutedJIPID
items.summary: Returns JIP ID of the persistent call generated from JIP queue for the joining player (see remoteExec).

items.name: remoteExecutedOwner
items.summary: Returns the machine network ID of the client that initiated Remote Execution.

items.name: remove3DENConnection
items.summary: Removes connection between entities.

items.name: remove3DENEventHandler
items.summary: Removes Eden Editor event handler of given type and ID.

items.name: remove3DENLayer
items.summary: Remove Eden Editor editing layer.

items.name: removeAction
items.summary: Removes user added action with given ID. This only removes actions added with the addAction command. You cannot remove default game actions, such as reload.

items.name: removeAll3DENEventHandlers
items.summary: Removes all Eden Editor event handlers of given type.

items.name: removeAllActions
items.summary: Removes all unit's user added actions.

items.name: removeAllAssignedItems
items.summary: Unassigns and deletes all linked items from inventory. The commands operates on assignedItems array, which does not include goggles or headgear but includes binoculars, which is a weapon.

items.name: removeAllBinocularItems
items.summary: Removes all items from binocular weapon, except magazine.

items.name: removeAllContainers
items.summary: Removes all containers (vest, uniform, backpack) from the provided unit.

items.name: removeAllCuratorAddons
items.summary: Restrict access to all addons for given curator.

items.name: removeAllCuratorCameraAreas
items.summary: Delete all curator camera areas.

items.name: removeAllCuratorEditingAreas
items.summary: Delete all curator edit areas.

items.name: removeAllEventHandlers
items.summary: Removes all event handlers of given type that were added by addEventHandler and resets event handler's creation index to 0.

items.name: removeAllHandgunItems
items.summary: Removes all items from handgunWeapon, except magazine.

items.name: removeAllItems
items.summary: Removes all special items from the unit.

items.name: removeAllItemsWithMagazines
items.summary: Removes all itemsWithMagazines from the uniform, vest and backpack. Command essentially clears all unit's containers.

items.name: removeAllMagazines
items.summary: Removes all magazines from the unit.

items.name: removeAllMagazinesTurret
items.summary: Removes all magazines from the given turret or from all turrets. Use turret path [-1] for driver's turret or [] for all turrets.

items.name: removeAllMissionEventHandlers
items.summary: Removes all mission event handlers of the given type which were added by addMissionEventHandler.

items.name: removeAllMPEventHandlers
items.summary: Removes all MP event handlers of the given type which were added by addMPEventHandler. Command needs to be executed only on one PC for MP event handler to be removed globally.

items.name: removeAllMusicEventHandlers
items.summary: Removes all music track event handlers of given type.

items.name: removeAllOwnedMines
items.summary: Removes ownership of all owned mines/explosive devices of the given unit

items.name: removeAllPrimaryWeaponItems
items.summary: Removes all items from primaryWeapon, except magazine.

items.name: removeAllSecondaryWeaponItems
items.summary: Removes all items from secondaryWeapon, except magazine.

items.name: removeAllUserActionEventHandlers
items.summary: Removes all UserAction event handlers of the given type which were added by addUserActionEventHandler.

items.name: removeAllWeapons
items.summary: Removes all weapons and magazines from the given unit. Does not remove items like map, compass, radio (see removeWeapon for this).

items.name: removeBackpack
items.summary: Removes unit's backpack

items.name: removeBackpackGlobal
items.summary: Removes backpack from a unit. (even non-local)

items.name: removeBinocularItem
items.summary: Removes given weapon item, including magazine, from the binocular weapon.

items.name: removeCuratorAddons
items.summary: Restrict curator use of given addons.

items.name: removeCuratorCameraArea
items.summary: Removes curator camera area.

items.name: removeCuratorEditableObjects
items.summary: Unregister objects which can be edited by a curator.

items.name: removeCuratorEditingArea
items.summary: Removes editing area for given curator.

items.name: removeDiaryRecord
items.summary: Remove a log record.

items.name: removeDiarySubject
items.summary: Removes a page and all its subjects from the Diary.

items.name: removeDrawIcon
items.summary: Removes an icon for an editor object.

items.name: removeDrawLinks
items.summary: Remove all drawn links for the given editor object for the given editor,object type. Pass an empty string as param type to remove all draw,links for an object.

items.name: removeEventHandler
items.summary: Removes a given Event Handler that was added with addEventHandler.

items.name: removeFromRemainsCollector
items.summary: Removes vehicles/units from the garbage collector, so they do not get deleted automatically; added earlier with addToRemainsCollector.

items.name: removeGoggles
items.summary: Removes goggles from unit (diver goggles for example). This command does not remove NVGoggles. Use unassignItem and removeItem or just unlinkItem for latter.

items.name: removeGroupIcon
items.summary: Remove icon with given ID from group.

items.name: removeHandgunItem
items.summary: Removes given weapon item, including magazine, from the handgunWeapon

items.name: removeHeadgear
items.summary: Removes headgear from a unit. If unit has no headgear command quietly fails.

items.name: removeItem
items.summary: Removes item from the inventory. The removal order by containers is uniform → vest → backpack.

items.name: removeItemFromBackpack
items.summary: Removes item from soldier's backpack.

items.name: removeItemFromUniform
items.summary: Removes item from soldier's uniform. Can be used with magazines and weapons too.

items.name: removeItemFromVest
items.summary: Removes item from soldier's vest.

items.name: removeItems
items.summary: Removes all items with given class name from the inventory.

items.name: removeMagazine
items.summary: Remove magazine from the unit or static weapon.

items.name: removeMagazineGlobal
items.summary: Removes the magazine from the unit.

items.name: removeMagazines
items.summary: Removes all magazines of given type from the unit. If magazine class does not exist, nothing happens, not even .rpt message, unlike with addMagazine command.

items.name: removeMagazinesTurret
items.summary: Removes all magazines of the given type from given vehicle. Use turret path [-1] for driver's turret.

items.name: removeMagazineTurret
items.summary: Removes the magazine from the turret. Use turret path [-1] for driver's turret.

items.name: removeMenuItem
items.summary: Removes a previously added menu item.

items.name: removeMissionEventHandler
items.summary: Removes mission event handler added by addMissionEventHandler.

items.name: removeMPEventHandler
items.summary: Removes MP event handler added by addMPEventHandler.

items.name: removeMusicEventHandler
items.summary: Removes specified music track event handler. See Arma 3: Event Handlers#Music Event Handlers.

items.name: removeOwnedMine
items.summary: Removes ownership over a remotely detonatable mine from the unit.

items.name: removePrimaryWeaponItem
items.summary: Removes given weapon item, including magazine, from the primaryWeapon.

items.name: removeSecondaryWeaponItem
items.summary: Removes given weapon item, including magazine, from the secondaryWeapon.

items.name: removeSimpleTask
items.summary: Remove a simple task from the list of simple tasks.

items.name: removeSwitchableUnit
items.summary: Remove a unit from the list of units available for Team Switch.

items.name: removeTeamMember
items.summary: Remove given member from given team. Effect is local, unless both member and team are local to PC on which command is executed, then effect is global.

items.name: removeUniform
items.summary: Removes uniform from unit.

items.name: removeUserActionEventHandler
items.summary: Removes a UserAction event handler. For a list of available UserAction event handlers, see: Arma 3: Mission Event Handlers.

items.name: removeVest
items.summary: Removes vest from unit.

items.name: removeWeapon
items.summary: Remove weapon from a unit. The unit must be local to the computer where command is executed. For a global version of this command, see removeWeaponGlobal.

items.name: removeWeaponAttachmentCargo
items.summary: Remove attachment linked to a weapon from the vehicle cargo space.

items.name: removeWeaponCargo
items.summary: Remove weapon from the vehicle cargo space.

items.name: removeWeaponGlobal
items.summary: Remove a weapon from a unit. An attempt to remove a weapon, which is not in unit's possession, is simply ignored.

items.name: removeWeaponItem
items.summary: Removes magazine from the specified muzzle. It is possible to remove magazine directly from 'Throw' muzzle provided it is configured with `keepInInventory = 0;`.

items.name: removeWeaponTurret
items.summary: Removes weapon from the turret. Use turret path [-1] for driver's turret.

items.name: reportRemoteTarget
items.summary: Shares the target vehicle via datalink to the Side center for a given time.

items.name: requiredVersion
items.summary: Check if version of application is available. If the current version is older than the required one, a warning message is shown and false is returned.

items.name: resetCamShake
items.summary: Stops any ongoing camera shake effects. Does not prevent new effects from being created. To disallow new effects altogether, enableCamShake should be used.

items.name: resetSubgroupDirection
items.summary: Sets formation direction of a group relative to current direction of the group leader. The group units will change their positions to form new formation if new formation direction is different (approx +/- 15 degrees).

items.name: resistance
items.summary: Pre-defined variable for the resistance side.

items.name: resize
items.summary: Changes the size of the given array. The command does not return new array, it resizes the source array to the desired number of elements.

items.name: resources
items.summary: Returns the resources of a team member. Results are local to the PC on which command was executed.

items.name: respawnVehicle
syntax: vehicle respawnVehicle [respawnDelay, respawnCount, deleteOldWreck, respawnOnServer, respawnFlying, respawnUnit, respawnMode, respawnSide, useRespawnMarkerDir]
items.summary: Sets vehicle as respawnable in MP game (see Vehicle Respawn). The vehicle will be spawned at the locality and coordinates it was prior to destruction.

items.name: restartEditorCamera
items.summary: Restarts the mission editor camera (if it was deleted by a script,for example).

items.name: reveal
items.summary: Reveals a target to a group. If *toWhom* is a unit, unit's group is considered. If *toWhom* is a vehicle, vehicle commander's group is considered.

items.name: revealMine
items.summary: Sets given mine as known to the side. (Knowledge about a mine is always shared across all units in a side.)

items.name: reverse
items.summary: Reverses given array by reference (modifies the original array, just like resize). The alternative syntax can be used to reverse a ANSI string. If Unicode support is desired, see forceUnicode.

items.name: reversedMouseY
items.summary: Returns true if mouse vertical axe is inverted.

items.name: roadAt
items.summary: Returns a road segment containing given position, objNull otherwise. Same as isOnRoad only returns the actual road object instead of boolean.

items.name: roadsConnectedTo
items.summary: Find the road segments connected to the given road segment.

items.name: roleDescription
items.summary: Returns unit description set in the editor and visible on role selection screen in multiplayer.

items.name: ropeAttachedObjects
items.summary: Returns an array of all entities that are attached to the transport with ropes. This command is the opposite of ropeAttachedTo.

items.name: ropeAttachedTo
items.summary: Returns the owner of the first rope - the transport to which other entities are attached with ropes. This command is the opposite of ropeAttachedObjects. To return all owners see ropesAttachedTo.

items.name: ropeAttachEnabled
items.summary: Returns true if entity can be attached to a rope end.

items.name: ropeAttachTo
items.summary: Attaches entity to the rope end with optional offset. For detach operation use ropeDetach.

items.name: ropeCreate
syntax: ropeCreate [fromObject, fromPoint, toObject, toPoint, length, ropeStart, ropeEnd, ropeType, nSegments]
ropeCreate [fromObject, fromPoint, length, ropeStart, ropeEnd, ropeType, nSegments]
items.summary: Creates a PhysX rope with given params. Since Arma 3 v2.14 the optional arguments can be skipped by setting them to nil.

items.name: ropeCut
items.summary: Cuts the given rope to the specified length. If some entity was attached to the end of the rope, it will be detached.

items.name: ropeDestroy
items.summary: Destroys the given rope. If the rope is attached to a vehicle, it will be detached and then destroyed.

items.name: ropeDetach
items.summary: Detaches attached object from rope (i.e. detaches rope end from attached to it entity). See ropeAttachTo for attach operation.

items.name: ropeEndPosition
items.summary: Returns start and end positions for the given rope. If command fails, empty array `[]` is returned.

items.name: ropeLength
items.summary: Return rope length in meters (set by ropeCreate, ropeCut, ropeUnwind).

items.name: ropes
items.summary: Returns all ropes attached to a ropes owner transport vehicle.

items.name: ropesAttachedTo
items.summary: Returns the owners of all ropes attached to the cargo - the transports to which other entities are attached with ropes.

items.name: ropeSegments
items.summary: Returns provided rope's segments.

items.name: ropeUnwind
items.summary: Increases or decreases the rope length by the given amount. Use relative parameter for changing rope length +/- from current length.

items.name: ropeUnwound
items.summary: Returns false if rope length changing animation is in progress. Returns true if animation is done.

items.name: rotorsForcesRTD
items.summary: Returns force produced by rotors.

items.name: rotorsRpmRTD
items.summary: Returns rotors RPM.

items.name: round
items.summary: Rounds the provided value to the closest integer.

items.name: runInitScript
items.summary: Fades in mission screen and re-executes init.sqf and init.sqs scripts. In Eden Editor the code inside the "Init" mission attribute is executed.

items.name: safeZoneH
items.summary: Returns the height of the screen in screen measurement units. Taken from top left corner of the default viewport (0,0) of the screen and going in the same direction as the Y axis, the value will be positive but…

items.name: safeZoneW
items.summary: Returns the width of the screen in screen measurement units. Taken from top left corner of the default viewport (0,0) of the screen and going in the same direction as the X axis, the value will be positive but resulting…

items.name: safeZoneWAbs
items.summary: Returns absolute safeZoneW including all monitors.

items.name: safeZoneX
items.summary: Returns the X of the left border of the screen, which is also a distance in screen measurement units from top left corner of the default viewport (0,0) of the screen to the left border of the screen.

items.name: safeZoneXAbs
items.summary: Returns absolute safeZoneX including all monitors.

items.name: safeZoneY
items.summary: Returns the Y of the top border of the screen, which is also a distance in screen measurement units from top left corner of the default viewport (0,0) of the screen to the top border of the screen.

items.name: save3DENInventory
items.summary: Saves the current state of entities' inventory to the Mission.sqm.

items.name: save3DENPreferences
items.summary: Saves current 3DEN preferences into .3den.Arma3Profile file.

items.name: saveGame
items.summary: Autosaves the game (used for Retry). The saving is not started immediately, the request for autosave is made instead. To check the status of the request, use isSaving.

items.name: saveIdentity
items.summary: Saves units's identity to Objects.sav file in campaign directory as entry name.

items.name: saveJoysticks
items.summary: Saves joysticks key mappings into the joysticks.cfg file. Engine add these joysticks to the Joystick Scheme mapping dialog in options controls section.

items.name: saveMissionProfileNamespace
items.summary: missionProfileNamespace provides long-term storage solution for mission variables.

items.name: saveOverlay
items.summary: Save the current overlay.

items.name: saveProfileNamespace
items.summary: Saves all variables stored in profileNamespace to the active Profile.

items.name: saveStatus
items.summary: Saves object's properties to Objects.sav file in campaign directory as entry name.

items.name: saveVar
items.summary: Save variable value into the campaign space. This variable is available to all following missions in the campaign.

items.name: savingEnabled
items.summary: Check if saving the game is enabled.

items.name: say
items.summary: Make unit say given sound. The sound is defined in CfgSounds. If the unit is a person, it will also perform the corresponding lipsync effect provided an appropriate .lip file has been created for this sound.

items.name: say2D
items.summary: Plays given sound in 2D.

items.name: say3D
items.summary: Lets an object say given sound in 3D space. This allows broadcasting of positional music or sound from a source, without having to script a fade sound or music command. The source has to be alive.

items.name: scopeName
items.summary: Defines name of current scope. Name is visible in debugger, and name is also used as reference in some commands like breakOut and breakTo. Scope name should be defined only once per scope.

items.name: score
items.summary: Returns the person's score in MP.

items.name: scoreSide
items.summary: Returns score for the given side. MP Only.

items.name: screenshot
items.summary: Takes a screenshot of the 3D scene and saves it to the provided filename. - Only the 3D scene is captured, no GUI/cursor - Sampling is taken in consideration: a 200% sampling value on a 1920x1080 resolution takes a…

items.name: screenToWorld
items.summary: Returns the position on landscape (PositionAGL) corresponding to the given point on screen (in UI coordinates).

items.name: screenToWorldDirection
items.summary: Returns the 3D vector in world corresponding to the given point on the screen (in UI coordinates), as if the vector was aiming from the camera to the screen position.

items.name: scriptDone
items.summary: Check if a script is finished running using the Script Handle returned by execVM or spawn.

items.name: scriptName
items.summary: Assign a user friendly name to the VM script this command is executed from.

items.name: scriptNull
items.summary: A non-existing or completed Script Handle. To compare non-existent scripts use isNull or isEqualTo:

items.name: scudState
items.summary: Return the current state of given Scud launcher.

items.name: secondaryWeapon
items.summary: Returns the name of a unit's secondary weapon (launcher). To detect the weapon which is currently being used by the unit use currentWeapon.

items.name: secondaryWeaponItems
items.summary: Returns array with all items assigned to the secondaryWeapon except magazines. Use secondaryWeaponMagazine command for the latter. This command is used for infantry weapons only.

items.name: secondaryWeaponMagazine
items.summary: Collects all loaded magazines from all secondaryWeapon muzzles and returns them in Array, otherwise it returns []. This command is used for infantry weapons only.

items.name: select
items.summary: Selects an element from an array, config entry from Config or substring from a string or a range from an array.

items.name: selectBestPlaces
items.summary: Find the places with the maximum value of *expression* in the given area. Places can be on water. Results are sorted by value. Search pattern is randomised every command execution.

items.name: selectDiarySubject
items.summary: Selects a subject page in the diary. The subject page is selected but the command does not open the map by default, which could be opened with openMap if necessary.

items.name: selectedEditorObjects
items.summary: Returns a list of currently selected editor objects.

items.name: selectEditorObject
items.summary: Select an editor object. Does not un-select previously selected objects.

items.name: selectionNames
items.summary: Returns the list of model selections. When using default syntax, the named selections are returned from the first LOD only (LOD index 0).

items.name: selectionPosition
items.summary: Returns selection position in model space pertaining to the current animation in render time scope.

items.name: selectionVectorDirAndUp
items.summary: Searches for selection in the object model's LOD level, and returns the Direction and Up vectors in model space.

items.name: selectLeader
items.summary: Select the group's leader. Group locality can be checked with local command and group ownership with groupOwner command.

items.name: selectMax
items.summary: Returns the array element with maximum numerical value. Engine solution to BIS_fnc_greatestNum and BIS_fnc_findExtreme. Therefore it is expected that supplied array consists of Numbers only.

items.name: selectMin
items.summary: Returns the array element with minimum numerical value. Engine solution to BIS_fnc_lowestNum and BIS_fnc_findExtreme. Therefore it is expected that supplied array consists of Numbers only.

items.name: selectNoPlayer
items.summary: Switches player to no unit, makes player return objNull.

items.name: selectPlayer
items.summary: Move player into given unit. Some usage advices: - Avoid using selectPlayer on editor-placed units in multiplayer, as it may, on occasion, lead to some undefined behaviour.

items.name: selectRandom
items.summary: Returns a random element from the given array. Engine solution to BIS_fnc_selectRandom

items.name: selectRandomWeighted
items.summary: Returns a random element from the given array according to assigned weights. Engine solution to BIS_fnc_selectRandomWeighted.

items.name: selectThrowable
items.summary: Selects current throwable, which will be launched if the user presses <kbd>G</kbd>.

items.name: selectWeapon
items.summary: Selects the given weapon.

items.name: selectWeaponTurret
items.summary: Selects the given weapon on the specified turret. Use turret path [-1] for the driver's turret.

items.name: sendAUMessage
items.summary: Send the command to the list of clients.

items.name: sendSimpleCommand
items.summary: Sends a simple command to the vehicle's driver / gunner (air vehicles ignore it). See also vehicleMoveInfo.

items.name: sendTask
items.summary: Create a new AI task (subtask of parentTask). Type is name of registered task type.

items.name: sendTaskResult
items.summary: Send a result of the task to the task sender.

items.name: sendUDPMessage
items.summary: Send message to given address using UDP protocol. Returns false if the message has not been delivered

items.name: sentencesEnabled
items.summary: A getter for enableSentences.

items.name: serverCommand
items.summary: Executes the given server command. Requires you to be logged-in admin as client to execute on a client, or provide the serverCommandPassword with the serverCommand execution as client/server to basically also get logged…

items.name: serverCommandAvailable
items.summary: Returns true if given serverCommand is available on current machine, false if not.

items.name: serverCommandExecutable
items.summary: Returns true if the serverCommand can be performed on the machine and in this exact environment, otherwise false.

items.name: serverName
items.summary: Returns name of the hosting server in MP, "" in SP.

items.name: serverNamespace
items.summary: Returns server's namespace. This namespace is only available on the server for the server's uptime duration (same as uiNamespace).

items.name: serverTime
items.summary: Returns the time since latest server (re)start in seconds.

items.name: set
items.summary: Changes the element at the given zero-based index of the array.

items.name: set3DENAttachedCursorEntity
items.summary: Attach an entity to the Eden Editor cursor.

items.name: set3DENAttribute
items.summary: Sets one of entity attributes. For the list of all attributes with their properties see Setting Attributes.

items.name: set3DENAttributes
items.summary: Set entity attributes. An attribute is identified by its `property` (`data` when it is engine-drive attribute) value in config. For the list of all attributes with their properties, see Setting Attributes.

items.name: set3DENGrid
items.summary: Sets the grid increment for the given transformation type.

items.name: set3DENIconsVisible
items.summary: Toggle visibility of Eden Editor icons.

items.name: set3DENLayer
items.summary: Set layer for Eden Entity.

items.name: set3DENLinesVisible
items.summary: Toggle visibility of Eden Editor lines.

items.name: set3DENLogicType
items.summary: Sets the new type of Logic object(s). For other objects use set3DENObjectType.

items.name: set3DENMissionAttribute
items.summary: Set scenario attribute. An attribute is identified by its `property` (`data` when it is engine-drive attribute) value in config. For the list of all attributes with their properties, see Setting Attributes.

items.name: set3DENMissionAttributes
items.summary: Set scenario attributes. An attribute is identified by its `property` (`data` when it is an engine-driven attribute) value in config. For the list of all attributes with their properties, see Mission Attributes.

items.name: set3DENModelsVisible
items.summary: Enables or disables trigger area visibility.

items.name: set3DENObjectType
items.summary: Sets the classname of one or more given Eden Editor objects. For Logic objects use set3DENLogicType.

items.name: set3DENSelected
items.summary: Changes selection in Eden Editor to what is inside entities array.

items.name: setAccTime
items.summary: Set simulation acceleration coefficient. May also be used to slow time in cutscenes.

items.name: setActualCollectiveRTD
items.summary: Sets the collective pitch control to a specific position, regardless of input devices (until those are changed). - 0: collective fully down - ~0.7: approximate stable hover position - 1: collective fully up

items.name: setAirplaneThrottle
items.summary: Sets a wanted throttle position - works only on player's vehicle.

items.name: setAirportSide
items.summary: Set owning side of the airport. ID is the number to identify which airport on the island you want to check.

items.name: setAmmo
items.summary: Sets custom ammo count in the currently loaded magazine of the specified weapon or muzzle.

items.name: setAmmoCargo
items.summary: Set amount of ammo resources in cargo space of a rearm vehicle. Ammo resource is used to resupply vehicles that take ammo. Soldiers use individual magazines instead.

items.name: setAmmoOnPylon
items.summary: Set count of ammo in magazine on pylon (supports pylon name since Arma 3 v1.94)

items.name: setAngularVelocity
items.summary: Sets the angular velocity of the object in world space as a 3D vector. The units are in Rad/s and rotations are clockwise.

items.name: setAngularVelocityModelSpace
items.summary: Sets the angular velocity of the object in model space as a 3D vector. The units are in Rad/s and rotations are clockwise.

items.name: setAnimSpeedCoef
items.summary: Sets a coefficient for animation speed (0.5 will play animations half the speed, 2 twice the speed).

items.name: setAperture
items.summary: Sets custom eye accommodation camera aperture.

items.name: setApertureNew
items.summary: Sets custom camera aperture when HDR is enabled. Provided values should be set such as *minimum* <e; *standard* <e; *maximum*.

items.name: setArmoryPoints
items.summary: Stores passed number into [USERNAME].ArmaXProfile file, where it assigns it as a value to *armoryPoints* entry. If entry doesn't exist, it is created.

items.name: setAttributes
items.summary: Returns a Structured Text created from the given structured text and sets attributes to the given values.

items.name: setAutonomous
items.summary: Sets UAV autonomous mode.

items.name: setBehaviour
items.summary: Sets individual unit behaviour on every unit in a group.

items.name: setBehaviourStrong
items.summary: Sets individual unit behaviour on every unit in a group and additionally tries to force this behaviour to the unit's group. Alternatively see setCombatBehaviour.

items.name: setBleedingRemaining
items.summary: Sets for how many seconds injured unit leaves blood trail. The unit damage must be >= 0.1 for this command to have an effect, otherwise, the getBleedingRemaining will return 0 and no blood trail is left behind.

items.name: setBrakesRTD
items.summary: Enable landing gear wheel brakes for a helicopter. - value 0: brakes off - value 1: brakes on

items.name: setCameraInterest
items.summary: Set camera interest for given entity. Camera interest is by default 0. Any unit which is speaking has its camera interest raised to 50. Camera interest is used to focus camera to control depth of field in cutscenes.

items.name: setCamShakeDefParams
syntax: setCamShakeDefParams [power, duration, frequency, minSpeed, minMass, caliberCoefHit, vehicleCoef]
items.summary: Sets camera shake default parameters.

items.name: setCamShakeParams
items.summary: Sets camera shake parameters. Will not have any effect until shake is started via addCamShake.

items.name: setCamUseTI
items.summary: Sets thermal vision mode for currently used camera. This command only works with camCreate created camera that is currently the main camera for the player (see Example 2).

items.name: setCaptive
items.summary: Mark a unit as captive. If unit is a vehicle, commander is marked. A captive unit: - is seen as belonging to the civilian Side - will not be fired upon - will still shoot at its real side's enemies - will make its…

items.name: setCenterOfMass
items.summary: Changes the center of mass of an object smoothly during the given time (in seconds). A time of zero (or using the alternative syntax) means an immediate change.

items.name: setCollisionLight
items.summary: Switches collision lights of a vehicle on/off.

items.name: setCombatBehaviour
items.summary: Sets an individual unit entity behaviour (main syntax) or a group entity behaviour (alternative syntax). The group in this case is a Group entity and not a simple collection of units.

items.name: setCombatMode
items.summary: Sets AI group combat mode (engagement rules). For individual unit's combat mode see setUnitCombatMode.

items.name: setCompassDeclination
items.summary: Sets the declination angle of player's compass, which is the difference between magnetic north and true north.

items.name: setCompassOscillation
items.summary: This command sets random heading on the player's compass (both in map and in 3D view) with given frequency, which is also randomised.

items.name: setConvoySeparation
items.summary: Sets the distance to keep to the vehicle which is in front.

items.name: setCruiseControl
items.summary: Limits or sets local player-controlled vehicle's speed through cruise control.

items.name: setCuratorCameraAreaCeiling
items.summary: Sets maximal (ATL) height to which curator camera can move.

items.name: setCuratorCoef
items.summary: Sets coef for some action (coef have to be bigger than -1 000 000, anything lower is considered as disabled action).

items.name: setCuratorEditingAreaType
items.summary: Set whether curator can edit in all editing areas (true) or outside of them (false).

items.name: setCuratorSelected
items.summary: Clear and set the curator selected items. Leave the items array empty to clear curator selection.

items.name: setCuratorSelectionPreset
items.summary: Set the list of objects in the given selection preset. Only Object is supported in selection presets, unlike curatorSelected which also returns the selected Group, Waypoint, and Marker String

items.name: setCuratorWaypointCost
items.summary: Sets cost of waypoints (used for placing, editing and deleting).

items.name: setCurrentChannel
items.summary: Sets given channel as current chat channel. Scripted way of selecting desired channel on the UI.

items.name: setCurrentTask
items.summary: Set the task as a current task of the person.

items.name: setCurrentWaypoint
items.summary: Sets the currently active waypoint for a group.

items.name: setCustomAimCoef
items.summary: Set custom aim precision coefficient for weapon sway

items.name: setCustomMissionData
items.summary: Defines custom mission text that is sent to Arma 3: Analytics.

items.name: setCustomSoundController
items.summary: Sets value of the specified custom sound controller to be used in simple expressions in config.

items.name: setCustomWeightRTD
items.summary: Add virtual custom weight to a helicopter's center of gravity. This can be used to simulate added internal payload for specific scenarios, and affects the flight model.

items.name: setDamage
syntax: object setDamage [damage, useEffects, killer, instigator, allowResurrection]
items.summary: Sets the damage (or lack thereof) of an object/unit. The alternative syntax allows to skip destruction effects for vehicles and buildings and set a tree/pole/wall fall direction (away from *killer*).

items.name: setDammage
items.summary: Entirely identical to setDamage that was introduced to fix a typographical error in the command's name.

items.name: setDate
items.summary: Sets mission date and time. Players joining after mission start will get the current server date including the year.

items.name: setDebriefingText
syntax: endType setDebriefingText [title, description, subtitle, picture, background]
items.summary: Sets debriefing title, text, subtitle, picture and background for a mission ending.

items.name: setDefaultCamera
items.summary: Sets the position and direction for the camera used after camera is set on no object (log out view when leaving MP game for example)

items.name: setDestination
items.summary: Set the destination for path planning of the pilot.

items.name: setDetailMapBlendPars
items.summary: Sets the detail texture map blend pars. Allows for smooth transition between detailed and undetailed terrain texture at distance.

items.name: setDiaryRecordText
items.summary: Set text of a log record.

items.name: setDiarySubjectPicture
items.summary: Sets a picture to be displayed on the right of the Diary subject. The picture can also be set during custom Diary subject creation, but this command also allows to change icon for the fixed subjects, like "Tasks",…

items.name: setDir
items.summary: Sets object heading. Angles are measured in degrees clockwise from north; the regular range goes from 0 to 360 (0° = N, 90° = E, 180° = S, 270° = W). Negative angles represent counter-clockwise angles.

items.name: setDirection
items.summary: Sets the orientation of a location. The location's area and map icon (if its type uses an icon) will be rotated to this orientation.

items.name: setDrawIcon
items.summary: Set the icon to be shown in 2D editor for the specified editor object. If maintain size is false,icon will not scale depending on the scale,of the map.

items.name: setDriveOnPath
items.summary: Sets the path to follow for AI driver. Note that unitReady will return true even if AI is still driving through the points.

items.name: setDropInterval
items.summary: Set interval of emitting particles from particle source. In Arma 3 hardcoded limit of how many particles can exist at the same time is 18000. Correspondence between CfgCloudlets class param name and command param:

items.name: setDynamicSimulationDistance
items.summary: Sets activation distance of Arma 3: Dynamic Simulation for given category.

items.name: setDynamicSimulationDistanceCoef
items.summary: Sets activation distance multiplier of Arma 3: Dynamic Simulation for the given class

items.name: setEditorMode
items.summary: Sets map mode to MAP,3D or PREVIEW.

items.name: setEditorObjectScope
syntax: map setEditorObjectScope [objects, editorType, condition, scope, subordinatesAlso]
items.summary: This command defines the level of access a user has to editor objects.

items.name: setEffectCondition
items.summary: The statement is executed when the trigger or waypoint is activated and the effects are launched depending on the result.

items.name: setEffectiveCommander
items.summary: Sets effectiveCommander of the given vehicle. Effective commander is the person who commands the vehicle, i.e. gives commands to the driver.

items.name: setEngineRpmRTD
items.summary: Sets the RPM of given engines.

items.name: setFace
items.summary: Set person's face. For a list of available faces, check CfgIdentities or `CfgFaces` config. If the face is non-existent, the face is set to 'Default' and the error is logged in the .rpt file.

items.name: setFaceAnimation
items.summary: Sets facial animation phase (eye blinking).

items.name: setFatigue
items.summary: Sets the person's fatigue, from 0 to 1.

items.name: setFeatureType
items.summary: Enable/disable object as a feature/landmark. Possible feature types: - 0 - Feature disabled - 1 - Object is always visible within object view distance - 2 - Object is always visible within terrain view distance

items.name: setFlagAnimationPhase
items.summary: Sets flag position on the flag pole. To animate flag use BIS_fnc_animateFlag.

items.name: setFlagOwner
items.summary: Sets flag owner. When owner is set to objNull or any object other than a unit of class man or logic, flag is returned to the flagpole. A flag owned by a logic has no visual representation.

items.name: setFlagSide
items.summary: Sets flag Side. A flag may be taken by any unit that is enemy to the side that owns the flag.

items.name: setFlagTexture
items.summary: Sets flag texture.

items.name: setFog
items.summary: Smoothly change the fog over given time (in seconds). See also fogParams.

items.name: setFormation
items.summary: Set group formation.

items.name: setFormationTask
items.summary: Set the current task of the formation member.

items.name: setFormDir
items.summary: Sets group formation heading. Accepted heading range is 0 to 360. Formation is facing this direction unless enemy is seen. When group is moving, this value is overridden by movement direction.

items.name: setFriend
items.summary: Sets how friendly a side is with another. The friendliness is set for one side, not for the other. See also Side Relations.

items.name: setFromEditor
items.summary: Set if given team member was inserted directly from editor.

items.name: setFSMVariable
items.summary: Set variable to given value in the variable space of given FSM.

items.name: setFuel
items.summary: Sets fuel level.

items.name: setFuelCargo
items.summary: Sets fuel amount in cargo space of refuel vehicles. Note that the carrying capacity of each side's refuel trucks differ.

items.name: setFuelConsumptionCoef
items.summary: Sets the fuel consumption coefficient, which is a multiplier of the fuel consumption rate in config. It doesn't affect fuel leakage or refueling.

items.name: setGroupIcon
items.summary: Sets group icon properties. Since Arma 3 v2.22 the offset can be set separately for 2d and 3d.

items.name: setGroupIconParams
items.summary: Set group icons parameters.

items.name: setGroupIconsSelectable
items.summary: Sets if group icons raise onGroupIconClick, onGroupIconOverEnter and onGroupIconOverLeave events.

items.name: setGroupIconsVisible
items.summary: Sets if group icons added with addGroupIcon are visible on map and in the HUD.

items.name: setGroupId
items.summary: Sets the group radio callsign, how it will be displayed in radio chat. Two groups on the same side cannot have the same callsign (possible on different sides) - see #Example 4.

items.name: setGroupIdGlobal
items.summary: A global equivalent of setGroupId.

items.name: setGroupOwner
items.summary: Changes the ownership of a group (and all its units) to a given client. The group leader must not be a player. This command only works when called from the server. Returns true if locality was changed.

items.name: setGusts
items.summary: Changes the gusts value smoothly during the given time (in seconds). A time of zero means there will be an immediate change.

items.name: setHideBehind
items.summary: Sets the data for hiding. objectWhereHide can be taken using findCover. hidePosition can be taken using getHideFrom. Command is not functional in Arma 2.

items.name: setHit
syntax: object setHit [part, damage, useEffects, killer, instigator, breakRotor]
items.summary: Set damage on a part of an object.

items.name: setHitIndex
syntax: vehicle setHitIndex [hitPartIndex, damage, useEffects, killer, instigator, breakRotor]
items.summary: Sets the current level of damage for a specific Hit Point. All hit points can be obtained with getAllHitPointsDamage command.

items.name: setHitPointDamage
syntax: vehicle setHitPointDamage [hitPointName, damage, useEffects, killer, instigator, breakRotor]
items.summary: Set the current level of damage for a specific Hit Point (specified by its config class). This command has no effect when allowDamage is set to false.

items.name: setHorizonParallaxCoef
items.summary: Sets coef used to shift horizon position based on camera height (use 0 to disable shifting).

items.name: setHUDMovementLevels
syntax: setHUDMovementLevels [minSpeed, maxSpeed, minAlt, maxAlt, minDir, maxDir, targetOrPosition]
items.summary: Set min/max movement borders displayed in HUD gauges. Use -1 to skip some value.

items.name: setHumidity
items.summary: Sets surface humidity. Affects how footsteps sound (dry / wet). humidity is increasing when raining and decreasing when not raining. Exception is if the rain is set with 'snow' flag, then humidity is not updated.

items.name: setIdentity
items.summary: Sets identity of a person. The identities could be defined in a custom config in Description.ext or in the main config. For a list of available main config values see CfgIdentities.

items.name: setImportance
items.summary: Sets the importance value of location.

items.name: setInfoPanel
items.summary: Opens given component or first component of given component type on specified info panel.

items.name: setJointDriveAngularVelocity
items.summary: Requires that a swing+twist or SLERP "drive" has been configured in attachChild. Sets the joints target angular velocity (orientation relative to the joint's own orientation).

items.name: setJointDriveLinearVelocity
items.summary: Requires that a linear "drive" has been configured in attachChild. Sets the joints target velocity (orientation relative to the joint's own orientation).

items.name: setJointDriveOrientation
items.summary: Requires that a swing+twist or SLERP "drive" has been configured in attachChild. Sets the joints target orientation (relative to the joint's own orientation).

items.name: setJointDrivePosition
items.summary: Requires that a linear "drive" has been configured in attachChild. Sets the joints target position (relative to the joint's own position).

items.name: setLeader
items.summary: Set the leader of the given Team. Effect is local, unless both leader unit and team are local to PC on which command is executed, then effect is global.

items.name: setLightAmbient
items.summary: Set ambient color of light. This includes surfaces that face away from the light, unlike setLightColor.

items.name: setLightAttenuation
syntax: light setLightAttenuation [start, constant, linear, quadratic, hardlimitstart, hardlimitend]
items.summary: Sets attenuation of light. Standard method of attenuation (1 / (constant + linear*dist + quadratic*dist*dist)). *start* param represents distance where the attenuation starts to take effects (dist = distance - start).

items.name: setLightBrightness
items.summary: Set brightness of light. Does nothing for light reflector, for light point the formula is setLightIntensity ((brightness * 50) ^ 2)

items.name: setLightColor
items.summary: Set diffuse color of light. Illuminates surfaces that are facing the light.

items.name: setLightConePars
items.summary: Sets the `1. lightreflector`'s cone params.

items.name: setLightDayLight
items.summary: Sets if light can be used during the day.

items.name: setLightFlareMaxDistance
items.summary: Sets max distance where the flare is visible.

items.name: setLightFlareSize
items.summary: Sets relative size of the flare for the light.

items.name: setLightIntensity
items.summary: Sets intensity of light directly. setLightBrightness uses setLightIntensity internally, therefore avoid using setLightBrightness alltogether to avoid confusion

items.name: setLightIR
items.summary: Sets lightpoint in infrared range.

items.name: setLightnings
items.summary: Changes the lightnings value smoothly during the given time (in seconds). A time of zero means there will be an immediate change.

items.name: setLightUseFlare
items.summary: Sets if light has flare.

items.name: setLightVolumeShape
items.summary: Sets the `1. lightreflector`'s volume shape. An empty shape will switch the light off.

items.name: setLocalWindParams
items.summary: Sets parameters for helicopter rotor wash. It affects the visual effect of a rotor's downwash, such as blown particles, vegetation wind effect and area size.

items.name: setMagazineTurretAmmo
items.summary: Sets ammo count to given amount for given turret magazine.

items.name: setMarkerAlpha
items.summary: Sets the marker alpha. This is a modifier to the existing markerColor and will be applied on top of the marker color alpha. The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

items.name: setMarkerAlphaLocal
items.summary: Sets the marker alpha. See setMarkerAlpha.

items.name: setMarkerBrush
items.summary: Selects the fill texture for the marker ("RECTANGLE" or "ELLIPSE"). Brush is the name of the subclass in `CfgMarkerBrushes`.

items.name: setMarkerBrushLocal
items.summary: Selects the fill texture for the marker ("RECTANGLE" or "ELLIPSE"). Brush is the name of the subclass in CfgMarkerBrushes.

items.name: setMarkerColor
items.summary: Set marker's colour. Arma 3's marker colour names and their corresponding RGBA values can be found here: Arma 3: CfgMarkerColors.

items.name: setMarkerColorLocal
items.summary: Set marker's colour. Arma 3's marker colour names and their corresponding RGBA values can be found here: Arma 3: CfgMarkerColors.

items.name: setMarkerDir
items.summary: Sets the orientation of the marker. Angle is in degrees.

items.name: setMarkerDirLocal
items.summary: Sets the orientation of the marker.

items.name: setMarkerDrawPriority
items.summary: Sets marker draw priority. Higher priority markers are drawn on top. Default priority is 0.

items.name: setMarkerPolyline
items.summary: Sets a polyline marker's path.

items.name: setMarkerPolylineLocal
items.summary: Sets a polyline marker's path. Works only on the computer that executes this command.

items.name: setMarkerPos
items.summary: Moves the marker. If position is given in 3D format, `z` coordinate is stored with the marker and will be used when marker is passed to commands like createVehicle, createUnit, createAgent, createMine,…

items.name: setMarkerPosLocal
items.summary: Moves the marker. If position is given in 3D format, `z` coordinate is stored with the marker and will be used when marker is passed to commands like createVehicle, createUnit, createAgent, createMine,…

items.name: setMarkerShadow
items.summary: Sets the shadow property of given marker.

items.name: setMarkerShadowLocal
items.summary: Sets the shadow property of given marker.

items.name: setMarkerShape
items.summary: Selects shape (actual type) of the marker. Non-existing marker shape defaults to "RECTANGLE".

items.name: setMarkerShapeLocal
items.summary: Selects shape (actual type) of the local marker. Non-existing marker shape defaults to "RECTANGLE".

items.name: setMarkerSize
items.summary: Sets the marker's size.

items.name: setMarkerSizeLocal
items.summary: Set marker size.

items.name: setMarkerText
items.summary: Sets the text label of an existing marker.

items.name: setMarkerTextLocal
items.summary: Sets the text label of an existing marker.

items.name: setMarkerType
items.summary: Sets marker type. Marker type is a class name from CfgMarkers.

items.name: setMarkerTypeLocal
items.summary: Sets marker type locally. Marker type is a class name in CfgMarkers.

items.name: setMass
items.summary: Changes the mass of a PhysX object. When using the alternative syntax the mass change is gradual during the given time. A time of zero means immediate change.

items.name: setMaxLoad
items.summary: Sets maximum load limit for a uniform/vest/backpack containers, vehicle cargo, supply boxes and weapon holders. In MP this command should be executed on the server and will persist on given container for JIP.

items.name: setMimic
items.summary: Sets person's facial expression. To set it back to default, use "".

items.name: setMissileTarget
items.summary: Sets a guided missile target. Does not work for all types of missiles. If the target is dead, it is ignored. The target has to be inside the missile's configured targeting cone for the command to work.

items.name: setMissileTargetPos
items.summary: Sets a guided munition target position. The munition must have `manualControl` config entry to use this command. The target position has to be inside the missile's configured targeting cone for the command to work.

items.name: setMissionOptions
items.summary: Sets various mission options. The options are automatically reset between missions and are saved/restored with the save system.

items.name: setMousePosition
items.summary: Moves mouse pointer to specified position on the screen. x and y could be any number, but will be clipped so mouse never leaves the screen area.

items.name: setMusicEffect
items.summary: Defines a music track played on activation. If another track is playing already, this will stop it and start the new track.

items.name: setMusicEventHandler
items.summary: Sets given music track event handler. Will overwrite other music event handlers.

items.name: setName
items.summary: Sets the name of a location or a person (person only in single player).

items.name: setNameSound
items.summary: Sets the nameSound of a person. By default, when giving orders, the units are addressed by their number. When nameSound is set, it will be used instead to address the unit.

items.name: setObjectArguments
items.summary: Set object arguments in mission editor.

items.name: setObjectMaterial
items.summary: Sets material of object selection. The selection number is defined through the hiddenselection[] = {} array in the vehicle's config (starting with 0).

items.name: setObjectMaterialGlobal
items.summary: Set the material of the given selection on all computers in a network session.

items.name: setObjectProxy
items.summary: Set the proxy object associated with the given editor object.

items.name: setObjectScale
items.summary: Scales an attached object or a Simple Object's model - see #Example 3 for various configurations' examples.

items.name: setObjectTexture
items.summary: Applies given texture to object's selection. See also Procedural Textures and Retexturing with setObjectTexture.

items.name: setObjectTextureGlobal
items.summary: Set the texture of the given selection on all computers in a network session.

items.name: setObjectViewDistance
items.summary: Sets the rendering distance of objects and shadows.

items.name: setOpticsMode
items.summary: Sets the optic mode of the current weapon to the given class name or the index.

items.name: setOvercast
items.summary: Set overcast to given value smoothly during given time (in seconds). Zero time means immediate change. An overcast setting of zero means clear (sunny) weather, and one means storms and rain are very likely.

items.name: setOwner
items.summary: From server machine, change the ownership of an object to a given client. Using command in an unintended way will log a message to .rpt file.

items.name: setOxygenRemaining
items.summary: Sets oxygen remaining. It has no effect when soldier is not diving.

items.name: setParticleCircle
items.summary: Updates particle source, creates particles in circle with given radius. Velocity is transformed and added to total velocity. The random particle positioning is calculated in relation to the nearest surface.

items.name: setParticleClass
items.summary: Sets particle source parameters using existing particle config from `CfgCloudlets` class. Use setParticleParams subsequently if you need to overwrite some values.

items.name: setParticleFire
items.summary: Set fire parameters to particle effect.

items.name: setParticleParams
items.summary: Set parameters to particle source. Array is in format ParticleArray.

items.name: setParticleRandom
syntax: particleSource setParticleRandom [lifeTime, position, moveVelocity, rotationVelocity, size, color, directionPeriod, directionIntensity, angle, bounceOnSurface]
items.summary: Sets randomization of particle source parameters. Correspondence between CfgCloudlets class param names and command array of params:

items.name: setPhysicsCollisionFlag
items.summary: Sets physics collision flags for PhysX and geometry LODs. Roadway LOD interactions remain.

items.name: setPilotCameraDirection
items.summary: Sets the direction of airplane's or helicopter's pilotCamera.

items.name: setPilotCameraOpticsMode
items.summary: Sets the optics mode index (zoom) for the pilotCamera

items.name: setPilotCameraRotation
items.summary: Sets rotation (relative to the centered camera position) of the object airplane or helicopter pilotCamera .

items.name: setPilotCameraTarget
items.summary: Sets an area or target to be tracked by the object airplane or helicopter pilotCamera. To track an object the vehicle has to have appropriate sensors (scanners) that can detect the given target type.

items.name: setPilotLight
items.summary: Switches headlights of a vehicle on/off. Note that the vehicle has to be local, for global variant use Arma 3: Actions "LightOn"/"LightOff"

items.name: setPiPEffect
items.summary: Sets Render Target's visual effect (Picture-in-Picture).

items.name: setPiPViewDistance
items.summary: Set the PiP (Picture-in-Picture) view distance. This has no impact if PiP is disabled (see isPiPEnabled).

items.name: setPitch
items.summary: Sets the pitch of a persons voice.

items.name: setPlateNumber
items.summary: Change the license plates on any vehicle which has plates configured. Max 15 characters are allowed!

items.name: setPlayable
items.summary: Create a multiplayer role for the unit. The roles created this way are used for Join In Progress and Team Switch.

items.name: setPlayerRespawnTime
items.summary: Sets the time interval (in seconds) that the player must wait before respawn, for the next respawn only. It resets to mission default on mission start.

items.name: setPlayerVoNVolume
items.summary: Sets provided player's Voice over Network (VoN) volume.

items.name: setPos
items.summary: Sets object position to format PositionAGLS (over surface). The Z value is used to calculate the nearest surface below the provided position. If the surface is close, it uses the Z position of the surface.

items.name: setPosASL
items.summary: Sets the object position above sea level. Given position must be in PositionASL format.

items.name: setPosASL2
items.summary: Sets the object position. The pos array uses the PositionASL format. The version of the command does not offset based on object center.

items.name: setPosASLW
items.summary: Sets the object position above sea surface. The pos array uses the PositionASLW format.

items.name: setPosATL
items.summary: Sets the position of an object relative to the terrain.

items.name: setPosition
items.summary: Sets the position of a location.

items.name: setPosWorld
items.summary: Sets position of an object based on the model's centre position (see getPosWorld).

items.name: setPylonLoadout
items.summary: Adds/overrides loadout to a vehicle pylon. `TransportPylonsComponent` in vehicle config and `pylonWeapon` in the magazine config are required to run.

items.name: setPylonsPriority
items.summary: Overrides default pylons priorities.

items.name: setRadioMsg
items.summary: Sets radio trigger menu title text (0 -> 0 -> map radio). Use "NULL" to disable radio slot. Use "" to restore default title.

items.name: setRain
items.summary: Sets rain density smoothly over the given transition time. A transition time of zero means an immediate change. A rain density of zero is no rain, one is maximum rain. Rain is not possible when overcast is less than 0.7.

items.name: setRainbow
items.summary: Changes the rainbow value smoothly during the given time (in seconds). A time of zero means there will be an immediate change.

items.name: setRandomLip
items.summary: Enables/Disables random lip. When enabled, the unit continuously moves its lips as if it is talking.

items.name: setRank
items.summary: Sets rank of given unit.

items.name: setRectangular
items.summary: Set the shape of a location to be either rectangular or elliptical. Locations default shape is elliptical.

items.name: setRepairCargo
items.summary: Set amount of repair resources in cargo space of repair vehicle. Amount 1 is full cargo.

items.name: setRotorBrakeRTD
items.summary: Toggles a helicopter's rotor brake.

items.name: setShadowDistance
items.summary: Sets the shadows rendering distance.

items.name: setShotParents
items.summary: Sets vehicle and instigator pair for the given projectile.

items.name: setSide
items.summary: Sets a location's side. The default side is Unknown.

items.name: setSimpleTaskAlwaysVisible
items.summary: Sets task's visibility.

items.name: setSimpleTaskCustomData
items.summary: Set custom data for the task. Tooltip will be drawn in task list on the right side. Description will be drawn in task description panel on the bottom.

items.name: setSimpleTaskDescription
items.summary: Attach descriptions to the simple task.

items.name: setSimpleTaskDestination
items.summary: Attach a destination to the simple task. Overrides setSimpleTaskTarget

items.name: setSimpleTaskTarget
items.summary: Attach a target to the simple task. Overrides setSimpleTaskDestination.

items.name: setSimpleTaskType
items.summary: Attach type to the simple task. See Default Task Types.

items.name: setSimulWeatherLayers
items.summary: Sets number of simul weather layers, affects quality of simul weather clouds.

items.name: setSize
items.summary: Sets the size (radius) of a location.

items.name: setSkill
items.summary: Sets the skill level of given unit. The value of a sub-skill is interpolated into a range defined in CfgAISkill.

items.name: setSlingLoad
items.summary: Creates a sling loading from a helicopter to an entity if possible. To unload cargo, pass objNull as second param.

items.name: setSoundEffect
items.summary: Defines the different sound effects for a trigger or a waypoint. To stop any sound, deactivate the trigger (might take up to 0.5 seconds to stop) or delete the trigger/waypoint (immediate).

items.name: setSpeaker
items.summary: Sets the speaker of a person.

items.name: setSpeech
items.summary: Add speech to location.

items.name: setSpeedMode
items.summary: Sets group speed mode. If unit is passed as param, unit's group is used. Mode may be one of: - "UNCHANGED" (unchanged) - "LIMITED" (half speed) - "NORMAL" (full speed, maintain formation) - "FULL" (do not wait for any…

items.name: setStamina
items.summary: Set units' stamina (seconds until depletion)

items.name: setStaminaScheme
items.summary: Sets the scheme used for the Stamina system.

items.name: setStatValue
items.summary: Sets a value to a given stat.

items.name: setSuppression
items.summary: Sets the given suppression value for the given unit.

items.name: setSystemOfUnits
items.summary: Set system of units. This will only impact gauges from advanced flight model.

items.name: setTargetAge
items.summary: Sets how the target is known to the other centers. They behave like the target was seen age seconds ago.

items.name: setTargetSize
items.summary: Sets target size (see `irTargetSize` and others from vehicle config) override on vehicle.

items.name: setTaskMarkerOffset
items.summary: Sets the task marker position in model space.

items.name: setTaskResult
items.summary: Set a result of the task.

items.name: setTaskState
items.summary: Set the state of a given task.

items.name: setTerrainGrid
items.summary: Sets the desired terrain resolution in meters.

items.name: setTerrainHeight
items.summary: Set the current terrain's altitude on provided location(s).

items.name: setText
items.summary: Sets the text associated with a location. This text will be displayed on the game map at the location's position.

items.name: setTimeMultiplier
items.summary: Sets a time multiplier for in-game time. The command range is capped at 0.1 - 120 to avoid performance problems.

items.name: setTIParameter
items.summary: Sets the provided Thermal Imaging parameter's value.

items.name: setTitleEffect
items.summary: Defines the title effect to show on activation via [Type, Effect, Text] where

items.name: setTowParent
items.summary: Allows a vehicle to be towed by another. This loosens the towed vehicle's brakes and turns its steering wheels toward the towing vehicle. Supposed to be used together with a rope connecting both vehicles.

items.name: setTrafficDensity
items.summary: Set the density of ambient cars in a rectangle (in cars per kilometer).

items.name: setTrafficDistance
items.summary: Set maximum ambient traffic draw distance (in 2D).

items.name: setTrafficGap
items.summary: Set the average gap between ambient cars in a rectangle (in meters).

items.name: setTrafficSpeed
items.summary: Set ambient traffic speed in a rectangle (in kilometers per hour).

items.name: setTriggerActivation
items.summary: Defines the trigger activation type.

items.name: setTriggerArea
syntax: trigger setTriggerArea [a, b, angle, isRectangle, c]
items.summary: Defines the area monitored by the given trigger. The area could be either rectangular or elliptical.

items.name: setTriggerInterval
items.summary: Sets the interval in seconds for trigger condition check.

items.name: setTriggerStatements
items.summary: Defines trigger condition, activation and deactivation statements. Trigger condition has to return Boolean. true will activate the trigger, false will deactivate it (only if activation is set to repeat).

items.name: setTriggerText
items.summary: Sets the text label attached to the trigger object. This is used for example as a radio slot label for radio activated triggers.

items.name: setTriggerTimeout
items.summary: Defines the time between condition satisfaction and trigger activation (randomly from min to max, with an average value mid). If the last argument is true, the condition must be fullfilled all the time.

items.name: setTriggerType
items.summary: Sets the type of action processed by the trigger after activation (no action, a waypoints switch or an end of mission):

items.name: setTurretLimits
syntax: vehicle setTurretLimits [turret, minTurn, maxTurn, minElev, maxElev, soft]
items.summary: Sets the rotation and elevation limits for the given turret. The limits are relative to model orientation of the turret. For example to allow 360 degree turning it is enough to set turn limits to (-180, 180).

items.name: setTurretOpticsMode
items.summary: Set the current optics mode of the optics in the turret occupied by the specified unit. Alternatively, you can specify a vehicle and turret path instead of a unit.

items.name: setType
items.summary: Changes a location to the specified class. Location classes are defined in CfgLocationTypes.

items.name: setUnconscious
items.summary: In Arma 2 and since Arma 3 v1.64, this command sets unit into incapacitated state.

items.name: setUnitAbility
items.summary: Sets skill of given unit. Unlike setSkill, setUnitAbility can set values > 1. Even though the skill command will correctly return set value, the actual unit ability will be capped to max available.

items.name: setUnitCombatMode
items.summary: Sets unit's combat mode (engagement rules). For AI group combat mode see setCombatMode.

items.name: setUnitFreefallHeight
items.summary: Sets minimum freefall height AGL per unit, at which the unit assumes HALO pose. Engine default is 100m. Use -1 to reset the height to default.

items.name: setUnitLoadout
items.summary: Creates a loadout from given inventory structure and applies it to a unit. When String for class name is supplied, the command will search `CfgVehicles` for the given class in order to extract the loadout from config.

items.name: setUnitPos
items.summary: Set unit position rules. This command will not change the stance of the human player, even though it will change the output of unitPos command. To change player stance use playAction or playActionNow:

items.name: setUnitPosWeak
items.summary: Set unit position rules. This command is the lowest level of priority for setting unit position and to be used in scripted FSM's. Priorities are: 1. Unit pos commanded (from the commanding menu, higher priority). 1.

items.name: setUnitRank
items.summary: Sets rank of given unit.

items.name: setUnitRecoilCoefficient
items.summary: Proportionaly increase/decrease unit's recoil. Drives muzzle up with every shot when supplied positive number and down when negative. 0 cancels recoil.

items.name: setUnitTrait
items.summary: Enables or disables a trait or alters a trait of the given unit. Unit traits consist of unit abilities, which are Booleans and modifiers, which are Numbers. Custom trait can only be a bool.

items.name: setUnloadInCombat
items.summary: Sets whether or not cargo or turret units *should* get out of vehicle when in combat. If true, vehicle will stop and units will dismount. Vehicle must be local.

items.name: setUserActionText
items.summary: Changes user added action (see addAction) menu item text.

items.name: setUserMFDText
items.summary: Stored user text value in MFD, limit is 50, user0...user49

items.name: setUserMFDValue
items.summary: When MFD is using user controllers, this command can set values on them. For example, MFD config for Blackfoot has an entry

items.name: setVariable
items.summary: Set variable to given value in the variable space of given element. Can be used to broadcast variables over the network.

items.name: setVectorDir
items.summary: Set object's direction vector. Up vector will remain unchanged.

items.name: setVectorDirAndUp
