items.summary: Sets orientation of an object. The command takes 2 vector arrays, one for vectorDir and one for vectorUp.

items.name: setVectorUp
items.summary: Set object's up vector. Direction of the object remain unchanged. Default object's vectorUp is [0,0,1].

items.name: setVehicleAmmo
items.summary: Sets how much ammunition (compared to a full state defined by the vehicle type) the vehicle has. Note that the ammo will be added only to local turrets. To check locality of turret use turretLocal.

items.name: setVehicleAmmoDef
items.summary: Sets how much ammunition (compared to the configuration of magazines defined in the vehicle's class) the vehicle has. Note that the ammo will only be added to local turrets.

items.name: setVehicleArmor
items.summary: Sets the armor (or health for men) state of the vehicle (a value from 0 to 1).

items.name: setVehicleCargo
items.summary: Load cargo vehicle inside vehicle if possible, returns bool based on whether the vehicle was able to be loaded. Can also be used to unload a specific loaded vehicle or all loaded vehicles.

items.name: setVehicleId
items.summary: Sets ID to vehicle. By this ID vehicle is referenced by triggers and waypoints.

items.name: setVehicleLock
items.summary: Sets vehicle lock. Possible values:

items.name: setVehiclePosition
items.summary: Moves the object to a given position (same as createVehicle placement algorithm). Uses either the position that's defined by the *position* param, or one of the marker positions from the markers array.

items.name: setVehicleRadar
items.summary: Sets the AI rule of Radar usage (Emission Control). Automatic means Radar switched on only when in Combat. The command doesn't affect player-controlled vehicles.

items.name: setVehicleReceiveRemoteTargets
items.summary: Sets that the vehicle will be able to receive targets acquired by someone else via datalink from the Side center.

items.name: setVehicleReportOwnPosition
items.summary: Sets that the vehicle will share its own position via datalink to the Side center.

items.name: setVehicleReportRemoteTargets
items.summary: Sets that the vehicle will share targets that were acquired by its own sensors via datalink to the Side center.

items.name: setVehicleTIPars
items.summary: Sets the "heat" state of different vehicle parts for Thermal Imaging detection.

items.name: setVehicleVarName
items.summary: Sets string representation of an object to a custom string.

items.name: setVelocity
items.summary: Sets velocity vector of an object in m/s.

items.name: setVelocityModelSpace
items.summary: Sets the velocity (i.e. speed) vector of the given vehicle relative to its model.

items.name: setVelocityTransformation
syntax: object setVelocityTransformation [fromPosASL, toPosASL, fromVelocity, toVelocity, fromVectorDir, toVectorDir, fromVectorUp, toVectorUp, interval, customCenter]
items.summary: Interpolates and applies PositionASL, velocity, vectorDir and vectorUp to the given object based on the interval value.

items.name: setViewDistance
items.summary: Set rendering distance. Setting view distance to <= 0 resets the value to the client's options (set in `Options → Video → General → Visibility → Overall`).

items.name: setVisibleIfTreeCollapsed
items.summary: Sets whether or not the object is visible even if the tree is collapsed.

items.name: setWantedRPMRTD
items.summary: Tell the helicopter engine RPMs to reach the given value within a period of time. The simulation will try to reach the RPMs, but it does not guarantee it will reach the precise value!

items.name: setWaterFillPercentage
items.summary: Set an object's water filling.

items.name: setWaterLeakiness
items.summary: Set an object's water intake ratio when immersed.

items.name: setWaves
items.summary: Changes the waves value smoothly during the given time (in seconds). A time of zero means there will be an immediate change.

items.name: setWaypointBehaviour
items.summary: Switches the unit behaviour when the waypoint becomes active.

items.name: setWaypointCombatMode
items.summary: Changes a group's combat mode when the waypoint becomes active.

items.name: setWaypointCompletionRadius
items.summary: The completion radius allows units to call the waypoint completed once they are inside of the given circle. If the given radius is less than unit’s or vehicle’s configured 'precision' then the latter is used.

items.name: setWaypointDescription
items.summary: Sets the description shown in the HUD while the waypoint is active.

items.name: setWaypointForceBehaviour
items.summary: Forces the behavior of waypoint, disables AUTOCOMBAT.

items.name: setWaypointFormation
items.summary: Switches the group formation when the waypoint becomes active.

items.name: setWaypointHousePosition
items.summary: For waypoints attached to a house, this defines the target buildingPos index.

items.name: setWaypointLoiterAltitude
items.summary: Assigns loiter altitude to the provided waypoint.

items.name: setWaypointLoiterRadius
items.summary: Assignes loiter radius to waypoint

items.name: setWaypointLoiterType
items.summary: Sets the waypoint loiter type.

items.name: setWaypointName
items.summary: Changes the waypoint name.

items.name: setWaypointPosition
items.summary: Attempts to move given waypoint to a random position inside a circle with the given center and radius.

items.name: setWaypointScript
items.summary: Attaches a script to a scripted waypoint. In early versions of Arma, command consisted of a script name and additional script arguments and the script had to use SQS Syntax.

items.name: setWaypointSpeed
items.summary: Switches the group speed mode when the waypoint becomes active.

items.name: setWaypointStatements
items.summary: The waypoint is done only when the condition is fulfilled. When the waypoint is done, the statement expression is executed.

items.name: setWaypointTimeout
items.summary: Defines the time between condition satisfaction and waypoint finish (randomly from min to max, with an average value mid).

items.name: setWaypointType
items.summary: Sets the waypoint type of given waypoint.

items.name: setWaypointVisible
items.summary: Sets the visibility of the given waypoint in 3D HUD view (for map visibility see showWaypoint).

items.name: setWeaponReloadingTime
items.summary: Sets reloading phase on the given weapon's current ammo round.

items.name: setWeaponZeroing
items.summary: Sets zeroing of given weapon and muzzle for given unit or vehicle.

items.name: setWind
items.summary: Set current or permanent wind vector.

items.name: setWindDir
items.summary: Changes the wind direction smoothly.

items.name: setWindForce
items.summary: Set max. wind overall wind changes in time. A time of zero means there will be an immediate change. A wind level of zero is minimal changes and a wind level of one means that wind can change rapidly.

items.name: setWindStr
items.summary: Changes the wind strength smoothly during the given time (in seconds). A time of zero means there will be an immediate change.

items.name: setWingForceScaleRTD
items.summary: Set effectivity of wings.

items.name: setWPPos
items.summary: Sets waypoint position.

items.name: show3DIcons
items.summary: Toggle the drawing of 3D icons.

items.name: showChat
items.summary: Shows/hides the whole chat window.

items.name: showCinemaBorder
items.summary: Forces drawing of cinema borders when using custom camera camCreate. This is normally used in cutscenes to indicate player has no control.

items.name: showCommandingMenu
items.summary: Create the commanding menu described by the given config class or menu name. When the name is empty, the current menu is hidden.

items.name: showCompass
items.summary: Shows or hides the compass on the map screen, if enabled for the mission and you possess the item. (default true)

items.name: showCuratorCompass
items.summary: Hides or shows compass in curator interface.

items.name: showGPS
items.summary: Shows or hides the GPS receiver on the map screen, if enabled for the mission and you possess the item. (default false).

items.name: showHUD
syntax: showHUD [scriptedHUD, info, radar, compass, direction, menu, group, cursors, panels, kills, showIcon3D]
items.summary: Enable / disable showing of HUD. Defines visibility of weapon crosshair and any informational tags that appear when pointing the weapon at an object as well as availability of the default action menu.

items.name: showLegend
items.summary: Show/hide map legend.

items.name: showMap
items.summary: Enable Map (default true).

items.name: shownAction
items.summary: Get the internal enum of the displayed action (or 0 if none are displayed). Action enums: 1. GetInCommander 1. GetInDriver 1. GetInPilot 1. GetInGunner 1. GetInCargo 1. GetInTurret 1. Heal 1. Repair 1. Refuel 1.

items.name: shownArtilleryComputer
items.summary: Checks whether the player has the artillery computer currently open.

items.name: shownChat
items.summary: Returns true if chat window is enabled. Chat window can be disabled with showChat command.

items.name: shownCompass
items.summary: Checks if client has Compass enabled in description.ext (*showCompass* param) or force enabled with showCompass command.

items.name: shownCuratorCompass
items.summary: Returns true if compass is shown.

items.name: showNewEditorObject
items.summary: Show the add editor object dialog,type is editor object type,class is,class definition to automatically select,side filters by a certain,side,pos is position to create the object.

items.name: shownGPS
items.summary: Checks if client has GPS receiver enabled in description.ext (*showGPS* param) or force enabled with showGPS command.

items.name: shownHUD
items.summary: Returns array of Booleans corresponding to the visibility of various HUD elements (see extended showHUD).

items.name: shownMap
items.summary: Checks if client has Map enabled in description.ext (*showMap* param) or force enabled with showMap command.

items.name: shownPad
items.summary: Checks if client has Notepad enabled.

items.name: shownRadio
items.summary: Check if player has Radio enabled.

items.name: shownScoretable
items.summary: Returns the state of the score table set with showScoretable command.

items.name: shownSubtitles
items.summary: A getter for showSubtitles.

items.name: shownUAVFeed
items.summary: Returns true if video feed transmitted from UAV is shown. A getter for showUAVFeed.

items.name: shownWarrant
items.summary: Check if player has ID card enabled. Obsolete command.

items.name: shownWatch
items.summary: Checks if client has Watch enabled in description.ext (*showWatch* param) or force enabled with showWatch command.

items.name: showPad
items.summary: Shows or hides the notebook on the map screen, if enabled for the mission. (default true). It is no longer relevant to Arma 2.

items.name: showRadio
items.summary: Shows or hides the radio on the map screen, if enabled for the mission and you possess the item. (default true).

items.name: showScoretable
items.summary: Forces the score table to be shown, hidden or reset to default functionality. Forcing score table will make it show even in SP.

items.name: showSubtitles
items.summary: Enables / disables showing of subtitles in a chat. Only scripted/engine chatter is affected, player manual chat is unaffected. Returns the previous state.

items.name: showUAVFeed
items.summary: Shows/hides video feed transmitted from UAV in its custom info panel.

items.name: showWarrant
items.summary: Enable ID card.

items.name: showWatch
items.summary: Shows or hides the watch on the map screen, if enabled for the mission and you possess the item. (default true)

items.name: showWaypoint
items.summary: Defines how waypoints are shown to the player in map view. For 3D HUD visibility see setWaypointVisible.

items.name: showWaypoints
items.summary: Shows/Hides task HUD markers and waypoints that will fade out in time. Dependable on difficulty settings.

items.name: side
items.summary: Returns the side of a unit, vehicle, object or location. - side of a renegade soldier is sideEnemy - side of an empty vehicle is civilian - side of a crewed vehicle is, if present, commander's > gunner's > driver's or >…

items.name: sideAmbientLife
items.summary: Returns side of ambient life, for example ambient life placed in Eden Editor.

items.name: sideChat
items.summary: Types text to the side radio channel by the specified unit. Use clearRadio to clear chat history

items.name: sideEmpty
items.summary: Returns empty side, for example static buildings in Eden Editor.

items.name: sideEnemy
items.summary: The enemy side which is used for renegades. Units of this side are hostile to everyone. - To join sideEnemy, you can attack members of your own side or use addRating.

items.name: sideFriendly
items.summary: The Friendly side - friendly to all, see Side Relations.

items.name: sideLogic
items.summary: The Logic side. Side of Game Logics and Modules.

items.name: sideRadio
items.summary: Sends the audio message to the side radio channel. The message is defined in CfgRadio in the description.ext file or config radio protocol. The transmission will play only on the PC where command was executed.

items.name: sideUnknown
items.summary: The unknown side.

items.name: simpleTasks
items.summary: Return all simple tasks assigned to given unit.

items.name: simulationEnabled
items.summary: Check if the entity has enabled simulation.

items.name: simulCloudDensity
items.summary: Returns density of clouds at given position.

items.name: simulCloudOcclusion
items.summary: Returns clouds occlusion between two given points.

items.name: simulInClouds
items.summary: Returns if given position is in clouds.

items.name: simulSetHumidity
items.summary: Sets simul cloud cover. This command does not affect overcast value.

items.name: simulWeatherSync
items.summary: Synchronizes Simul Weather with Arma weather, generates all keyframes.

items.name: sin
items.summary: Sine of x.

items.name: size
items.summary: Returns a location's size.

items.name: sizeOf
items.summary: Returns the diameter of bounding sphere of the object of given classname in meters. If you need to estimate the size of the object more precisely, use boundingBox or boundingBoxReal.

items.name: skill
items.summary: Returns current skill of a unit, in range between 0 to 1, 1 being the highest level of skill.

items.name: skillFinal
items.summary: Returns final, recalculated sub skill value of given unit. (with regard to AI Level coefficient (Difficulty settings)).

items.name: skipTime
items.summary: Jumps the specified number of hours forward or backward. The time of day and tides are adjusted, but no changes are made to any units.

items.name: sleep
items.summary: Suspends code execution for given time in seconds. The sleep precision is given by a framerate, the delay given is the minimal delay expected. Must be called inside of a context which is interruptible, i.e.

items.name: sliderPosition
items.summary: Returns current thumb position of CT_SLIDER or CT_XSLIDER with given idc of topmost user dialog.

items.name: sliderRange
items.summary: Returns limits of CT_SLIDER or CT_XSLIDER.

items.name: sliderSetPosition
items.summary: Sets current thumb position of CT_SLIDER or CT_XSLIDER.

items.name: sliderSetRange
items.summary: Sets limits of CT_SLIDER or CT_XSLIDER.

items.name: sliderSetSpeed
items.summary: Sets slider line step and page step delta amount as well as optional step amount of CT_SLIDER or CT_XSLIDER with given idc of topmost user dialog.

items.name: sliderSpeed
items.summary: Returns slider step value for line and page movement of CT_SLIDER or CT_XSLIDER.

items.name: slingLoadAssistantShown
items.summary: Returns true if Sling Load Assistant is open.

items.name: soldierMagazines
items.summary: Get array with all magazines of the given unit.

items.name: someAmmo
items.summary: Check if unit has some ammo.

items.name: sort
items.summary: Attempts to sort given array either in ascending (true) or descending (false) order.

items.name: soundParams
items.summary: Returns various params for the given sound. The sound has to be playing otherwise command returns empty array [].

items.name: soundVolume
items.summary: Returns the current sound volume (set by fadeSound).

items.name: spawn
items.summary: Adds given set of compiled instructions to the scheduler. Exactly when the code will be executed is unknown, it depends on how busy is the engine and how filled up is the scheduler.

items.name: speaker
items.summary: Returns the speaker class name of a unit.

items.name: speechVolume
items.summary: Returns the current speech volume (set by fadeSpeech)

items.name: speed
items.summary: Object speed (in km/h). Returns relative speed of given object along Y axis. An equivalent to: `3.6 * (velocityModelSpace _obj select 1)`

items.name: speedMode
items.summary: Returns speed mode of the group, which can be any of the following: - "LIMITED" - "NORMAL" - "FULL"

items.name: splitString
items.summary: Splits the provided ANSI string into an array of tokens according to given delimiters.

items.name: sqrt
items.summary: Returns square root of x.

items.name: squadParams
items.summary: Returns data about squad of given unit loaded from squad.xml as well as the unit itself.

items.name: stance
items.summary: Returns the stance of the given unit.

items.name: startLoadingScreen
items.summary: Shows loading screen with the given text, using the given resource. While loading screen is shown, simulation and scene drawing is disabled, user control is disabled, mouse cursor is hidden, scripts run at full speed…

items.name: steamGameRecordingEvent
items.summary: Triggers a Steam Timeline event within the Game Recording feature. Read Arma 3: Steam Game Recording for more information and a list of all available event icons.

items.name: step
items.summary: Optional step value. A countdown can be made with a negative value. If not set, the default step is 1.

items.name: stop
items.summary: Stop an AI unit from turning or moving, preventing it to follow a watched object or engage an enemy properly - although if properly aligned, the unit -will- shoot the enemy.

items.name: stopEngineRTD
items.summary: Instant engines stop.

items.name: stopped
items.summary: Check if unit is stopped by stop command.

items.name: stopSound
items.summary: Terminates the given sound. If sound object provided, such as say3D and there is .lip file playback attached, this playback will also terminate.

items.name: str
items.summary: Converts any value into a string, depending on its type. If an Object has a vehicleVarName, it is returned (see #Example 4).

items.name: sunOrMoon
items.summary: Returns the moon to sun transition state in range 0..1.

items.name: supportInfo
items.summary: Creates a list of supported operators and type. Each field of array has the format: "x:name" Where x can be: - 't' - type - 'n' - nullar operator - 'u' - unary operator - 'b' - binary operator.

items.name: suppressFor
items.summary: Force suppressive fire from the unit.

items.name: surfaceIsWater
items.summary: Returns whether there is water at given position. In Arma 3, it also detects pond objects, but only if they are loaded in memory (normally only true if the objects are within the object view distance)

items.name: surfaceNormal
items.summary: Returns terrain's surface normal) on given position.

items.name: surfaceTexture
items.summary: Same as surfaceType, but returns texture path to ground texture as string.

items.name: surfaceType
items.summary: Returns what surface type is at the given position. For surface texture see surfaceTexture command.

items.name: swimInDepth
items.summary: Sets the target depth level for swimming soldier. Depth should be a negative number.

items.name: switch
items.summary: Checks if the given parameter matches any case. If so, the code block of that case will be executed. After that the switch ends so no further cases will be checked.

items.name: switchableUnits
items.summary: Returns a list of playable units available for switching to - Command is relative to the client on which it is executed and will only show playable units for the same side as player's group + player himself - In…

items.name: switchAction
items.summary: When used on a person, the given action is started immediately (there is no transition). Use switchmove "" to switch back to the default movement if there is no transition back, otherwise the person may be stuck.

items.name: switchCamera
items.summary: Switch camera to given vehicle / camera. Mode is one of: - "INTERNAL": 1st person - "GUNNER": optics / sights - "EXTERNAL": 3rd person (inaccessible if difficulty settings do not allow for it) - "GROUP": group -…

items.name: switchGesture
items.summary: When used on a person,the given move is started immediately (without transition).

items.name: switchLight
items.summary: Controls whether a lamp is lit or not.

items.name: switchMove
items.summary: Immediately applies given animation to the unit. For a smooth transition from the current animation (by connecting animations successively, e.g `CurrentAnim -> Intermediate1 -> Intermediate2 -> TargetAnim`), use…

items.name: synchronizedObjects
items.summary: Return the list of objects synchronized with the given unit.

items.name: synchronizedTriggers
items.summary: Returns the list of triggers synchronized with a given waypoint.

items.name: synchronizedWaypoints
items.summary: Returns the list of waypoints synchronized with a given trigger or waypoint.

items.name: synchronizeObjectsAdd
items.summary: Add given objects to the unit's list of synchronized objects.

items.name: synchronizeObjectsRemove
items.summary: Removes given objects from the unit's list of synchronized objects.

items.name: synchronizeTrigger
items.summary: Synchronizes the trigger with zero or more waypoints.

items.name: synchronizeWaypoint
items.summary: Synchronizes the trigger or the waypoint with an array of waypoints.

items.name: systemChat
items.summary: Types text to the system radio channel. The text will be visible only on the PC where command was executed. If you need the message to show on all computers, you have to execute it globally (see remoteExec).

items.name: systemOfUnits
items.summary: Returns the currently selected system of units. - 0: Metric - 1: Mixed (ground vehicles use Metric / air vehicles use Imperial) - 2: Imperial

items.name: systemTime
items.summary: Returns system time.

items.name: systemTimeUTC
items.summary: Returns systemTime according to Universal Time Coordinated time scale.

items.name: tan
items.summary: Tangent of x, argument in Degrees.

items.name: targetKnowledge
items.summary: Returns unit's knowledge about target.

items.name: targets
syntax: unitOrGroup targets [enemyOnly, maxDistance, sides, maxAge, alternateCenter]
items.summary: Retrieves list of given unit targets matching specified filter. If the filter is not specified, all targets are returned.

items.name: targetsAggregate
syntax: [speaker, side, classname, position, timeMax] targetsAggregate candidates
items.summary: Aggregate candidates.

items.name: targetsQuery
syntax: enquirer targetsQuery [targetIgnore, targetSide, targetType, targetPosition, targetMaxAge]
items.summary: Returns sorted array of targets, known to the enquirer (including own troops), where the accuracy coefficient reflects how close the result matches the query. This command could be CPU intensive.

items.name: taskAlwaysVisible
items.summary: Returns true if the task is flagged to be always visible or false if not.

items.name: taskChildren
items.summary: Return the child tasks of the specified task.

items.name: taskCompleted
items.summary: Return if task is completed. (state Succeeded, Failed or Canceled)

items.name: taskCustomData
items.summary: Returns custom data attached to the local task or an empty array if there are no custom data attached.

items.name: taskDescription
items.summary: Returns the sub-parts of the task description.

items.name: taskDestination
items.summary: Returns the position of the task (as specified by destination parameter in config).

items.name: taskHint
items.summary: Shows info about new, changed or failed task. The text can contain several lines. `\n` is used to set a line return.

items.name: taskMarkerOffset
items.summary: Returns model space position for the task marker

items.name: taskName
items.summary: Returns the name of the given task.

items.name: taskNull
items.summary: A non-existing Task. To compare non-existent tasks use isNull or isEqualTo:

items.name: taskParent
items.summary: Returns the parent task of the specified task.

items.name: taskResult
items.summary: Send a result of the task to the task sender.

items.name: taskState
items.summary: Returns the current state of a task.

items.name: taskType
items.summary: Returns the type of the given task. A new task returns "Default" for the type.

items.name: teamMember
items.summary: Return an agent for given person.

items.name: teamMemberNull
items.summary: A non-existent Team Member. To compare non-existent team members use isNull or isEqualTo:

items.name: teamName
items.summary: Return a name of given team.

items.name: teams
items.summary: Return a list of teams in the current mission.

items.name: teamSwitch
items.summary: Invoke the Team Switch dialog (force it even when conditions are not met). There has to be at least one playable unit for team switch to work, and for this command to work in MP, respawn type in description.ext should…

items.name: teamSwitchEnabled
items.summary: Check if Team Switch is currently enabled. Team Switch is enabled by default.

items.name: teamType
items.summary: Returns a type of given team.

items.name: terminate
items.summary: Terminates (aborts) spawned or execVMed script.

items.name: terrainIntersect
items.summary: Checks for intersection of terrain between two AGL positions. Returns true if intersects with terrain. For ASL variant see terrainIntersectASL.

items.name: terrainIntersectASL
items.summary: Checks for intersection of terrain between two ASL positions. Returns true if intersects with terrain. For AGL variant, see terrainIntersect.

items.name: terrainIntersectAtASL
items.summary: Checks for intersection of terrain between two ASL positions. Same as terrainIntersectASL but returns the intersection ASL position.

items.name: text
items.summary: Creates a structured text containing the given plain text if argument is String. Use setAttributes to set additional attributes on the text. If the argument is location, returns location's text value (see Alt Syntax).

items.name: textLog
items.summary: Dump argument value to debugging output.

items.name: textLogFormat
items.summary: Debugging output.

items.name: tg
items.summary: Identical to tan

items.name: then
items.summary: Links an If Type with Code to be executed if said If Type's condition is true; otherwise, "else" code is executed if provided.

items.name: throw
items.summary: Throws an exception. The exception is processed by first catch block. This command will terminate further execution of the code.

items.name: throwables
items.summary: Returns all throwables in unit inventory in currentThrowable format.

items.name: time
items.summary: Returns time elapsed since mission started (in seconds). The value is different on each client. If you need unified time, use serverTime. Unlike uiTime the time stops when game is paused.

items.name: timeMultiplier
items.summary: Returns the value set with setTimeMultiplier.

items.name: titleCut
items.summary: Displays text on screen.

items.name: titleFadeOut
items.summary: Terminate the title effect and set duration of the fade out phase to the given time. Same as cutFadeOut but for the title layer.

items.name: titleObj
items.summary: Shows object defined in global config in CfgTitles

items.name: titleRsc
items.summary: Displays a resource defined in RscTitles. Also see cutRsc, with these two commands you can show two different resources at once.

items.name: titleText
items.summary: Displays text across the screen. If used along with cutText two different texts (in different type styles) can be shown at once.

items.name: to
items.summary: Continue sequence of for construct. It sets the end value of the index variable.

items.name: toArray
items.summary: Converts the supplied String into an Array of Numbers. The numbers in the created array are the decimal Unicode representations of characters.

items.name: toFixed
items.summary: Converts a number into a string, keeping the specified number of decimals. If the desired number of decimals is higher than the actual number, nulls are added to create the desired decimal length.

items.name: toJSON
items.summary: Converts data to JSON.

items.name: toLower
items.summary: Converts the supplied Unicode string to all lowercase characters. If the string doesn't have characters with codes > 255, use toLowerANSI.

items.name: toLowerANSI
items.summary: Converts the supplied string to all lower case characters fast (could be 3× faster than toLower). ANSI in this case refers to ISO-8859-1 code page.

items.name: toString
items.summary: Converts the supplied Array of Numbers into a String through <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unicode> characters representation conversion, or provided Code to compilable String.

items.name: toUpper
items.summary: Converts the supplied Unicode string to all uppercase characters. If the string doesn't have characters with codes > 255, use toUpperANSI.

items.name: toUpperANSI
items.summary: Converts the supplied string to all upper case characters fast (could be 3x faster than toUpper). ANSI in this case refers to ISO-8859-1 code page.

items.name: triggerActivated
items.summary: Returns true if the trigger has been activated.

items.name: triggerActivation
items.summary: Returns trigger activation.

items.name: triggerAmmo
items.summary: Triggers a munition such as shells, bullets, missiles, rockets, mines and bombs (*shotSubmunition/shotShell/shotBullet/shotMissile/shotRocket*) as if it did hit.

items.name: triggerArea
items.summary: Returns currently monitored trigger area. Since Arma 3 v1.60, the command returns 3rd dimension for the monitored area. If height is not set, the value for it would be -1.

items.name: triggerAttachedVehicle
items.summary: Returns vehicle attached to the trigger (for example using triggerAttachVehicle).

items.name: triggerAttachObject
items.summary: Assigns a static object to the trigger. The activation source is changed to "STATIC".

items.name: triggerAttachVehicle
items.summary: Specifies the entity which will activate the selected trigger.

items.name: triggerDynamicSimulation
items.summary: Controls the ability of given unit to activate entities with disabled Arma 3: Dynamic Simulation. If false dynamically disabled entities will not be activated by this unit's presence.

items.name: triggerInterval
items.summary: Returns trigger condition check frequency in seconds.

items.name: triggerStatements
items.summary: Returns trigger statements.

items.name: triggerText
items.summary: Returns trigger text.

items.name: triggerTimeout
items.summary: Returns trigger timeout.

items.name: triggerTimeoutCurrent
items.summary: Returns current timeout of the given trigger or -1 if countdown is not in progress.

items.name: triggerType
items.summary: Returns the trigger type.

items.name: trim
items.summary: Trims a string.

items.name: true
items.summary: Always true

items.name: try
items.summary: Defines a try-catch structure. This sets up an exception handling block. Any thrown exception in a try block is caught in a catch block. The structured exception block has the following form:

items.name: turretLocal
items.summary: Checks if a turret is local.

items.name: turretOwner
items.summary: Returns id of the turret's owner. Returns 0 on non-server and SP.

items.name: turretUnit
items.summary: Returns the unit in the vehicle turret. To find turret path of known unit, see unitTurret.

items.name: tvAdd
items.summary: Adds an item with given text to Tree View control. The position on Tree View where to add the item and the actual path to this item once added are different.

items.name: tvClear
items.summary: Removes all items from Tree View with given idc.

items.name: tvCollapse
items.summary: Collapses tree item pointed to by the path. IDC means id of parent Tree View.

items.name: tvCollapseAll
items.summary: Collapses all tree items for the given Tree View.

items.name: tvCount
items.summary: Returns children count on given path. IDC means id of parent Tree View.

items.name: tvCurSel
items.summary: Returns path to currently selected item. IDC means id of parent Tree View.

items.name: tvData
items.summary: Returns string data from item on given path. IDC means id of parent CT_TREE.

items.name: tvDelete
items.summary: Removes an item with given Tree View Path from Tree View.

items.name: tvExpand
items.summary: Expands tree item pointed to by the path. IDC means id of parent Tree View.

items.name: tvExpandAll
items.summary: Expands all tree items for the given Tree View.

items.name: tvIsSelected
items.summary: Returns true if given treeview item is selected.

items.name: tvPicture
items.summary: Returns name of picture from item pointed to by path. IDC means id of parent Tree View.

items.name: tvPictureRight
items.summary: Returns the right picture of a CT_TREE on given path.

items.name: tvSelection
items.summary: Returns array of paths to selected items.

items.name: tvSetColor
items.summary: Sets text color on given Tree View Item

items.name: tvSetCurSel
items.summary: Sets cursor to given item on given path. IDC means id of parent Tree View. To deselect all items use [-1] for the path param (*available since Arma 3 v1.56*)

items.name: tvSetData
items.summary: Sets string data to item on given path. IDC means id of parent Tree View.

items.name: tvSetPicture
items.summary: Sets picture to item selected by path. IDC means id of parent Tree View. Name is picture name. The picture is searched in the mission directory.

items.name: tvSetPictureColor
items.summary: Sets the colour of the picture (set via tvSetPicture) under the specified tree view path.

items.name: tvSetPictureColorDisabled
items.summary: Sets the color of left picture of a tree item defined by path when that item is disabled.

items.name: tvSetPictureColorSelected
items.summary: Sets the color of the left picture of a tree item defined by path when item is selected

items.name: tvSetPictureRight
items.summary: Sets right picture on the tree view item defined by path.

items.name: tvSetPictureRightColor
items.summary: Sets color of the right picture on the tree view item defined by path

items.name: tvSetPictureRightColorDisabled
items.summary: Sets the color of the right picture of a tree item defined by path when item is disabled

items.name: tvSetPictureRightColorSelected
items.summary: Sets the color of the right picture of a tree item defined by path when item is selected

items.name: tvSetSelectColor
items.summary: Sets the select color of given path.

items.name: tvSetSelected
items.summary: Sets the selection state of given treeview item in multi-select control.

items.name: tvSetText
items.summary: Sets string text to item on given path. IDC means id of parent Tree View.

items.name: tvSetTooltip
items.summary: Sets the tooltip text associated with the specified tree view path.

items.name: tvSetValue
items.summary: Sets scalar data to item on given path. IDC means id of parent Tree View. If the given value is not integer, it will be converted to integer

items.name: tvSort
items.summary: Sorts all children of given path. Text of Tree View entries is used for sorting.

items.name: tvSortAll
items.summary: Sorts all children, including trees deriving from given path. Text of Tree View entries is used for sorting.

items.name: tvSortByValue
items.summary: Sorts all children of given path. Value of Tree View entries is used for sorting. tvSetValue can be used to set the value for a given path.

items.name: tvSortByValueAll
items.summary: Sorts all children, including trees deriving from given path. Value of Tree View entries is used for sorting.

items.name: tvText
items.summary: Returns shown text in the item on given path. IDC means id of parent Tree View.

items.name: tvTooltip
items.summary: Gets the tooltip text associated with the specified tree view path.

items.name: tvValue
items.summary: Returns numeric value set for given tree view path.

items.name: type
items.summary: Returns a string of a Location's class name or Task's name (same as taskName).

items.name: typeName
items.summary: Returns the Data Type of an expression.

items.name: typeOf
items.summary: Returns the class name of given target.

items.name: UAVControl
items.summary: Returns array with current operator of UAV and his vehicle role in UAV. If nobody is controlling the UAV, the command tries to find if player has terminal connected to this UAV.

items.name: uiNamespace
items.summary: Returns the global namespace attached to user interface.

items.name: uiSleep
items.summary: Suspend execution of script for given uiTime. uiSleep is a sleep method to delay script execution where script time/simulation time is stopped.

items.name: uiTime
items.summary: Returns UI time elapsed since mission started (in seconds). Unlike time the uiTime does not stop when game is paused.

items.name: unassignCurator
items.summary: Unassign curator (will destroy both sides of connection).

items.name: unassignItem
items.summary: Unassigns existing item and tries to put it into inventory. If there is no space in inventory the item simply disappears. See also unlinkItem.

items.name: unassignTeam
items.summary: Unassigns the unit (in the case of a vehicle its commander unit) from his team. This is equal to unit assignTeam "MAIN".

items.name: unassignVehicle
items.summary: Unassigns individual unit from a vehicle, usually previously assigned with *assignAsXXX* command, i.e removes assignedVehicleRole of the unit.

items.name: underwater
items.summary: Returns whether the object is fully underwater.

items.name: uniform
items.summary: Returns name of uniform.

items.name: uniformContainer
items.summary: Returns a cargo container of a unit's uniform.

items.name: uniformItems
items.summary: Get array with all items (of any kind, even weapons) from uniform.

items.name: uniformMagazines
items.summary: Get array with all magazines from uniform of the given unit.

items.name: uniqueUnitItems
syntax: uniqueUnitItems [unit, weaponsItems, uniformItems, vestItems, backpackItems, assignedItems]
items.summary: Returns hashmap of all items in units inventory as [classname, count] pairs.

items.name: unitAddons
items.summary: Returns list with addons the unit belongs to.

items.name: unitAimPosition
items.summary: Returns the position on the unit other units can aim at. Same as aimPos only returns position in PositionAGL format and has render scope alternative unitAimPositionVisual.

items.name: unitAimPositionVisual
items.summary: Returns the position on the unit other units can aim at in render scope. See also aimPos, unitAimPosition.

items.name: unitBackpack
items.summary: Returns unit's backpack

items.name: unitCombatMode
items.summary: Gets individual unit's combat mode. For more information see setUnitCombatMode.

items.name: unitIsUAV
items.summary: Returns whether or not the given transport object is a drone (UAV, UGV), regardless of if it has a crew or if it is empty, corresponding to the `isUAV` transport parameter.

items.name: unitPos
items.summary: Return the unit position rules.

items.name: unitReady
items.summary: Check if the unit is ready. Unit is busy when it is given some command like move, until the command is finished.

items.name: unitRecoilCoefficient
items.summary: Returns recoil coefficient of a soldier.

items.name: units
items.summary: Returns an array with all the units in the group or unit's group, or all units belonging to a certain side.

items.name: unitsBelowHeight
items.summary: Returns units in group/array below given Above Terrain Level (ATL) altitude.

items.name: unitTurret
items.summary: Returns the turret path the given vehicle's gunner is in. To get the turret's unit see turretUnit.

items.name: unlinkItem
items.summary: Unassign and delete existing item from its assigned slot. Nothing happens if the item does not exist or is not assigned. See also unassignItem.

items.name: unlockAchievement
items.summary: Unlocks the given achievement. The achievements are listed in CfgAchievements, however none of the currently listed achievements is used in Arma 3, hence the command always returns false.

items.name: unregisterTask
items.summary: Unregisters a task type from given agent. The task type is the name given in `CfgTasks` classes in `name` property. Also available from registeredTasks array.

items.name: updateDrawIcon
items.summary: Updates the icon to be shown in 2D editor for the specified editor,object. If maintain size is false,icon will not scale depending on the,scale of the map.

items.name: updateMenuItem
syntax: map updateMenuItem [menu item index, text, command]
items.summary: Sets the text and command for the menu item. Index is index returned by addMenuItem command. Command is optional.

items.name: updateObjectTree
items.summary: Update the editor object tree.

items.name: useAIOperMapObstructionTest
items.summary: Toggle secondary obstruction test on road paths.

items.name: useAISteeringComponent
items.summary: Enable the new AI driving, used to test the old and new AI driving.

items.name: useAudioTimeForMoves
items.summary: Switch between elapsed game time and audio time being used as animation timer. Used for audio/animation synchronization.

items.name: userInputDisabled
items.summary: Returns whether or not user input is disabled.

items.name: values
items.summary: Returns all values stored in the given HashMap. The order of the returned Array corresponds to the order of the Array returned by the keys command.

items.name: vectorAdd
items.summary: Adds two arrays of numbers. Replaces BIS_fnc_vectorAdd.

items.name: vectorCos
items.summary: Cosine of angle between two 3D or 2D vectors.

items.name: vectorCrossProduct
items.summary: Cross product of two 3D vectors.

items.name: vectorDiff
items.summary: Subtracts one 3D vector from another. (vector1 - vector2)

items.name: vectorDir
items.summary: Returns an object's direction vector in world space.

items.name: vectorDirVisual
items.summary: Returns an object's direction vector in world space and render time scope.

items.name: vectorDistance
items.summary: Returns Euclidean distance between two points.

items.name: vectorDistanceSqr
items.summary: Squared distance between two 3D vectors.

items.name: vectorDotProduct
items.summary: Dot product of two 3D vectors.

items.name: vectorFromTo
items.summary: Unit vector, equal to direction from vector1 to vector2. In other words this command produces normalised vector between given 2 points.

items.name: vectorLinearConversion
syntax: vectorLinearConversion [rangeFrom, rangeTo, rangeValue, vectorFrom, vectorTo, clip]
items.summary: Interpolates vector between the given *vectorFrom* and *vectorTo* value according to the given range value.

items.name: vectorMagnitude
items.summary: Magnitude of a 3D vector.

items.name: vectorMagnitudeSqr
items.summary: Squared magnitude of a 3D vector.

items.name: vectorModelToWorld
items.summary: Converts vector direction from model to world space.

items.name: vectorModelToWorldVisual
items.summary: Converts vector from model to world space in render time scope.

items.name: vectorMultiply
items.summary: Multiplies an array of numbers by a scalar or another array of numbers.

items.name: vectorNormalized
items.summary: Returns normalised vector (unit vector, vectorMagnitude == 1) of given vector. If given vector is 0 result is a 0 vector as well.

items.name: vectorSide
items.summary: Returns an object's side vector in world space.

items.name: vectorSideVisual
items.summary: Returns an object's side vector in world space and render time scope.

items.name: vectorUp
items.summary: Returns an object's up vector in world space.

items.name: vectorUpVisual
items.summary: Returns an object's up vector in world space and render time scope.

items.name: vectorWorldToModel
items.summary: Converts vector direction from world to model space.

items.name: vectorWorldToModelVisual
items.summary: Converts vector direction from world to model space in render time scope.

items.name: vehicle
items.summary: Vehicle in which given unit is mounted. If none, unit is returned. Alternatively, use objectParent

items.name: vehicleCargoEnabled
items.summary: Check if the vehicle has enabled transporting other vehicles or not.

items.name: vehicleChat
items.summary: Types text to the vehicle radio channel. The text will be visible only on the PC where command was executed. If you need the message to show on all computers, you have to execute it globally, see remoteExec.

items.name: vehicleMoveInfo
items.summary: Returns current vehicle move/turn info (a getter for sendSimpleCommand) in format [moveInfo, turnInfo]. Possible values:

items.name: vehicleRadio
items.summary: Sends the audio message to the vehicle radio channel. The message is defined in CfgRadio in the description.ext file or config radio protocol. The transmission will play only on the PC where command was executed.

items.name: vehicleReceiveRemoteTargets
items.summary: Gets whether the vehicle can acquire targets via datalink from the Side center.

items.name: vehicleReportOwnPosition
items.summary: Gets whether the vehicle shares its own position via datalink with the Side center.

items.name: vehicleReportRemoteTargets
items.summary: Gets whether the vehicle shares acquired targets via datalink with the Side center.

items.name: vehicles
items.summary: Returns an array of all vehicles available to current client. This command returns both empty and crewed vehicles but not soldiers. It will also return "WeaponHolderSimulated" of dead bodies (weapon on the ground).

items.name: vehicleVarName
items.summary: Returns the variable name that contains a primary editor reference to this object. This is the variable given in the *Insert Unit dialog / name field* in the editor. It can be changed using setVehicleVarName.

items.name: velocity
items.summary: Returns the velocity of the object as vector in m/s.

items.name: velocityModelSpace
items.summary: Returns the velocity (speed vector) of the vehicle as an array with format [x, y, z] in metre per second. Vector is in model space.

items.name: verifySignature
items.summary: Check if file is signed by any key present in game keys folders. On clients, it does not check against the keys accepted by server.

items.name: vest
items.summary: nameof vest.

items.name: vestContainer
items.summary: Returns a cargo container of a unit's vest.

items.name: vestItems
items.summary: Get array with all items (of any kind, even weapons) from vest.

items.name: vestMagazines
items.summary: Get array with all magazines from vest of the given unit.

items.name: viewDistance
items.summary: Returns the rendering distance.

items.name: visibleCompass
items.summary: Checks if the player has compass opened and visible. Keep in mind that the GPS minimap in Arma 3 also shows the direction.

items.name: visibleGPS
items.summary: Checks if the player has GPS receiver (minimap) opened and visible.

items.name: visibleMap
items.summary: Return true if the main map is shown (active). In Arma 3 it also returns true if the respawn screen map is visible.

items.name: visiblePosition
items.summary: Returns an object's rendered position (z value above surface underneath) in render time scope. Same as getPosVisual.

items.name: visiblePositionASL
items.summary: Returns an object's rendered ASL position (z value above sea level) in render time scope.

items.name: visibleScoretable
items.summary: Checks whether the score table is visible.

items.name: visibleWatch
items.summary: Checks if the player has watch opened and visible. Keep in mind that the GPS minimap in Arma 3 also shows the time.

items.name: waitUntil
items.summary: Suspends execution of scheduled script until the given condition satisfied.

items.name: waterDamaged
items.summary: Checks if the engine was water damaged. When a vehicle is Drowned, the engine gets water damaged and might need full repair either with setDamage or setHitPointDamage to be able to start.

items.name: waves
items.summary: Return waves value.

items.name: waypointAttachedObject
items.summary: Gets the object attached to the waypoint.

items.name: waypointAttachedVehicle
items.summary: Gets the vehicle attached to the waypoint.

items.name: waypointAttachObject
items.summary: Attaches a static object via its numeric ID to the given waypoint. Not to be confused with synchronizeWaypoint!

items.name: waypointAttachVehicle
items.summary: Attaches the Waypoint to the provided vehicle Object.

items.name: waypointBehaviour
items.summary: Gets the waypoint behavior.

items.name: waypointCombatMode
items.summary: Gets the waypoint's combat mode setting.

items.name: waypointCompletionRadius
items.summary: Gets the radius around the waypoint where the waypoint is completed.

items.name: waypointDescription
items.summary: Gets the waypoint description.

items.name: waypointForceBehaviour
items.summary: Returns true if the waypoint behavior is forced.

items.name: waypointFormation
items.summary: Gets the waypoint formation.

items.name: waypointHousePosition
items.summary: Returns buildingPos index assigned to the waypoint.

items.name: waypointLoiterAltitude
items.summary: Gets the waypoint loiter altitude.

items.name: waypointLoiterRadius
items.summary: Gets the waypoint's loiter radius.

items.name: waypointLoiterType
items.summary: Gets the waypoint loiter type. Waypoint uses format Waypoint.

items.name: waypointName
items.summary: Gets the waypoint name.

items.name: waypointPosition
items.summary: Get provided waypoint's position.

items.name: waypoints
items.summary: Returns an array of waypoints for the specified unit/group.

items.name: waypointScript
items.summary: Gets the waypoint script.

items.name: waypointsEnabledUAV
items.summary: Checks if the UAV has waypoints enabled.

items.name: waypointShow
items.summary: A getter for showWaypoint command.

items.name: waypointSpeed
items.summary: Gets the waypoint speed.

items.name: waypointStatements
items.summary: Gets the waypoint statements.

items.name: waypointTimeout
items.summary: Gets the waypoint timeout values.

items.name: waypointTimeoutCurrent
items.summary: Gets the current timeout for currentWaypoint of a group or -1 if countdown is not in progress.

items.name: waypointType
items.summary: Gets the waypoint type.

items.name: waypointVisible
items.summary: A getter for setWaypointVisible command.

items.name: weaponAccessories
items.summary: Get array with all items linked to a given weapon.

items.name: weaponAccessoriesCargo
items.summary: Returns array with all items assigned to the given weapon in given cargo container.

items.name: weaponCargo
items.summary: Get array with weapons from ammo box (or any general weapon holder container).

items.name: weaponDirection
items.summary: Returns the direction that the vehicle weapon is aiming in. For addons the weapon name must be an entry in CfgWeapons.

items.name: weaponDisassemblyEnabled
items.summary: Returns if weapon disassembly is enabled. As disassembly can be enabled/disabled on both player and weapon, it might be necessary to check both.

items.name: weaponInertia
items.summary: Returns current rate of how much the weapon view is distorted because of quick aiming.

items.name: weaponLowered
items.summary: Returns true if given soldier's weapon is lowered.

items.name: weaponReloadingTime
items.summary: Returns current ammo round reloading phase. For a magazine reloading phase see weaponState command.

items.name: weapons
items.summary: Returns array of names of all unit's weapons.

items.name: weaponsInfo
items.summary: Returns entity's weapons information including weapon index and firemode.

items.name: weaponsItems
items.summary: Returns an array with subarrays contains class names and also names of connected items of all the vehicle's weapons.

items.name: weaponsItemsCargo
items.summary: Returns an array with subarrays contains class names and also names of connected items of all the vehicle's cargo weapons in weaponsItems format.

items.name: weaponState
items.summary: Returns the given or currently selected weapon state for unit or vehicle. With #Syntax 2, if no optional arguments are present, currently selected weapon is queried.

items.name: weaponsTurret
items.summary: Returns all weapons of a given turret. Use turret path [-1] for driver's turret.

items.name: weightRTD
items.summary: Returns weight of RTD helicopter.

items.name: west
items.summary: West (BLUFOR) side.

items.name: WFSideText
items.summary: Returns the unlocalized text value of a side or an object's/group's side.

items.name: while
items.summary: Repeats Code while the given condition is true. A part of while-do construct.

items.name: wind
items.summary: Returns the current wind vector (in m/s).

items.name: windDir
